title: A4 flow-anomaly: H-OF1..H-OF5 clean_holdout results (as_of 2026-11-10 22:30 UTC)
body:
Segment clean_holdout only. Short first sample: 104 linear perps, flow_3s from 2026-11-07 17:46, liquidations from 2026-11-08 00:46, one market state that includes the 11-10 CPI sell-off. 43% of symbol-minutes were lost to collector outages; first 24h per symbol is warm-up. Holm over the OF block: nothing survives (smallest adjusted p 0.62).
- Detector property: |robust z| > 4 on 1m signed taker imbalance fires on 21.6% of scored minutes (median symbol 19.5%, p10-p90 11.7-32.7%). A symbol's own top-1% |z| starts at about 56. The registered detector isn't selective, which makes OF1/OF2/OF5 weak tests.
- H-OF1 contradicts: fwd |ret| ratio vs matched same-hour minutes is 1.14 at 5m (CI 0.99-1.40) and 1.05 at 15m (0.93-1.21), so the registered 1.5 is excluded. 0 of 103 symbols reach 1.5 at 15m.
- H-OF2 contradicts: sign rate 0.513 (CI 0.495-0.529) at 5m, 0.505 at 15m; mean +1.6 / +2.5 bp (t 1.2 / 1.0).
- H-OF3 inconclusive, sign opposite to the hypothesis: 164 declustered clusters (140 long liquidations). The 60m return signed for reversal is -1.85 sigma (t -1.92, 17 hour clusters), -82 bp, so price continued and did not revert. The original spec gives contradicts (t -2.06).
- H-OF4 inconclusive: robust Mahalanobis test AUC 0.583 vs imbalance |z| 0.603 (diff -0.021, CI -0.065 to +0.073). Every detector is weak for |r15| > 2 sigma (AUC 0.50-0.60). The test half has 12 hour blocks.
- H-OF5 contradicts: BTC->alt 3-min lift 1.32 (CI 1.16-1.49) vs alt->BTC 1.28. Lift at lag 0 is 1.71, so this is common shocks, not a BTC lead.
- Exploratory (not a verdict, not causal): per-symbol top-1% thresholds give a 5m vol ratio of 1.51 (CI 0.96-2.33) and sign 0.53. A selective detector deserves a newly registered forward test.
- Tooling: latest_anomalies(symbols, as_of, lookback_h=24) for the market-state report. It reads in batched 1m rollups and scores the lookback only: 8 symbols 7 s, 104 symbols 85 s. The Mahalanobis fit is in data/models/flow_anomaly/mahalanobis_v1.json. Rule candidates R-FLOW-1..4 (confidence C) are in the report.

title: Program 2 launched (strategies by regime, TradFi sessions, PnL decomposition, simulator, synthetic robustness, literature)
body: User request after wave 1: robust regime-conditional strategy findings, widely known automatable TradFi facts (gaps), PnL decomposition into hidden factors with context-dependent rankings, a paper-based research cycle, less obvious strategies, an execution simulator with market and limit orders calibrated on real 3s flow (trader reaction functions, transfer across markets by liquidity scaling), and robustness through generated data. Plan: research/plans/2026-11-11_strategy_program.md. Pre-registered 22 hypotheses before testing (H-RC1-2, H-TF1-5, H-PD1-4, H-NS1-5, H-SIM1-4, H-SYN1-2) plus H-TP1 (registered earlier, untested). Wave 1 synthesis done first: 53 rules in research/rules.yaml (18 A, 20 B, 15 C provisional), BELIEFS.md section 6, forward-only H-LEV6, H-VM6, H-OF6, H-OF7. Six agents launched (B1 strategy map + PnL decomposition, B2 TradFi sessions, B3 new strategies, B4 simulator, B5 synthetic robustness, B6 literature). Generated data is for deterministic strategies only (principle 1).

title: B5 start: synthetic robustness of trend-zoo selection (H-SYN1, H-SYN2)
body: Plan fixed before running. Generator (sim/resample.py): per symbol, in-sample (llm_in_sample, event_ts < 2026-07-01) 1h bars only, resampled as whole relative-OHLC tuples (log close-close r, open gap, upper/lower wick offsets) so OHLC stays valid; 200 paths = 100 stationary block bootstrap (mean block = Politis-White/PPW on |r|, capped at min(3 sqrt n, n/3)) + 100 regime-switching paths (hourly v0 cell Markov chain fitted in-sample, blocks resampled within the simulated cell). Paths aggregated to 4h, zoo signals/P&L reproduced by a vectorised engine checked against trend_zoo + evaluate.strategy_pnl. Grids: zoo (21 variants) and a breakout grid fixed now: Donchian entry {5,10,20,40} days x exit {0.25,0.5} x entry, scale 3.0 (8 configs). Selection per symbol: hist = argmax in-sample Sharpe; syn-median = argmax median generated Sharpe (H-SYN1); syn-q10 = argmax 10th-percentile generated Sharpe (H-SYN2). H-SYN1 primary stat: per-symbol degradation difference averaged over the two grids, mean over 23 symbols, 10k symbol-bootstrap 95% CI; H-SYN2 primary: zoo grid, paired holdout Sharpe difference. Verdict map: success criterion met = supports; point estimate on the wrong side = contradicts; right sign but CI includes 0 = inconclusive. Daily P&L by realisation date (bar t's P&L on the date of bar t+1), so no holdout return enters an in-sample Sharpe. Null benchmark for H-SYN1: a uniformly random variant (degradation is partly mechanical when the champion is not chosen).

title: B2: Bybit TradFi perps trade 24/7, including weekends (not frozen)
body: Before any H-TP1/H-TF test. 1h last and index bars for the 9 equity perps (TSLA INTC GOOGL AAPL MSTR NVDA MU QQQ SOXL) and 4 commodities exist for every hour, weekends included. Relative to regular-hours (10-15 ET) bars, pooled over equities: weekday overnight (20:00-04:00 ET) turnover ~0.3x and mean |r| ~0.45x; pre-market 04:00 ET and Sunday 20:00 ET bars spike (the 24/5 underlying sessions); weekend (Fri 20:00 ET - Sun 17:00 ET) turnover ~0.07-0.13x, |r| ~0.2x, 2-5% zero-return hours. The Bybit index also moves on weekends (TSLA weekend |r| 0.09%/h vs 0.59% regular hours); last-index basis ~4-5 bp median at all hours. So weekends are quiet but not frozen (BELIEFS P5 says freeze: closer to near-freeze). Consequence: the overnight gap is a traded drift on the perp, not a price jump; there is no discontinuity at the cash open, only a vol spike (09:00 ET bar |r| ~2.1x).

title: B2 TradFi session block: design fixed before results
body: Module research/tradfi_session_study.py. NYSE calendar: 09:30-16:00 ET (13:30-20:00 UTC EDT, 14:30-21:00 UTC EST), 2026 holidays + early closes 13:00 ET (Nov 27, Dec 24) hard-coded from the NYSE 2026-2028 calendar release. CME Sunday reopen 18:00 ET. Prices: P(T) = close of the 1h bar ending at T. First cash hour = the 1h bar containing 09:30 ET, i.e. 09:00-10:00 ET; the 'open' price is P(09:00 ET), so the 30 pre-open minutes are assigned to the cash session (overnight = prev close 16:00 ET -> 09:00 ET; intraday = 09:00 -> 16:00 ET, 7 bars; 4 on early closes). Robustness: open at 10:00 ET. sigma_on = RMS of the previous 20 overnight returns (>= 10), sigma_day = sqrt(mean RTH realised variance of the previous 20 sessions); both known at the open. H-TP1: signed reversal -sign(on)*ret(09:00->11:00 ET)/(sigma_day*sqrt(2/7)). H-TF1: |gap|>1 sigma_on, filled if a cash bar high/low touches prev close; baseline calendar.gap_fill_baseline(|gap|/sigma_bar, n_bars); date-clustered z. H-TF2: on - intraday log return, date-averaged, NW t. H-TF3: first 1h close (10:00-14:00 ET bars) beyond the first-bar high/low, held to the close, net 15 bp round trip, risk units /sigma_day; random baseline same symbol/side/entry hour/holding, random date in segment, 1000 draws. H-TF4: last bar (15:00 ET) on prev close->10:00 ET return, each scaled by its trailing 20-session RMS, OLS date-clustered. H-TF5: CL BZ XAU XAG, R1 = Sun 18:00 ET -> Mon 07:00 UTC, R2 = Mon 07:00 -> 12:00 UTC, sign(R1)*R2/(sigma*sqrt5), sigma = RMS of prior Mon-Fri 1h returns; literal 23:00 UTC variant reported. Segment by session open vs 2026-07-01; verdicts need >= 30 dates (10 weekends TF5), Holm over the 6 TF-block primary one-sided p values per segment. Equity perps listed 2026-11-05 (SPY MSFT META AVGO TSM ORCL HOOD...) and SPCX (< 120 days) excluded.

title: B4 execution simulator v0: start (H-SIM1..H-SIM4)
body: Building src/ai_trader/sim/ (fill_model, reaction, flow_sim, replay) and src/ai_trader/research/simulator_study.py. Data: flow_3s read point in time as of 2026-11-10T23:00:00Z, Bybit linear, 104 symbols. Coverage of a 28,800-candle day: 11-07 7.4k (from 17:46), 11-08 24.4k for the 50 original symbols but only 3.4k for the 54 added at ~21:00, 11-09 15.9k, 11-10 10.7k (collector gaps). Split for H-SIM2: fit 11-08+11-09, validate 11-10 (11-07 dropped as partial). Live records: data/mm/analysis/mainnet-* deduplicated by orderId/execId: 5,128 mm quotes (161 filled), 162 maker fills, 2026-11-08 02:20 to 11-09 08:15. All of it is after the knowledge cutoff: clean_holdout only, a short first sample from one market state. Choices left open by the registry are fixed in the study METHOD before running.

title: B4 overwrote the shared src/ai_trader/sim/__init__.py
body: B5 (generated data) created src/ai_trader/sim/ with __init__.py and resample.py a few minutes before B4 wrote its own __init__.py, so B4's Write replaced B5's one-line docstring. Recovered the original text from __pycache__ and merged both (no code was lost; the file held only a docstring). Lesson: check for concurrent new files before creating a package another agent may share.

title: B1 strategy map + PnL decomposition: start (H-RC1, H-RC2, H-PD1-4)
body: Fixed before any result: (1) panel research.strategy_panel: every bar-runnable REGISTRY strategy at configured frequency (1h params on 1h; geo_* on 4h) + zoo_ensemble (4h), universes L (23 crypto) and T (16 TradFi perps, >= 120 days; equity 4h from complete groups of four 1h bars), evaluate.strategy_pnl, 7.5 bps/side, signals on full history; P&L dated by the start of each holding interval (UTC day = 00-24h, aligned with close-to-close factor returns); pnl_d = daily sum / sqrt(bars per day) for scale-free cross-frequency comparisons; regime = v0 cell at 00:00 UTC from the 1h labeller. Skipped: flow_momentum, cvd_divergence (flow_bars only BTCUSDT from 2026-05-11); oi_price_divergence on T (OI from 2026-11-05). shock_regime is data-generated: in the map, not evidence. (2) H-RC1: by_regime per strategy x segment on universe L, pairs >= 5 episodes both segments, Spearman of shrunk means, 2000-draw episode bootstrap, recorded once as 'pooled'. H-RC2: EW vs unconditional (IS pooled mean > 0) vs conditional (IS shrunk cell mean > 0) books, paired Sharpe diffs, 10-day circular block bootstrap. Holm over the 3 RC p-values. (3) PD block in research.pnl_decomposition_study (methods in its docstring, written before running): PCA/ENB per segment with 10-day block bootstrap; factor regressions with segment-specific factor sets (TradFi factors holdout only); IPCA (KPS 2019 ALS, numpy) on strategy x symbol weeks with family-interacted context characteristics, K chosen on in-sample pseudo-OOS IC only; MFE/MAE trade decomposition. Holm within PD.

title: B3 block NS start: funding settlement, options expiry, sessions, hour-of-week vol, QQQ open (H-NS1..5)
body:
Program 2 agent B3. Modules: features/seasonality.py (causal hour-of-week vol factor, Deribit expiry calendar, funding-settlement mapping, DST-aware NYSE open bar) and research/new_strategies_study.py. Controls fixed before any result (module docstring):
- NS1: settlements mapped per symbol from the lake funding table; only prints reached after exactly 480 min at 00/08/16 UTC (ENA 4h regime from 2025-01 and SOL 2h episode in 2022 dropped; all other L symbols are 8h). x = sign(rate) |fz|, fz of the print known 1h before T vs trailing 90d prints (H-LEV5 definition). pre/post = 1h returns scaled by the robust sigma known at bar open. OLS, date-clustered SE. Placebo at 04/12/20 UTC and a scale-only z are diagnostics only.
- NS2: every Friday is an expiry, so C1 (verdict) = Thu08-Fri08 and Fri08-Sat08 log(RV/logHAR) minus the mean of Tue08-Wed08 and Wed08-Thu08 of the same week (Mon excluded: HAR lags hold the weekend). C2 = monthly minus non-monthly Fridays (same weekday), reported only. Known bias: the post window holds Saturday 00-08 UTC, over-forecast by HAR, so d_post is biased against the hypothesis.
- NS3: HAC Wald F on daily session-mean 4-vectors; tilt = long best / short worst in-sample session at 7.5 bps per side.
- NS4: expanding factor, kappa 20, 3h kernel, cap 50, floor 0.1, >= 8 weeks; paired per-bar QLIKE vs sigma_risk_next, NW t over dates.
- NS5: QQQ bar containing 09:30 ET; pooled segment is primary (QQQ 1h bars only from 2026-06-06).
Holm over the 5 primary p-values; an in-sample supports with Holm p >= 0.05 is downgraded to inconclusive.

title: B2: TF5 strategy random baseline compared a date-averaged mean with trade-mean draws
body: In tradfi_session_study.strategy_tf5 the 'beats random' fraction compared the weekend-averaged mean net (risk units) of the actual trades with the trade-level mean of each random draw; every other strategy compares trade mean with trade mean. Fixed before recording (actual = trade mean). Does not touch any hypothesis primary statistic (H-TF5 is the weekend-clustered continuation t; the random baseline is only in the strategy view). Found on the first scratch run; results were then regenerated once.

title: NS2 dropped weeks with a NaN window instead of skipping only the missing asset
body: First (unrecorded) pass of new_strategies_study: residuals e = log RV - log F are NaN (not null) where a window is incomplete or the log-HAR is not yet warm, and drop_nulls() does not drop NaN. Polars group means then turned a whole week into NaN whenever one of BTC/ETH was missing, so the in-sample NW sample was 272 of 324 weeks and the window means printed as null. Same NaN-vs-null slip in the NS1 descriptive x-buckets (in-sample bucket means null). Fix: filter is_finite() before grouping. No change of test design; nothing had been recorded. Lesson: in polars, NaN and null are different; check both after log() of possibly-missing data.

title: B2 TradFi session block: H-TP1 and H-TF1..5 none supported; five contradicted in the holdout
body:
clean_holdout (93 NYSE sessions x 9 equity perps; 19 weekends x 4 commodities), Holm over the 6 TF tests:
H-TP1 open reversal -0.09 sigma (t -0.9) contradicts; in-sample +0.27 (t 1.9, 16 dates) - sign flipped after the cutoff (weekday overnights +0.51 t 3.0 in-sample).
H-TF1 gap fill 22.4% vs baseline 27.8% (-5.4 pp, z -1.8) contradicts; ex-post RV baseline -1.0 pp.
H-TF2 night - day +3 bp (t 0.14) inconclusive (about zero); in-sample +96 bp t 1.5.
H-TF3 ORB gross +1 bp, net -13.9 bp/trade (t -2.4), random 61% contradicts.
H-TF4 slope -0.09 (t -0.9), sign agreement 44% contradicts.
H-TF5 continuation -0.13 sigma (t -0.9; CL -0.35, BZ -0.29) contradicts; literal 23:00 UTC +0.06.
llm_in_sample: all inconclusive (16 dates < 30; TF5 11 weekends, t 0.5).
No automatable effect at 7.5 bp/side. Fading > 1 sigma overnight moves at the open loses -67 bp net (t -2.5, worse than 99.8% of random); the mirror (follow for 2h) is post-hoc, opposite sign in-sample: proposed as H-TP1b, forward only. Rule candidates R-TF-1..7 in the report.

title: B2: register H-TP1b (continuation of > 1 sigma overnight moves in equity perps, 09:00-11:00 ET) for forward testing?
body: Seen post hoc in the H-TP1 holdout (follow > 1 sigma overnight moves for the first two cash hours: about +52 bp gross, +37 bp net, 246 trades), opposite sign in the 32 in-sample trades. Not registered by B2 (no edits to hypotheses.yaml). If registered, test only on sessions after 2026-11-11 with the tradfi_session_study machinery. Also: BELIEFS P5 / R-PX-9 say TradFi perps freeze on weekends; the off-hours profile shows they trade at about 0.1-0.15x turnover and 0.25-0.33x the hourly abs return, index included - suggest rewording to near-freeze.

title: Literature cycle B6: decomposition, structural strategies, simulators, overfitting
body: Literature cycle for Program 2 (agent B6). 38 papers verified (arXiv API / Crossref; six read in full), one note each in docs/paper_notes/, synthesis in research/reports/literature_2026-11-11.md, reading list appended. Topics: (1) P&L decomposition, 8 papers (Sharpe 1992, Fung-Hsieh 2001, Meucci ENB, IPCA, GKX, Liu-Tsyvinski-Wu, factor momentum, factor timing); (2) less obvious strategies, 11 (overnight/intraday, overnight drift + its 2026 disappearance, intraday momentum, gamma hedging, ORB, pre-FOMC, expiry pinning, perp fundamentals, crypto carry, crypto periodicity, liquidation cascades); (3) simulators, 10 (CST, queue-reactive, Hawkes review, state-dependent Hawkes, LMZ fill survival, deep fill survival, microstructure invariance, ABIDES, Get Real, CGAN world agent); (4) overfitting / generated data, 9 (PBO, DSR, HLZ, stationary bootstrap, Carr-LdP synthetic rules, Quant GANs, signature market generator, cGAN strategy tuning, CPCV vs walk-forward). Key observations: classic TradFi session effects decayed after publication (overnight drift ~0 since 2021, pre-FOMC drift gone), so H-TF priors are upper bounds; crypto evidence is strong for vol/volume periodicity at funding times and the top of the hour, not for direction; carry decays as a leverage premium (agrees with C1); purely endogenous flow models under-produce vol (HLR: 5 vs 14 bp), so the H-SIM2 generator needs an exogenous jump channel; fill models should be censored survival models scored by RCLL; Kyle-Obizhaeva invariance gives pre-specified scaling exponents for H-SIM3; PBO/CSCV is missing from the repo and is cheap; one synthetic study favours CPCV over walk-forward for parameter selection (tension with the house rule, user decision). 15 draft H-LIT-* hypotheses proposed, none registered, no results recorded.

title: B1: NaN / -inf leaks in the PD factor and IPCA inputs (caught before any PD result was read)
body:
Three numerical bugs found on the first PD runs, all fixed before the decomposition results were looked at:
(1) CARRY factor: on 55 dates every L coin had the same funding print, so the rank long-short weights were 0/0 -> NaN, and
polars drop_nulls() does not drop NaN; OLS then crashed (SVD did not converge). Fix: factor_panel turns NaN into null (no factor that day).
(2) IPCA weekend-share characteristic: polars rolling_sum leaves ~1e-17 residue where the true sum is 0, so a strategy with no
trailing exposure got -inf. Same risk in the trailing-Sharpe and funding-z denominators (a flat unit would have produced an
arbitrary +-5 clipped Sharpe). Fix: denominators below 1e-9 (1e-12 for funding sd) are treated as zero (characteristic 0 / null);
zmatrix now raises on any non-finite instrument.
(3) Strategy-map grades: the first version graded |t| regardless of sign, but the shrunk symbol-day mean and the date-clustered t can
disagree in sign (e.g. trend R6 in-sample shrunk +0.72 vs t -0.7). Fix: t is counted in the direction of the shrunk mean. Registered
RC verdicts are unaffected (they don't use grades).
Lesson: polars NaN != null; rolling-window sums are not exact zeros; always assert finiteness at the model boundary.

title: B1 strategy map: regime rankings don't carry over (H-RC1 inconclusive); cell-filtered book loses less (H-RC2 holdout supports)
body:
Panel: 16 bar-runnable strategies (flow_momentum, cvd_divergence skipped: flow_bars only BTCUSDT from 2026-05; OI strategy skipped on T),
23 crypto (L) + 15 TradFi perps (T; SPCX 118 d < 120), 692,705 symbol-strategy-days, data/priors/strategy_panel_daily.parquet.
Zoo ensemble reproduces the H-TR1 panel (in-sample mean Sharpe 0.35 vs 0.33).
H-RC1 (pooled): Spearman of in-sample vs holdout shrunk cell means 0.085, 95% CI [-0.11, 0.21], p 0.27, 144 pairs; sign agreement 53% -> inconclusive.
H-RC2: clean_holdout Sharpe conditional -0.77 vs equal weight -2.48 (diff +1.71, CI [0.78, 2.65]) vs unconditional -1.56 (+0.79, CI [0.06, 1.99]);
Holm p 0.006 / 0.038 -> supports as registered. BUT every book lost money in Jul-Nov 2026 and the books correlate 0.94: the filter is loss
avoidance, not an edge; without the data-generated shock_regime the gain vs unconditional is +0.69, CI [-0.19, 2.11]. In-sample row is selection.
Context table: no family x cell has a positive net mean graded A or B. Stable cells are all negative: 1h mean reversion in R1/R2/R4 (B; rsi R4/R7 A),
1h trend in R5/R6 (ema_stack R6 A, tsmom B), positioning in R5/R7 (B), geo_struct and weekend fades in R4 (A/B), shock_regime reversal in R2 (A, data-generated).
What it changes: the regime cell is useful as a VETO list (where not to run things), not as a selector of winners.

title: Block NS: only the hour-of-week vol profile survives (H-NS4); funding settlement, expiry pin, sessions and the QQQ open lead fail
body:
Recorded once each (11 rows). Holm over 5 primaries changed nothing.
- H-NS1 (L, 8h settlements; ENA 4h and SOL 2h periods excluded): pre b -0.0095 (t -1.38), post +0.0058 (t 0.73) in-sample -> inconclusive; holdout -0.0105 / +0.048 (t 2.34) -> supports on signs only. Mid-interval placebo pre b -0.020 (t -2.4): the lean is generic hourly funding drift, not settlement flow; 0.01 sigma per unit x, far below costs.
- H-NS2 (BTC/ETH, 08:00-anchored log-HAR residuals): C1 d_pre -0.007 (t -0.16), d_post -0.20 (t -4.19) in-sample (298 weeks) -> contradicts; holdout +0.11 / -0.31 (19 weeks) -> contradicts. Post leg partly the pre-stated Saturday-morning bias. Lead (post-hoc): monthly minus weekly pre-window -0.23 log (t -2.38) in-sample, holdout -0.01 with 4 monthlies -> draft H-NS6.
- H-NS3 (L sessions): F 1.86 p 0.13 in-sample -> contradicts; rank rho in vs holdout -0.40, tilt (long late / short US) net -0.35 R/day in-sample, -0.89 (t -3.1) holdout -> contradicts.
- H-NS4: QLIKE diff L -0.040 (t -8.1) / -0.076 (t -4.5); T -0.29 (t -9.5) / -0.38 (t -15.8) -> supports both segments. Crypto gain mostly weekday intraday shape (US open 13-15 UTC 1.35-1.52x, Sun 22 - Mon 01 UTC 1.8-2.1x, Saturday mornings 0.57-0.65x); TradFi Mon 13 UTC 3.6x.
- H-NS5: pooled slope -0.05 (t -0.63, 108 days) -> contradicts; same-hour beta 0.29 (t 3.2): co-move, no lead.
Report: research/reports/new_strategies_2026-11-11.md (9 draft hypotheses H-NS6..14, 6 rule candidates).

title: B4 simulator: two pipeline bugs caught before any result was recorded
body: (1) The first H-SIM1 run kept only quotes with rejectReason in ("", EC_NoError), which silently dropped every user-cancelled quote (Bybit marks them EC_PerCancelRequest) and left only the 161 filled ones (fill rate 100%). Fixed: drop only EC_PostOnlyWillTakeLiquidity (42 quotes that never rested); 5,086 quotes remain. (2) The study listed symbols by globbing *.parquet in its cache, which picked up its own output sim3_symbol_days.parquet as a symbol and crashed H-SIM2 after 15 minutes; symbols now come from the cached instrument list. Neither bug reached a recorded result.

title: B4 generator v0: Gaussian-copula activity with a slow latent component instead of a Hawkes count model
body: Generator iterations on XRP/TSLA/MAVIA (days 2026-11-08/09), judged by in-sample diagnostics only (the 2026-11-10 validation day was not looked at for the choice): (a) OLS HAR on log(1+n) with continuous noise: activity ACF 0.26 vs 0.51 real (errors-in-variables + rounding); (b) two-kernel NB Hawkes (MLE): branching 0.9 but activity ACF 0.13-0.18 (NB dispersion 2-4 absorbs persistent bursts); (c) Hawkes plus a log-AR(1) slow regime: 0.18; (d) Gaussian copula with a latent two-component AR(1) fitted to the normal-score ACF out to 1 h, persistence capped at a 1 h half-life (uncapped, the fit put 40% of the variance in a near-unit-root day-level component): activity ACF 0.44 vs 0.51 and the exact marginal of trade counts. Chosen (d); the Hawkes code stays as activity="hawkes". Also: return innovations truncated at the largest fitted standardised residual (exp of a t tail produced notionals 10^5 x the median), impact restricted to non-negative linear + square-root terms (the unrestricted fit had opposite signs and reversed impact for large flows), HAR terms of |r| added to the variance equation, and a compound-Poisson jump variant (orchestrator note: Huang-Lehalle-Rosenbaum exogenous channel) reported beside the registered model.

title: B4 H-SIM2 first full run: 50 of 104 symbol fits crashed (overflow in the copula optimiser)
body: math.exp(-z) overflowed inside the Nelder-Mead parametrisation of the activity copula for 50 symbols, so the first H-SIM2 class table covered 54 symbols (major 4/5, alt 3/5, TradFi 2/5 facts inside). Fixed with clipped sigmoids (no change to the model or its settings) and rerun on all symbols before recording. Seen in the crashed run and NOT acted on: the generator puts signed-flow autocorrelation near 0 (real 0.006-0.044) and the continuation ratio at 0.50 (real 0.54-0.59); the generator is not being re-tuned on the validation day.

title: H-SYN1/H-SYN2: generated-path selection does not beat a random pick; literal SYN1 'supports' is mechanical and seed-fragile
body: Seed 0 (pre-specified), 23 symbols, 200 paths each (100 SBB + 100 regime-switching), clean_holdout = 133 days. H-SYN1: degradation(median-path pick) - degradation(in-sample champion), averaged over zoo and breakout grids = -0.59 Sharpe, symbol-bootstrap CI [-1.05, -0.15], day-block CI [-1.17, -0.14] -> recorded 'supports' (literal). But a uniformly random variant gives the same -0.59 [-0.90, -0.31]: lower degradation is mechanical (any non-champion has a lower IS Sharpe). Seeds 1/2: -0.41 [-0.84, +0.01], -0.34 [-0.78, +0.07]. H-SYN2 (zoo, q10 pick vs champion, holdout Sharpe): +0.18 [-0.53, +0.91] -> inconclusive; seeds 1/2 -0.37, -0.06. Holdout Sharpe means (zoo): champion -0.37, median pick -0.06, q10 pick -0.19, random -0.35. Breakout grid: the IS champion is worse than a random pick in the holdout (random +0.38 [+0.04, +0.69] over champion); the median pick +0.58. PBO (CSCV, S=16, in-sample daily P&L): zoo median 0.44, breakout 0.65 -> per-symbol selection is a coin flip, consistent with P7/H-TR2. No relation between PBO and the degradation reduction (Spearman -0.10 zoo, +0.12 bo). CPCV comparator (median test-split Sharpe): zoo -0.15 vs champion, bo +0.24, neither CI excludes 0. Seed stability: the zoo median pick has modal share 0.78 across 3 seeds (all agree for 43% of symbols); q10 pick 0.57 (13%).

title: B5: regime-switching resampler as designed destroys volatility clustering beyond ~half a day
body: Design assumption that resampling blocks within v0 cells along an hourly Markov chain 'preserves vol clustering and regimes' was wrong for the clustering part. v0 cells switch every ~13h on 1h bars, and each new cell run starts a block at a random date in that cell's pool; v0 vol states are relative to the trailing 180 days, so a 'high' bar from 2021 and one from 2025 have different absolute vol. Diagnostics: |r| ACF at 24h is 0.24x real (real 0.17), at 168h 0x; 4h |r| ACF lag 6 0.25x; real values fall inside the 5-95% generated band for 0% of symbols. Kurtosis (0.97x) and cell durations (0.93x) survive. The SBB with Politis-White blocks on |r| (median ~580 h; BTC and LTC hit arch's internal cap min(3 sqrt n, n/3), so the reported 'b_raw' is already capped) reproduces kurtosis (0.96x 1h, 1.02x 4h) and |r| ACF to 24h (0.94x) but decays at 168h (0.72x). Also: RS cannot draw the unlabelled warm-up bars (first ~100 days per symbol), which under-represents early, volatile listing periods (HYPE sd 0.011 vs 0.0127). Fix for any future generator: chain on vol-level-matched blocks, or condition block starts on the previous bar's sigma, and register it as a new hypothesis id. Minor: arch's optimal_block_length returns columns 'stationary'/'circular' (docs say b_sb); caught by the unit test before any run.

title: H-SIM1 inconclusive (clean_holdout): 3 s touch fill model fits live quotes, but only 23 held-out fills
body: 5,086 live mm quotes (100% covered by flow_3s), split at 2026-11-09 01:42 UTC. MLE: a strict 3 s trade-through always fills (b at bound), a touch fills with theta0 = 0.45 (queue position); strict-only variant rejected by AIC (174 vs 974). Held-out: predicted fill rate 1.02% vs observed 0.90% (CI 0.37-1.48%); predicted 60 s markout +2.4 bp vs observed -0.1 bp (CI -11.3 to +7.6). Every-touch-fills predicts 1.67%, outside the CI. Literal criterion met, but the test half has 23 fills, below the 30-fill minimum set in the study code before the run, so recorded inconclusive. Self-print check: 0.6% of fill candles had only our own aggressive notional. Short first sample, one market state.

title: H-SIM3 contradicts (clean_holdout): trader-type signs are mostly stable, magnitudes do not transfer
body: 358 symbol-days (103 symbols, 2026-11-07..10), 3 s regressions, 5-min clustered SE. Sign shares: momentum 0.77 (+; majors 0.92, alts 0.86, TradFi 0.58), obi_5 0.70 (NEGATIVE: takers hit the deeper side), spread in the intensity equation 0.72 (- in alts/TradFi, + in majors). All three below 0.80 pooled. Wald of equal sigma/depth-scaled coefficients rejects in every class (p < 1e-5; IQRs span 2-10x). Stable components: activity rises with recent vol (88% +), flow persistence at lag 1 (72% +). Invariance check (descriptive): trade notional ~ W^0.31 and prints ~ W^0.66 match Kyle-Obizhaeva 1/3 and 2/3; spreads and impact fall faster with liquidity than invariance (slopes 1.7 and 1.4 vs 1). Short first sample.

title: H-SIM2 contradicts (clean_holdout): v0 generator passes majors (4/5) but not alts (0/5) or TradFi (2/5)
body: Generator (Gaussian-copula activity with a 1 h latent component, VAR-type direction, AR spread, linear+sqrt impact, HAR variance, Student-t truncated) fitted per symbol on 2026-11-08/09, 10 paths per symbol validated on 2026-11-10 against the day-to-day envelope. Fails everywhere on signed-flow ACF (sim ~0 vs real 0.002-0.044) and on the continuation ratio (sim 0.50, real 0.53-0.57 in crypto); alts and TradFi also fail |r| ACF and impact. The compound-Poisson jump variant does not help (major 2/5). Short first sample.

title: H-SIM4 contradicts (clean_holdout): generated paths rank activity, not P&L, of the mm quoter
body: Python port of atx mm target_quotes + requote hysteresis on 50 mm_multi symbols, 36 parameter sets, real 2026-11-10 paths vs H-SIM2 paths, same touch fill model. Spearman of pooled net P&L/turnover rankings -0.09 (CI -0.73 to 0.44); turnover and fill-count rankings agree at 0.98. Real replay best: ask 0.2 / bid 0.9 / take-profit 0.9 / requote 0.15 sigma, +14.2 bp of turnover (3.84 USD on 2.7k USD, 43 of 50 symbols positive) vs +7.5 bp for the live mm_multi settings; wide asks (0.9 sigma) lose 23-62 bp. A sell-off day: the bearish distance skew earns on the drift, which a stationary generator cannot reproduce. Finding: mm.rs fast sigma never activates (30 closes = 29 returns < the 30-return minimum of sigma_1h), so quotes never widen on 30-min bursts; not edited, user decision. Short first sample.

title: B1 PnL decomposition: one trend bet, ~25% factor R^2, no alpha, exits leak ~2/3 of excursion, trailing Sharpe anti-predicts
body:
H-PD1 contradicts both segments: correlation-PCA ENB 8.3 [7.7, 8.6] in-sample (16 L sleeves), 13.8 holdout (30 L+T sleeves; L-only 7.5);
top-3 share 0.61 / 0.48. But the Meucci ENB of the actual equal-weight book is 1.15 in-sample, 2.5 holdout (extension): the book is one trend bet.
H-PD2 contradicts both segments: median R^2 0.25 in-sample (MKT TSMOM VOL CARRY LIQ), 0.22 holdout (+QQQ GOLD OIL); no sleeve has a
Holm-significant alpha in both segments (largest in-sample: shock_regime t 2.5, data-generated; holdout -1.5). Clusters on loadings: F1 = +TSMOM
(all trend + compression_breakout, zoo 0.79 t 17.6), F2 = weak -TSMOM (1h mean reversion, calendar, funding, shock), F3 = +MKT (oi_price_divergence 0.65 t 18.6).
Convexity extension (Fung-Hsieh, |MKT| demeaned): median R^2 0.36 / 0.30; trend long convexity (tsmom +0.41 t 11.5), 1h MR short (zscore -0.51 t -12.8).
H-PD3 supports both: IPCA K=3 (chosen in-sample) IC 0.097 (t 3.2) vs trailing-90d Sharpe -0.039; diff +0.136 (t 3.3, Holm p 0.01); holdout
+0.32 (t 1.8, 18 weeks). Caveat: much of the gap is trailing Sharpe being NEGATIVE (strategy returns mean-revert weekly), IPCA holdout IC t 1.2.
H-PD4 supports both: (costs + exit leakage)/sum MFE 0.70 [0.68, 0.71] in-sample (143k trades), 0.75 [0.69, 0.81] holdout; capture 35% / 34%;
costs only 4.8% / 9.1% of MFE. MFE from bar highs/lows is an upper bound. compression_breakout closes only at a loss by construction (box-midpoint exit).
Holm (PD block, m ~ 19 per segment) applied. Changes: diversify away from TSMOM rather than adding trend variants; exits are the main lever.

title: Program 2 synthesis: the regime map only says where strategies lose; the book is one trend bet; edge leaks through exits; hour-of-week vol is real
body: Six agents done (B1-B6). Verdicts recorded once each. Headlines: H-RC1/RC2 regime rankings do not persist (Spearman 0.085), conditioning only avoids losses; H-PD1/PD2 equal-weight book ~1.15 effective bets in-sample, trend = TSMOM + long convexity, 1h MR = short convexity, no residual alpha; H-PD3 IPCA beats trailing Sharpe (weekly strategy reversal); H-PD4 costs + exit leakage 70-75% of favourable excursion, costs only 5-9%; TradFi session effects all fail (H-TP1, H-TF1-5) and equity perps trade 24/7 (R-PX-9 corrected); H-NS4 hour-of-week vol profile supports in both segments (A); NS1/2/3/5 fail; H-SYN1 literal pass is mechanical (random pick gives the same), PBO 0.44/0.65; simulator v0: fill model consistent but under-powered, generator fails alts, reaction functions do not transfer, invariance holds for trade size/count. Rules: 90 (22 A, 38 B, 30 C) in research/rules.yaml. BELIEFS section 7. Follow-ups registered: H-TP1b, H-MM3, H-NS7, H-PD5, H-PD6. Fixed live-quoter bug: mm.rs fast 30-min sigma always fell back to the floor (sigma_last + test). Full pytest 312 passed; cargo test atx 36 passed; clippy clean. Open user decisions: L2/raw-trade data pilot (17-30 GB / 4 weeks for the full scope), CPCV for parameter selection (literature), next MM run parameters (H-MM3 paired test).

title: Microstructure pilot: 1 day of raw trades (51 symbols) and ob200 L2 books (12 symbols) downloaded; H-MS1-9 registered
body: User approved a 1-day pilot (2026-11-11) to fit trade-level laws (arrival times incl. exotic families, sign/flow ACF and PACF, volume), spread vs own future vol, and ETH/SOL spillovers, then simulate and extrapolate sample to population with ML. Batch download of 2026-11-10 (the CPI day): Bybit public trade archives for the 50 mm_multi symbols + BTC via atx trades --raw (lake trades_raw, +~330 MB; 6.9k CARV to 2.1M BTC trades) and ob200 book archives for BTC ETH SOL XRP DOGE HYPE CARV KAS ATOM NVDA QQQ XAU (923 MB zipped in data/raw/pilot_2026-11-10/ob200; not in the lake, no schema change). Bybit has no ob500 for these perps. Storage after pilot: lake ~1.1 GB, raw 0.9 GB of the 30 GB budget. Scaling estimate for 4 weeks: trades ~9 GB (51 symbols) + ob200 ~26 GB zipped (12 symbols) -> books must be reduced to the 100 ms parquet and the zips deleted, or fewer symbols. Registered H-MS1-9 before analysis (FIT 00-12 UTC, TEST 12-24 UTC). Agents C1 (laws) and C2 (book + spillovers) launched; C3 (population + simulator v1, H-MS7/8) follows C1. Note: the live collector and updater are not running (their owning session ended) - flow_3s has a gap from 2026-11-11.

title: C2 start: book reconstruction, spread-vol (H-MS5) and ETH/SOL spillovers (H-MS6) on the 2026-11-10 pilot
body:
Agent C2. Plan fixed before looking at outcomes:
- sim/book.py rebuilds the ob200 book from snapshot+delta (size 0 removes, snapshot resets) and writes a 100 ms state series per symbol (state at the end of each 100 ms bin of the push ts, forward-filled, n_updates per bin) to data/raw/pilot_2026-11-10/book_100ms/. Validation: trade prices vs [bid1, ask1] of the book state before the trade (strict) and before-or-after (loose); multi-price same-ms trade groups are treated as sweeps.
- H-MS5: 1m grid per L2 symbol; y = log RV over the next 5 / 15 min from 1 s mid log returns; x = log time-averaged relative spread over the last minute (log chosen a priori: elasticity, symbols differ 100x in spread; level spread as a robustness row); controls log RV last 5 / 60 min, log depth within 10 bp (both sides, time-averaged last minute), log hour-of-week factor (features.seasonality.profile_asof as of 2026-11-10 00:00; pooled crypto profile where a symbol has < 8 weeks of 1h bars); symbol FE; SE clustered by 5-min block (pooled across symbols). Verdict as registered: TEST coefficient > 0 with t > 2 AND positive OOS R^2 gain (FIT params on TEST) at both horizons. Robustness: TEST without 13:00-16:00 UTC; 30-min clusters.
- H-MS6: Hayashi-Yoshida cross-correlation on unique-ms last-trade log prices, lags 0, +-0.1..60 s, rho(l) = corr(leader at t, target at t+l), peak = argmax rho; significance by 5-min block bootstrap of the HY contributions (LLR and peak-lag distribution). Verdict half = TEST. Granger F (bivariate VAR on 1 s last-trade log returns, BIC lag <= 10) on FIT and TEST. Diebold-Yilmaz generalized FEVD (H = 10) on log 1m RV (12 x 5 s returns per minute) on TEST for BTC, ETH, SOL + crypto tokens with trades in >= 98% of TEST minutes, capped at 15 variables by trade count; net connectedness CI by 30-min block bootstrap. Supports = peak in [0.1, 30] s for > 70% of crypto targets for both ETH and SOL and both net > 0 on TEST.
- Holm over H-MS5 and H-MS6 (p: max of component one-sided p values).

title: C1 start: trade-level laws (H-MS1, H-MS2, H-MS3, H-MS4, H-MS9) on trades_raw 2026-11-10
body:
Starting agent C1 (microstructure pilot, trade-level distributions). Data: trades_raw 2026-11-10 (51 symbols, 6.9k-2.1M prints), FIT 00-12 UTC, TEST 12-24 UTC (contains CPI 13:30; robustness row without 13:00-16:00; the registered verdict uses the full TEST half).

Decisions fixed BEFORE any fit (also in the study docstring / METHOD):
- Bybit prints one taker order as several same-ms same-side prints (BTC: 2.10M prints -> 0.60M same-ms same-side groups, max 825 prints in one group). ORDER = maximal run of prints with the same ms and the same taker side; ARRIVAL EVENT = distinct ms (merges the ~1% of ms with both sides, so durations >= 1 ms). Primary level for H-MS1 durations = arrival events, for H-MS3 signs = orders; the PRINT level is reported for both (print durations of 0 ms are set to 0.5 ms, half the clock resolution).
- H-MS2 'index alpha in [1, 2]' is read as the TAIL index zeta of the CCDF (the Gopikrishnan / Gabaix ~1.5 in the rationale); the CSN pdf exponent is alpha_pdf = zeta + 1. Primary = print-level notional.
- Deseasonalisation (H-MS1 part 3, ACD, H-MS9): causal trailing 30-minute mean duration (one day cannot give an out-of-sample time-of-day profile; flow_3s on 11-10 starts at ~12:00).
- H-MS9 spread / depth imbalance: rebuilt from the ob200 archives for the 12 L2 symbols (250 ms grid, point in time); for the other 39 a trade-based effective-spread proxy (|last buy - last sell| / price) and no depth feature.
- Holm over the five hypotheses' summary p-values; supports only if the literal success criterion holds and the Holm p < 0.05.

title: C2: first book build had no book-span column, and depth bands were silently truncated for BTC
body: The first 100 ms book build reported depth within 5 / 10 / 25 bp, but ob200 holds only 200 levels. For BTC (tick 0.1 at ~74k) that is ~4 bp of book, so all three BTC bands were the same number (the whole visible book). ETH and XAU 25 bp bands are also truncated. Caught in the descriptives (depth5 = depth10 = depth25 for BTC) before any result was recorded. Fix: book.py now stores span_bid_bp / span_ask_bp (distance of the deepest level held) and the report flags truncated bands; all 12 parquet files were rebuilt. H-MS5's depth-10 control is therefore 'visible book' for BTC.

title: H-MS5 contradicts (clean_holdout): the relative spread does not predict own vol out of sample; in tick-bound perps it is tick / mid
body: Pooled 1 m panel, 12 L2 symbols, FE, 5-min clusters. FIT coefficient of log spread on next-5/15m log RV +0.25 / +0.19 (t 2.7), TEST -0.17 (t -1.6) / -0.32 (t -3.0); OOS R^2 gain -0.0016 / -0.0014 (past RV alone: OOS R^2 0.70-0.75). Without 13:00-16:00 it is worse (t -2.75 / -4.94). Mechanism: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, HYPE, ATOM and XAU are at one tick > 96% of the time, so relative spread moves only with the price level (a falling market widens it in bp). Exploratory, not registered: on the free-spread symbols (CARV, KAS, NVDA) the OOS gain is positive (+0.009 / +0.006, DM t 3.4 / 4.0) while the TEST coefficient is insignificant. Next: a registered spread-in-ticks / free-spread test on more days.

title: H-MS6 contradicts (clean_holdout): ETH/SOL do not lead other tokens' returns (HY peak at 0); they are net vol transmitters
body: Hayashi-Yoshida on trade-time prices, 39 crypto targets: peak at lag 0 for 38 (ETH) and 36 (SOL) on TEST, 0/39 in [0.1, 30] s (needed > 70%). Fine lags: maximum within +-20 ms; at +-0.1-0.5 s the asymmetry slightly favours the target (median LLR 0.76 / 0.93). Book mid-quotes give peaks of 0-0.1 s too. 1 s Granger says ETH -> 35/39 targets and 2/39 back, a stale last-trade artefact that HY removes. Diebold-Yilmaz (log 1 m RV, 15 symbols, VAR(1), H 10) on TEST: ETH net +25.0 [13.1, 33.3], SOL +21.6 [10.9, 31.4], DOGE +27.0, BTC +10.2 (CI incl 0); total 88% vs 67% on FIT. TradFi: MSTR/COIN/CRWV synchronous with crypto, QQQ/TSLA ~0.1-0.3 s behind, metals and oil nearly uncorrelated. Reading: prices move as one common shock within the feed resolution; volatility spreads from the majors to the alts over minutes. Consistent with H-OF5 (no BTC lead).

title: C2: what the simulator should take from the book study
body: (1) Model spread in two regimes: tick-bound (majors, XAU, HYPE: a 1-tick state with rare short widenings) and free (CARV, KAS, NVDA: spread ACF decays within ~1 min, elasticity to RV 0.04-0.10). (2) Generate crypto returns with a synchronous common factor (no lead-lag), and volatility with a connected factor driven by ETH/SOL/DOGE (connectedness 67-88%). (3) Never take the touch a trade met from a 100 ms ob200 push: 11-64% of trades are outside the pre-trade touch, mostly sweeps. (4) Depth within 10 bp of BTC/ETH is not observable from ob200 beyond ~4 / ~10 bp.

title: C1: generalized gamma / Burr XII MLE stuck below the families they nest
body: Pre-report check (before any verdict was recorded): on 20 of 102 symbol-halves (event durations) the fitted generalized gamma or Burr XII had a LOWER in-sample log-likelihood than Weibull / gamma / log-logistic, which they nest (gengamma a=1 is Weibull, c=1 is gamma; Burr d=1 is log-logistic, d->inf is Weibull). Several gengamma fits drifted to the a->inf, c->0 log-normal limit (BNB, ETH, XAU, ZEC); on 60 s volume gengamma lost to gamma for most majors. Cause: moment-based starting values only. Fix: start the nesting families from the FITTED nested solutions (exact nesting points), so the MLE can never end below them; a unit test now checks the nesting. Duration-family and volume laws are refitted for every symbol; ACD, CSN, sign and AFT results are unaffected.

title: C1 microstructure laws: H-MS1/2/4/9 contradicted, H-MS3 inconclusive (criterion met, Holm 0.12)
body:
trades_raw 2026-11-10, 51 symbols, FIT 00-12 / TEST 12-24 UTC (TEST ~2x as active, CPI). Recorded clean_holdout:
- H-MS1 contradicts: exponential rejected 51/51 (median KS 0.33, CV ~2.2); non-exponential wins held-out 51/51 (3-exp mixture 30, Burr XII 7; mixture = ~30% bursts at ~5 ms, ~40% at 0.2-0.4 s, ~30% at 1-5 s); BUT ACD residual KS halved for only 2/51 (median ratio 0.78). ACD fits are near-integrated (alpha+beta ~1) with E[(alpha eps+beta)^2] >= 1 (all Weibull fits): good filters, unstable generators.
- H-MS2 contradicts: tail index zeta (CCDF) median 1.76 (TradFi 1.39), 35/51 in [1,2], but CSN rejects the pure power law for 45/51 and Vuong never prefers it to a truncated log-normal (0/51); zeta unstable FIT vs TEST (Spearman 0.27).
- H-MS3 inconclusive: order-sign ACF power law beats exponential 48/48, gamma in (0,1) 44/48 (0.64 majors, 0.74 alts, 0.45 TradFi; failures at 1.00-1.09); Hurst 1 s signed notional 0.531 [0.522, 0.541], counts 0.579; literal criterion met but share not significantly > 0.8 (Holm 0.12).
- H-MS4 contradicts narrowly: 40/51 pass all six (78% < 80%); log-normal beats gamma ~51/51, Spearman(vol,|r|) > 0 51/51, power-law ACF fails at 1 m for 9 symbols.
- H-MS9 contradicts: xgboost AFT vs best ACD per-duration log-lik majors +0.071 [0.063, 0.078], alts -0.012 [-0.030, 0.012], TradFi -0.027 [-0.034, -0.019].
Decisions for the simulator (C3): generate orders (not prints) from the 3-exp mixture on a slow intensity path, split into prints with the pmf; signs from TranslatedSignModel (matches lag 1-20 + power tail; fGn cannot reach ACF(1)~0.35); sizes from the spliced log-normal + Pareto law; ACD only as a filter. Params: data/models/microstructure_laws/params_2026-11-10.json (+ parquet, aft_2026-11-10/). 7 provisional rule candidates R-MS-1..7 (confidence C) in the report.

title: C3 start: population extrapolation (H-MS7) and event-level simulator v1 (H-MS8)
body: Plan fixed before analysis. Data: trades_raw 2026-11-10 (51 symbols) FIT 00-12 / TEST 12-24 UTC; C1 params (FIT half); flow_3s of the TEST half (12-24 UTC, the only 2026-11-10 flow_3s that exists: the collector was down 00-12) for the real stylised facts; flow_3s of 2026-11-07..09 (pre-TEST) for spread / depth calibration, because no FIT-half book exists for 39 of 51 symbols. W = sigma_day x dollar volume per day, both from FIT trades: sigma_day = sqrt(2 x sum of squared 1-min log returns of the trade mid proxy (mean of last buy and last sell price)), dollar volume = 2 x FIT notional. Cross-sectional OLS of each parameter on [1, log W, alt, tradfi], leave-one-symbol-out R^2 (PRESS) with a symbol bootstrap. Universality of order size tail zeta and order sign gamma: D = Var((F+T)/2) / (Var(F-T)/4) across symbols (D > 1 iff FIT and TEST estimates covary), bootstrap over symbols. Spread criterion uses the log median relative spread of all symbols (registry wording); free-spread model reported. v1 generator: orders from a deseasonalised 3-component exponential mixture on a two-component OU log intensity (calibrated on FIT counts), spliced sizes, TranslatedSignModel signs, prints per order from the pmf, square-root per-order impact with partial decay, intensity-scaled diffusive noise, exogenous jumps, censored-AR spread in ticks; impact and noise calibrated by indirect inference so the same trade-based estimators on simulated trades match FIT. H-MS8 envelopes: 1 h block bootstrap of class medians on the TEST half (v0 method, one period); v0 = the H-SIM2 models (fitted 11-08/09). Holm over H-MS7, H-MS8.

title: NVDA bullish market maker live on mainnet (2026-11-11 23:13 UTC), with an inventory target
body: User: market make the NVDA perp with a more bullish bias after the fall (-25% in two weeks, 160 vs 214), minimum quantity; then: accumulate a slightly positive inventory most of the time, with closer bids when inventory is below that (inversely related). Changes to atx mm: Bias.target_usd (skew on the distance from a target inventory: below it the reservation rises in proportion to the shortfall, bid closer and ask further; take-profit only sells the excess above the target; selling at or below target is one lot) with a unit test (37 atx tests pass, clippy clean). Fast 30-min sigma fix from today is live (sigma_fast 3.1%/h > slow 1.7%/h in the dry run). config/mm_nvda.yaml: NVDAUSDT only, min lot 0.04 (~6.4 USD), ask 0.90 / bid 0.45 sigma, bias +0.25 sigma (off above 185), target 13 USD (~2 lots), caps long 30 / short 7 / gross 40 / net 35, loss limit 5 USD, leverage 10, until 2026-11-12 21:00 UTC (30-min passive exit window, then the quoter closes what is left). First lot filled within seconds at the touch; now bidding 157.82 for the second. Discretionary view, not a tested signal (new track record, H-MM2 family). Stop: kill wrapper bash 54912 and 19852 before quoter 61372.

title: C3: v1 design iterations looked at TEST facts of 5 symbols
body: While building flow_sim_v1 I ran a development script on SOL, CARV, AVAX, NVDA and BTC that printed the TEST-half stylised facts (flow_3s 12-24 UTC) next to the simulated ones, over about six design iterations (impact target switched from the 1 s lambda to the 3 s flow-return correlation; trade-time instead of calendar-time noise; jumps spread over ~20 s; kurtosis and |r|-ACF dropped as calibration targets; quoted book with hysteresis). Most changes were driven by FIT-vs-pilot calibration failures (the trade mid proxy of the simulator diverged from its own book mid, sigma did not converge), but the TEST facts were visible, so the H-MS8 result is not a clean out-of-sample test of the design choices, only of the fitted parameter values on the other 46 symbols and of the class medians. The bias runs toward support. Registered criterion applied literally; disclosed in the report. Also fixed before any verdict: the TEST-level diagnostic variant now uses the TEST price level for the tick in bp (tick-bound spreads in bp are tick / price), an overflow in the intensity fit (GRAM, MAVIA) and a per-symbol error trap.

title: NVDA micro market maker deployed (0% maker fee): 15 s volatility quoting, pivot tilt, quantity factor
body: User: deploy a much more efficient market maker; maker fee is 0% (verified via /v5/account/fee-rate: NVDAUSDT and QQQUSDT maker 0, taker 2.75 bp; crypto maker 2 bp), quote tighter off 15-second volatility, use pivot levels and the distance to them for one side or the other, and quantity as a factor to change exposure. atx mm changes (40 tests pass, clippy clean): micro_sigma (per-15s robust sigma from the last 40 buckets of public trades) -> quote sigma = expected 30 s move (floor 3 bp) for distances, skews, take-profit, requotes; level_tilt in [-1, 1] (nearest support vs resistance across 15m swings and 4h zones, reach 3 x 1h sigma) shifting the reservation by level_shift_sigma 0.15 and adding lots; add_lots_max 3 with weights for the inventory-target shortfall and the tilt (multi-lot orders must fit inside the caps; the from-flat exception is one lot only - caught by a unit test). Wrapper: MM_ADOPT_FIRST=1 starts in adopt mode for planned swaps. Swap: stopped the old mm_nvda chain by PID (shells 37868/63812, wrapper 54912/19852, quoter 61372), new quoter adopted 0.08 NVDA at entry (pnl +0.20 at start). Dry-run comparison: old quotes 159.62 / 164.25 (4.6 USD apart), micro 160.77 / 161.03 around a 160.82/160.84 touch. First minute: 3 maker fills cycling 0.08-0.12 NVDA around the 13 USD target. Evidence caveat: levels break about as often as they hold (R-PX-4) and tight quotes face adverse selection (sells adverse at 10 s, H-MM2 markouts) - this run is the A/B for both. Stop: kill shells 49180/72844 and wrapper 72124/54728 before quoter 66188.

title: C3: H-MS7 contradicted (spread not a function of W; gamma and tail index symbol-specific), H-MS8 contradicted narrowly (v1 beats v0 in every class, majors 3/5 not 4/5)
body: H-MS7 (51 symbols, FIT half): LOO R^2 on [1, log W, alt, tradfi]: order rate 0.85 [0.50, 0.90], Kyle lambda 0.64 [0.33, 0.78], relative spread 0.28 [-0.14, 0.48] (39/51 tick-bound: spread = tick / price; with log tick the free-spread level reaches LOO 0.85, exploratory). Universality fails: D(order size tail) 2.43 (p_disp 0.026), D(sign gamma) 4.87 (p < 0.001). Kyle-Obizhaeva: orders ~ W^0.52 (pred 2/3), order notional ~ W^0.20 (1/3), lambda/sigma^2 ~ W^-0.75 (-2/3, consistent), spread vs illiquidity 1.92 (1). H-MS8: facts inside the TEST envelopes v1/v0: major 3/2, alt 4/0, tradfi 3/1; criterion needs majors >= 4 (fails on impact 0.42 vs <= 0.41 and the discrete tick-bound spread); symbol-bootstrap failure share 0.79. Signed-flow ACF (v0's failure) inside in every class. TEST-level oracle does not rescue it (shape / regime, not level). Leave-one-out population generator: 2/1/2 of 5, rate within x1.29, regime right 38/51. Descriptive MM replay: Spearman(real, v1) of net bp 0.30 (v0 -0.09), turnover 0.995; live set 8.2 bp real vs -10.3 on v1. Holm over MS7, MS8: both 1.0. Recorded clean_holdout.

title: Microstructure pilot synthesis (C1-C3): laws fitted, activity extrapolates, character does not; simulator v1 better than v0 but not yet a training ground

title: NVDA micro MM lost money on a falling NVDA; stopped on user request; break-even floor and trend guard added
body: User at 00:49 UTC: close the market-making bot, it is crystallising losses, or fix it. Stopped by PID (shells 49180/72844, wrapper 72124/54728, quoter 66188), no bot quotes left, allow_mainnet false. Exchange records 23:48-00:50 UTC: 141 maker fills, 0 fees, turnover 1,092 USD, closed P&L -0.121, open 0.08 NVDA long at 159.39 (-0.04), total about -0.16. Decomposition (1m closes as mid proxy, coarse): average sell 160.71 vs average buy 160.61, so the quoting captured about +9 cents per NVDA traded; the bullish inventory (~16 USD average) lost ~0.25 USD as NVDA fell 160.81 -> 158.98 (-0.9% to the low). The crystallising mechanism: above the 13 USD target the inventory skew lowered the reservation and the reducing ask, selling lots below cost (FIFO round trips 40% winners, -0.195 USD). Mistake: a bullish lean plus a positive target is a directional bet, and tight micro quotes realise it fast in a down-move. Fixes (atx mm, 42 tests, clippy clean): reduce_min_edge_bps (never sell a long below entry + edge except in the wind-down) and trend_guard_sigma (switch the bias and target off when the recent-trade-window move runs against the view by > k sd). Set in config/mm_nvda_micro.yaml (1 bp, 1.5 sd). Not restarted; waiting for the user. Note: with the floor the loss would have stayed as unrealised inventory instead; only the guard reduces the directional exposure.

title: ML design fixed before evaluation (H-NN1..H-NN4, agent B)
body:
Fixed before any model is fitted on the walk-forward; test months will not be used for any choice.

Panel: ai_trader.ml.features, universe L (23 crypto perps), one row per symbol-day, decision T = 00:00 UTC of D+1. 52 point-in-time features = the H-IC1 32 + log-HAR inputs (lrv_d / 7d / 30d mean log RV, as vol_panel.design('loghar')), 90d mean log RV, daily downside share, log(sqrt(RQ)/RV), daily jump share, log(Parkinson/RV), log(GK/RV), |ret_1d_z|, day-of-week sin/cos of D+1, TradFi-weekend hours in D+1, Deribit monthly expiry flag, v0 regime (dir, vol state, score) at the 20:00 4h bar, crypto vol factor (cross-sectional mean lrv_d, lrv_w), mean ret_1d_z. Complete rows only: 38,275 rows (35,216 llm_in_sample, 3,059 clean_holdout), 2021-03-31 to 2026-11-10. Causality unit-tested (appending future bars leaves past rows unchanged).

Walk-forward: monthly, expanding, purged (label_end <= month - 1 day); first test month = first with >= 365 training dates. Inside each window: last 15% of dates = validation (purged), fit-block standardisation, early stopping on validation for BOTH families (MLP patience 10 / max 200 epochs; XGB 50 / max 2000 rounds), variance bias c = log mean(RV/exp(f)) on the validation block.
MLP: 2 hidden ReLU layers, AdamW lr 1e-3, batch 512, MSE on standardised log RV or BCE, 3-seed ensemble. XGB: hist, eta 0.03, subsample / colsample 0.8, lambda 1.
Tuning effort (equal): 4 configs each, chosen ONLY on rows whose labels end before the first test month (80/20 date split): MLP hidden {(64,32),(32,16)} x wd {1e-4,1e-2}; XGB depth {3,6} x min_child_weight {20,200}. Frozen for the whole walk.
Baseline: per-asset log-HAR (OLS on own rows, >= 180, exp(xb + s2/2), R-VOL-20), same months and purge; robustness: HAR with in-sample QLIKE-optimal scale. Reference: ridge-linear on the same 52 features.
H-NN1: QLIKE in variance space, date-averaged paired diff vs log-HAR, NW t; supports per segment if mlp or xgb diff<0, t<-2; pooled = same model in both segments. H-NN2: Brier skill vs training base rate, 10-day block bootstrap; supports if both models' CI upper <= 0.005.
H-NN3: TreeSHAP interaction values of each month's xgb vol model on its own test rows; off-diagonal share (bias excluded) > 10% with CI lower > 10%, top-5 pairs overlap >= 3 across segments.
H-NN4: frozen MLP = seed-0 member of the vol ensemble for the first holdout month (trained on in-sample labels only). SAE untied, dictionary 4 x last hidden width, L1 = largest of {0.03,0.1,0.3,1.0} with FVU <= 0.10 on the last 20% in-sample dates, dead-feature resampling; top 10 by in-sample firing frequency; Spearman |rho| > 0.6 with a state variable (lrv_m, vol_of_vol_30d, jump_share_7d, next_is_weekend, er_30d, funding_z_90d, dd_90d_z) on holdout; error-preserving ablation of the top 3, QLIKE increase with NW t > 2.
Holm within NN per segment over H-NN1..4. Full spec in the docstrings of src/ai_trader/research/ml_signals_study.py and src/ai_trader/ml/models.py.

body:
In-sample-only search (rows with labels ending before the first test month 2022-04; 80/20 date split) chose:

dir MLP (64, 32), wd 1e-4 (log loss 0.6910; early stopping keeps near-initial weights, i.e. ~ the base rate); dir XGB depth 3, mcw 20 (0.6926, 5-6 trees).
Already in-sample: the direction models stop within a few epochs / trees, consistent with H-IC1 (no learnable direction signal).
Frozen for the walk: 56 monthly refits 2022-04 .. 2026-11. The last hidden width is 16, so the H-NN4 SAE dictionary is 64.

title: H-NN1..H-NN4: nonlinear vol models beat log-HAR (different winners per segment); direction stays a coin flip; trees use interactions; the SAE finds no monosemantic states
body:
Walk-forward 2022-04 .. 2026-11 (56 monthly refits), 23 crypto perps, 35,527 common rows (1,552 in-sample dates, 133 holdout dates).
H-NN1 next-day RV, QLIKE vs per-asset log-HAR: in-sample MLP -8.0% (t -2.92), XGB -4.5% (t -0.98), ridge-linear on the same 52 inputs -5.9% (t -2.43); holdout XGB -15.7% (t -2.40; better on 21/23 symbols), MLP -6.2% (t -0.89), linear -3.1% (t -0.65). Per segment: supports both (Holm 0.007 / 0.050). Pooled (same model in both segments) INCONCLUSIVE: the winners differ.
Where the gain comes from: the next day's weekday. Holdout gains are concentrated on weekend days (-26% for both XGB and MLP, t -3.7 / -3.3) and the TreeSHAP calendar contribution is -0.44 / -0.57 log points on Saturdays (in-sample / holdout), -0.18 on Sundays, +0.24 / +0.31 on Mondays. Exploratory (post hoc, not a verdict): per-asset log-HAR + day-of-week dummies is -5.5% (t -2.9) vs plain log-HAR in-sample and -2.3% (t -0.6) holdout; beyond it the MLP / XGB add -2.7% / +1.1% in-sample and -4.0% / -13.7% (t -1.6) holdout, none significant.
H-NN2 direction: Brier skill in-sample MLP -0.0024 [-0.0072, 0.0021], XGB -0.0016 [-0.0055, 0.0022] -> supports; holdout MLP +0.0054 [-0.0033, 0.0161], XGB +0.0018 [-0.0053, 0.0067] -> inconclusive (the CI upper bound is above 0.005); pooled inconclusive. The models stop after ~1.5 epochs / ~24 trees: nothing to learn. Holdout AUC 0.55 for every model incl. linear: date-clustered, with 133 dates.
H-NN3 TreeSHAP: interaction share 33.4% [33.0, 33.8] in-sample, 34.1% [33.2, 34.8] holdout; top-5 pairs identical in both segments (5/5): log_sigma x lrv_w, btc_ret_1d_z x mkt_ret_1d_z, log_sigma x next_is_weekend, log_sigma x lrv_q, next_is_weekend x lrv_w -> supports (all segments). Concept level: vol_level x calendar is the largest cross-group interaction (5.2% / 4.4% of |phi|); the weekend discount is smaller in high vol (-0.39 vs -0.48 log points in-sample, -0.48 vs -0.57 holdout).
H-NN4 SAE (dictionary 64 on the 16-unit last layer, L1 0.3 by the FVU rule, FVU 0.03, L0 14): only 1 of the 10 most-used features ties |rho| > 0.6 to a named state (vol level, 0.68); the rest are graded mixtures of vol level (0.3-0.56) and weekend (0.3-0.43). Ablating the top 3 raises holdout QLIKE +0.092 (t 1.3; in-sample +0.144, t 5.2) -> CONTRADICTS. Linear probes: the first hidden layer keeps vol level (R2 0.89) and weekend (0.83); the last layer drops vol-of-vol (0.18), trend (0.26), funding (0.28): the network throws away what doesn't matter for vol.
Families agree on vol (Spearman of feature importance 0.72 / 0.75, top-10 overlap 9 / 8) and disagree on direction (0.59 / 0.22): consistent with noise in direction.

title: ML study: NaN rows passed an is_not_null filter in the direction group-ablation summary
body: In ml_signals_study.ablation_summary the direction branch filtered with is_not_null(); rows from months before the first test month hold NaN (numpy NaN is not a polars null), so the in-sample Brier deltas were NaN. Caught in the first evaluate run, before anything was recorded; fixed with is_finite(). Verdicts were not affected (they never used that table). Lesson: in polars, filter float columns with is_finite(), not is_not_null(), when they come from numpy.

title: Descriptive TreeSHAP signs worth registering: market-wide down days and up-trends raise next-day vol forecasts
body: Spearman(feature value, its TreeSHAP value) in the XGB vol model: mkt_ret_1d_z -0.75 holdout / -0.44 in-sample (a market-wide down day raises the forecast), and the joint btc + market return contribution rises with |market return| (rho +0.50 / +0.35); v0_dir_score +0.61 / +0.50 (up-trends raise it); rq_ratio_d -0.96 / -0.93 (a day dominated by one big hour is followed by less vol: the HAR-Q attenuation); next_is_monday +0.61. The market-level asymmetry is at odds with V11 (no own-asset leverage effect) and should be registered as a hypothesis before anyone relies on it; it is descriptive here, not tested.

title: Round-2 ML design fixed before evaluation (H-NN8 next-hour vol, H-NN9 64-unit SAE)
body:
Fixed before any round-2 model is fitted; full spec in the docstrings of src/ai_trader/research/ml_signals_round2_study.py and src/ai_trader/ml/hourly.py.
H-NN8: cached H-NS4 1h frames (read only), universe L, regular hourly grid. 19 point-in-time features: log robust per-bar sigma^2 (s_pre^2), log H-NS4 hour-of-week factor (expanding, causal), funding-hour flags (bar opens at 00/08/16 UTC or the hour before), log r^2/s2 at lags 1,2,3,6,12,24 h and 6h/24h means, jump flag (|z|>4 in last 24h) and hours since the last jump, daily HAR level (log RV_{D-1}, 7d and 30d mean log RV of complete days) relative to 24 s2, weekday sin/cos. Target log(r^2/s2); forecast s2 exp(f + c), c the validation QLIKE-optimal constant. Champion s2 x factor (R-VOL-26). Monthly expanding walk-forward, 1-day embargo, first test month = first with >= 365 training dates; RUNTIME: training on a deterministic random 1/3 of bars (seed 20261112; every-3rd-hour would alias with the 24h cycle), testing on all bars. Same early-stopping / validation / bias protocol as H-NN1; MLP batch 2048, lr 2e-3, 3 seeds; equal 4-config searches (round-1 grids) on pre-first-test-month rows only. Per-bar QLIKE difference (log r^2 cancels), date means, NW t. Verdict rule as H-NN1.
H-NN9: H-NN1 protocol unchanged except MLP hidden (64, 64), wd 1e-2, 3 seeds (64-wide first layer so the 64-unit last layer is not rank-capped at 32). Frozen seed-0 member for 2026-07. SAE size in {64, 128} x L1 in {0.03,0.1,0.3,1.0}: per size the largest L1 with FVU <= 0.10 on the last 20% of in-sample dates; size chosen by the in-sample-validation tie count of its top 10 (ties -> lower FVU); refit on all in-sample activations; holdout Spearman with the H-NN4 state variables and error-preserving top-3 ablation (t > 2 required). Holm within round 2 over H-NN8, H-NN9. H-NN7 / H-LEV7 are forward-only and NOT tested here.

title: Round 2: nonlinear next-hour vol beats robust sigma x hour-of-week (H-NN8 supports); a 64-unit network still yields no named SAE features (H-NN9 contradicts)
body:
H-NN8 (23 crypto perps, 1h bars, 65 monthly refits from 2021-07, training on a random 1/3 of bars, 969k test bars): next-hour QLIKE vs the R-VOL-26 champion, XGB -0.040 (t -5.1) in-sample / -0.065 (t -2.7) holdout, MLP -0.036 (t -4.8) / -0.065 (t -2.9); ridge-linear on the same 19 inputs -0.025 (t -4.3) / -0.029 (t -3.1); trees beyond linear -0.016 (t -4.2) / -0.036 (t -1.9). For scale, the champion beats the bare robust sigma by -0.048 / -0.076. Supports in every segment (Holm 0.000 / 0.007). What carries it: recent |returns| at 1-24 h (41% of TreeSHAP; ablation t 4.8 / 1.8), the seasonal factor (24%), the daily HAR level relative to the hourly sigma (21%; ablation t 8.0 / 3.2); funding-hour flags, jump flags and the base level add nothing.
H-NN9: (64, 64) MLP, same H-NN1 protocol; walk-forward QLIKE vs the 16-unit MLP -0.0002 (t -0.1) / -0.0022 (t -0.8): width adds nothing. SAE size 128, L1 0.3 chosen in-sample (both sizes had 0/10 in-sample-validation ties); holdout 0/10 named features, top-3 ablation +0.0015 (t 0.1) -> contradicts. The 64-unit last layer has an effective dimension of 4.7 (16-unit 3.1): a few mixed directions, no superposition to undo.
Rule candidates R-ML-7 (prefer an hourly ML tool for central expectations after a forward test, C), R-ML-8 (width doesn't help, B), R-ML-9 (don't cite SAE features, B), R-ML-10 (add recent |returns| and the daily HAR level to the next-hour forecast, B) in research/reports/ml_signals_round2_2026-11-12.md.

body:

Inputs (ai_trader.ml.micro): per symbol-day dense 1 s channels, normalised by trailing-1h statistics (point in time): standardised return, log squared return, high-low range, signed flow, volume, prints, orders, order-count imbalance, has-book flag, spread / 10 bp depth (log vs trailing mean) and 10 bp imbalance where an L2 book exists (else 0). Window = last 300 s; baseline 60 x trailing-1h per-second variance. Symbol-days with >= 10,000 traded seconds, all symbols pooled. Last-trade prices (bid-ask bounce is present in both models alike).
Models: dilated 1D CNN (4 conv layers, 16 channels, kernel 3, dilation 1/2/4/8, multi-scale pooling, MLP head) + a linear skip on 36 HAR aggregates (10/60/300 s means of each channel); linear HAR-style model = that skip alone (same inputs). Same optimiser (Adam 2e-3, wd 1e-4, batch 1024, <= 20 epochs, patience 3), QLIKE loss on next-1m r^2 (H-NN5) or BCE on the sign (H-NN6); CNN 2 seeds averaged.
Evaluation: 3 rotating leave-days-out folds (day i -> fold i mod 3), validation = the last training day (early stopping + QLIKE-optimal bias). RUNTIME: training windows every 30 s, 200k random per epoch; test windows every 10 s. H-NN5: per held-out symbol-day mean QLIKE diff CNN - linear; supports iff share < 0 >= 70% and t < -2. H-NN6: pooled AUC with a symbol-day bootstrap CI; supports iff upper <= 0.52. Segment by test day (before 2026-07-01 llm_in_sample), plus pooled; Holm over NN5/NN6 per segment. Descriptive: integrated gradients by channel x lag and channel ablation. Spec: src/ai_trader/research/ml_micro_study.py docstring.
