title: H-MINE1 effect family declared (1884 effects) before any statistic
body:
Effect family of H-MINE1, declared in src/ai_trader/research/micro_mining.py (effect_family) BEFORE any effect statistic is computed. Only coverage counts and a smoke build of 2026-11-10 (no target-by-state statistic) were looked at.

**States (point in time, within the symbol-day, past-only mid-rank among the day's earlier minutes, warm-up 60 past values):**
- flow_q: quintile of the minute's notional imbalance (buy - sell) / (buy + sell); in T5 the imbalance over the last 5 minutes.
- vol_t: tercile of log RV (5 s last-trade returns) over the last 15 minutes (T1) or 30 minutes (T5).
- spread (L2 symbols only): free if the minute's time-average spread is > 1.5 ticks (tick = laws/<SYM>.json tick), else tick-bound.
- hour block (UTC, fixed): 0 = 00-06, 1 = 06-12, 2 = 12-16, 3 = 16-24.
- cls: major / alt / tradfi (microstructure_laws_study.asset_class).
- leaders: BTC / ETH / SOL flow_q and vol_t of the same minute (for alts).

**Targets:** next-1m and next-5m |return| (a1, a5; vol) and signed return (s1, s5; direction), from last-trade minute closes. They are normalised over the symbol-day's analysis rows (|r| / mean |r|, r / sd r) and demeaned within the symbol-day, so an effect = mean target in a cell minus the symbol-day mean (or a contrast of two cells).

**Family: 1884 effects (942 vol, 942 direction).**
- F1 (720): cls x flow_q x vol_t x hour cells, 4 targets.
- F2 (144): flow Q5 - Q1 contrast within cls x vol_t x hour, 4 targets.
- F3 (120): L2 symbols, spread x flow_q x vol_t cells, 4 targets.
- F3c (60): free - tick contrast within flow_q x vol_t, 4 targets.
- F4a (180): alts, leader (BTC / ETH / SOL) flow_q x vol_t cells, 4 targets.
- F4b (300): alts, leader flow_q x own flow_q, 4 targets.
- F5 (360): 5-minute table, cls x flow_q(5 m) x vol_t(30 m) x hour, targets a5 and s5.

**Inclusion and inference:**
- A symbol-day enters if >= 75% of its minutes have a print.
- A day-cell estimate needs >= 30 rows, pooled over the day's symbols.
- Each effect has one estimate per day (day-clustered); t-test over days, df = D - 1, two-sided.
- An effect is testable on discovery if >= 10 of the 16 days give an estimate. Untestable effects get p = 1 and stay in the family.
- Benjamini-Hochberg at FDR 10% over all 1884 effects.

**Confirmation (fixed now):**
- Each discovery is tested once on the batch 4-6 days (the 15 dates of H-MINE1), one-sided in its discovered sign, day-clustered t-test, p < 0.05.
- It needs >= 5 confirmation days with an estimate (pooled). One that can't be tested counts as not replicated.
- Replication rate = replicated / discoveries, overall and split vol vs direction.
- Success (H-MINE1): rate >= 50% and vol rate > direction rate, recorded once, segment pooled. In-sample and holdout confirmation-day splits are reported alongside.
- Code wall: load_days / build_day raise on a confirmation date while data/research/mining/discoveries_frozen.json is missing.

**Known caveat:** last-trade returns carry bid-ask bounce, so flow-conditioned direction effects (reversal after one-sided minutes) are partly mechanical.

title: H-MINE1 discovery list frozen
H-DS1-3 design fixed before evaluation: lattices, k-means codebooks, honest trees, EB cells
body:
Design of the H-DS1-3 test, fixed before any discretised forecast was evaluated (agent C). Code: src/ai_trader/ml/discretize.py, src/ai_trader/research/discrete_states_study.py (full spec in the docstring); tests/test_discretize.py.

Panel and protocol = H-NN1: universe L, 52 point-in-time features, complete rows, expanding monthly refits from 2022-04 with purge + embargo. Baseline = the same per-asset log-HAR (re-fitted per month with the identical code path, checked against wf_preds.F_har); the XGB reference forecasts are read from H-NN1's wf_preds.parquet so the XGB gain is the exact H-NN1 number on the same rows.

Cell value: EB-shrunk mean of u - mean(u), u = log(RV_{D+1} / HAR fitted value) on the refit's training rows; date-clustered variances, one pooled kappa per refit and discretisation (moment estimator tau2, kappa = sigma2/tau2), shrink toward 0 (= plain HAR). Forecast = HAR x exp(cell value). Centring keeps HAR's overall calibration (mean log ratio is about -s^2/2 by construction).

Fixed discretisations (training-only fits, <= 64 cells):
- WD7: forecast weekday (7) - calendar-only reference.
- V0: v0 direction x v0 vol (9) - baseline.
- LAT1: weekday group {Mon, Tue-Fri, Sat, Sun} x vol_pct_1y terciles x v0 direction {down, range, up} (36).
- LAT2: weekday group x lrv_w terciles (pooled 7d level) x mkt_ret_1d_z terciles (36).
- LAT3: weekday (7) x vol_pct_1y terciles x v0 direction (63).
- KM8/16/32/64: k-means on the top-10 in-sample H-NN3 TreeSHAP main effects (log_sigma, lrv_w, lrv_q, next_is_weekend, dow_sin, lrv_m, next_wk_hours, lrv_d, rq_ratio_d, v0_dir_score) + dow_cos, training-standardised, k-means++, 3 inits, seed 0.
- HT3/HT6: honest regression trees of u on the 52 features + weekday, depth 3/6, min leaf max(150, 1% of split half); split half = alternating calendar weeks, leaf values from the other half.
Direction (H-DS3): same partitions, vol trees replaced by HT3r/HT6r grown on winsorised (+-5) ret_next_z; p = training base rate + EB-shrunk cell deviation.

Selection: the best vol discretisation is the lowest walk-forward llm_in_sample QLIKE; the best direction discretisation is the highest in-sample Brier skill. Both are then read in the holdout (no holdout selection). H-DS2/H-DS3 orderings use the frozen partition of the 2026-07 refit (training labels end before the cutoff), with OOS-HAR residuals, cells with >= 30 rows in both segments, 10-day date-block bootstrap within segments.
Verdict rules: DS1 per segment supports iff share >= 0.8 and t < -2, contradicts if diff >= 0 or share CI upper < 0.8; pooled = both. DS2 supports iff rho > 0.8 and CI lower > 0.6, contradicts if rho <= 0.6 or CI upper <= 0.8. DS3 (null) pooled supports iff ordering rho <= 0.3 and holdout skill <= 0, contradicts if rho CI lower > 0.3 or holdout skill CI lower > 0. Holm over the three DS p-values. Caveat known in advance: the TreeSHAP-ranked input list for KM was computed on all in-sample walk-forward rows, so early in-sample months carry mild feature-selection look-ahead; the holdout is clean.

title: H-MINE1 discovery-day descriptives: vol tercile and hour dominate; BTC flow leads alts by a minute
body:
Discovery days only (16), descriptive, after the freeze.

**Vol structure is carried by recent vol and the hour.**
- Next-1m |r| vs the symbol-day mean is -24% / -9% / +28% across the 15-min vol terciles.
- By hour block: 12-16 UTC is +25%; 00-06 and 06-12 are -11% and -13%.
- The vol tercile persists from one minute to the next 92% of the time.

**Extreme-flow minutes are quiet.** Next-1m |r| is about -9% after both the Q1 and Q5 flow minutes and +5 to +7% after Q2-Q4. A one-sided minute is usually a thin minute.

**Direction (sd units):**
- Alts' next-1m return rises with BTC's same-minute flow: -0.019 (Q1) to +0.028 (Q5). This is a 1-minute catch-up that the sub-second HY lead-lag missed. At 5 minutes it has gone.
- TradFi perps show own-flow continuation (Q1 -0.028, Q5 +0.025).
- Crypto shows nothing monotone in own flow.

**Placebo.** 500 joint sign flips of the day estimates (same flip for every effect, which keeps the cross-effect dependence) give a mean of 1.6 BH rejections, zero in 95% of draws, against 550 real ones (67 direction). The discovery count is not an artefact of the dependence between effects.

title: Sparsity design fixed before evaluation (H-SP1-3)
H-DS3 ordering read float residue of fully-shrunk cells as signal (fixed before recording)
body: In the first evaluation pass, when the empirical-Bayes between-cell variance tau2 was 0 (no detectable between-cell spread in next-day returns, which is the case for most partitions), the weights n/(n+1e12) were about 1e-12 rather than exactly 0. Spearman then ranked the residue (proportional to n_c x m_c) and reported spurious return-ordering correlations of 0.4-0.8 for the k-means codebooks. Fix: with tau2 = 0 every cell value is exactly 0 (discretize.eb_shrink), and the cross-segment ordering is defined as rho = 0 (no ordering). This changes the H-DS3 ordering of the in-sample-best direction cells (KM64) from 0.42 to 0.00. The DS3 verdict was inconclusive under both versions, because the holdout Brier skill point is above 0 (+0.0048, CI [-0.0002, 0.0087]). Nothing had been recorded yet. The walk-forward forecasts were produced before the fix; the effect on them is below 1e-8 relative. A second issue, noted but not changed because the design is fixed: percentile bootstrap CIs of a Spearman between two noisy cell tables are biased toward 0 (bootstrap median below the point). Fisher-z intervals are reported alongside for reference, and no verdict depends on the difference.

title: H-SP2 stability selection: no single feature is stable; vol-level and weekend clusters are
body:
Randomised-lasso stability selection, 236-column library, 200 date-half subsamples per segment, pi_thr 0.8, q_max = sqrt(0.6 p) = 11.9. The region gives q_hat 11.6 / 11.3 and PFER bounds 0.95 / 0.91.

Result: 0 features selected in llm_in_sample and 0 in clean_holdout. By the pre-registered rule (|S| = 0 counts as contradicts) this contradicts in both segments and pooled.

Highest single-feature probabilities:
- in-sample: Saturday dummy 0.72, lrv_w 0.71, log_sigma 0.67, lrv_q 0.60, lrv_d 0.50;
- holdout: lrv_w 0.55, lrv_d lag 13 0.53, log_sigma 0.51.

The reason is substitution. The vol-level measures (7d / 30d / 90d mean log RV, robust sigma, lagged daily log RV) are near-collinear, so each subsample picks a different one and no single column reaches 0.8.

EXPLORATORY, post hoc (added after seeing that nothing was selected): single-linkage clusters of columns with |rho| >= 0.8, re-run with the identical seed (probabilities identical to the registered run). Probability that a cluster is selected:
- vol-level cluster (log_sigma, lrv_d/w/m/q, lrv_d lags 2-4): 1.00 in-sample, 0.99 holdout;
- weekend-calendar cluster (next_is_weekend, dow_sin, TradFi-weekend hours, their products): 0.99 / 0.75;
- 7d efficiency ratio er_7d: 0.88 / 0.40.

So the stable minimal input set is one vol-level measure in both segments, plus the weekend flag in-sample. Everything else in the library (lags, logs, products, quantile dummies, funding, jumps) is never stable.

title: H-DS1-3: 36 weekday x vol x trend cells give -6.0% / -7.4% QLIKE vs log-HAR; all three inconclusive
body:
Walk-forward 2022-04..2026-11 (56 monthly refits), universe L, 35,527 common rows. The HAR replication matches H-NN1 exactly.
H-DS1 (inconclusive in all segments): the best discretisation chosen in-sample is LAT1 (weekday group x own-vol tercile x v0 direction, 36 cells). QLIKE vs log-HAR -6.0% (t -3.01) in-sample and -7.4% (t -2.13) holdout. Share of the XGB gain: 1.34 in-sample, where the XGB gain itself is not significant (t -0.98), and 0.47 [0.17, 1.02] in the holdout. Nine of 11 discretisations pass the bar in-sample, none in the holdout. The shortfall is on weekends: holdout weekend -15.8% for the cells vs -26.4% for XGB. In-sample LAT1 met the per-segment criterion before Holm; Holm (p driven by the holdout share) downgraded it.
H-DS2 (inconclusive): frozen LAT1 cell ordering Spearman 0.76 (bootstrap [0.46, 0.88], Fisher [0.55, 0.88]) over 30 cells.
H-DS3 (inconclusive): direction cells carry nothing. For most partitions the EB between-cell variance of returns is 0; the in-sample-best KM64 has holdout Brier skill +0.0048 [-0.0002, 0.0087] and return ordering rho 0.
Cell table (raw material for rules), relative to log-HAR in-sample / holdout:
- Saturday with v0 range or down: -49% / -58%.
- Saturday in an up-trend: -28% / +10% (unstable).
- Sunday: -10% / -7%.
- Monday: +45% / +25%.
- Tue-Fri up-trend: +20% / +28%.
- Tue-Fri range: +1% / +8%.
The weekday is the main state and the v0 trend the second; the vol tercile matters little once HAR carries the level. Rule candidates R-DS-1..6 are in the report; the merged groups are post hoc and should be registered before promotion.

title: Agent C done: discretised states recover about half of the nonlinear vol gain; weekday x trend cells; H-DS4 forward registered
body: H-DS1-3 inconclusive (7 rows). Best discretisation 36 cells (weekday group x own vol tercile x v0 trend): -6.0% QLIKE vs log-HAR in-sample (t -3.0), -7.4% holdout (t -2.1), 0.47 of the XGB holdout gain; cell ordering Spearman 0.76 across segments (bar 0.8); direction cells shrink to the base rate. Cell groups chosen after reading the table -> R-DS-1..6 merged capped at grade C / provisional, and H-DS4 registered (forward dates only) before any use.

title: Sparsity study: pre-walk-forward rows leaked into the direction metrics (NaN vs null)
body: sparsity_study.load_wf kept rows before the first test month (2021-03..2022-03) because their forecasts were NaN, and polars is_not_null() lets NaN through. Vol QLIKE was unaffected: non-finite losses are dropped per date. But the direction Brier skill came out NaN in-sample, and the in-sample row count was 35216 instead of 32766. Fixed by also filtering is_finite(), and re-evaluated before any verdict was recorded. After the fix the dense direction skill reproduces H-NN2 (-0.00237 vs -0.00238 reported). Lesson: filter on is_finite() as well whenever arrays are pre-filled with NaN.

title: Sparsity results: H-SP1 in-sample supports / holdout inconclusive; H-SP2 and H-SP3 contradict
body:
H-SP1 (lottery ticket, 56 refits x 3 seeds, full walk-forward). At 95.4% sparsity the network keeps 100 of 2192 weights, ~24 of 48 units and ~29 of 52 inputs. QLIKE ratio sparse/dense: 0.986 [0.964, 1.007] in-sample (supports, Holm p 0.006) and 0.974 [0.943, 1.027] holdout (inconclusive: CI upper above 1.02). Pooled inconclusive. The 95% network vs log-HAR: -9.3% (t -4.0) / -8.6% (t -1.6); dense was -8.0% / -6.2%. In-sample the curve breaks after ~97%: 1.026 at 98.4% (36 weights), 1.059 at 99.0% (21 weights). Input survival at 99%: log_sigma 94% and lrv_w 93% of networks; next_wk_hours, lrv_m, lrv_d, lrv_q and next_is_weekend 36-46%; funding/OI 0%.

Direction (descriptive): pruning does not collapse to the base rate (33 units at 95%, sd(p) 0.03), but in-sample skill stays ~0 (-0.0007 at 95%). The surviving inputs are market-wide day-level variables.

H-SP2: 0 / 0 stable features (contradicts). Vol-level columns substitute for each other; only clusters are stable (see the earlier entry).

H-SP3 (seed-0, 2026-07, 95%): 24 surviving units. 17/24 have holdout R^2 > 0.8 with an additive 2-input spline (bar 80%), so contradicts. Top-3 mean ablation: x1.45 [1.30, 1.61] in-sample, x1.37 [0.95, 1.97] holdout. Single-unit ablations change QLIKE by only -5%..+6%, so the circuit is redundant. Strongest units: L2u10 (7d log RV + Fri-Sun, R^2 0.94) and L2u3 (30d log RV + Fri-Sun, 0.92), calm-weekend dampers.

Rule candidates R-SP-1..4 (report). Holm within SP applied; no downgrades.

title: H-NN11 / H-NN12 design fixed (hourly TradFi vol ML + cross-asset block)
body:
Agent G. Design fixed BEFORE any H-NN11 / H-NN12 statistic was computed (panels built, no model fitted yet).
Code: src/ai_trader/ml/hourly_xasset.py, src/ai_trader/research/ml_hourly_xasset_study.py (docstring = full spec);
tests/test_ml_hourly_xasset.py (5 pass: leader block uses leader bars t-1 and earlier only, target's own copy excluded,
cash / CME flags correct across the 2026-03-08 and 2026-11-01 DST changes, early close, holiday).

Universe T: TradFi perps in the H-NS4 1h cache with >= 120 complete UTC days: XAU XAG CL BZ TSLA INTC GOOGL AAPL MSTR NVDA MU QQQ
SOXL PAXG XAUT (15); SPCX out (116 days). 62,000 complete rows (21,350 before the cutoff, almost all PAXG/XAUT + XAU/XAG/CL in
June; equities only have complete rows from mid-July because the hour-of-week factor needs 8 weeks). Universe L: the H-NN8
panel unchanged (992,814 rows, 23 symbols).

Features T: the 19 H-NN8 features + cash_sess (equities/ETFs: NYSE trading day, bars 09:00 ET .. last bar before the 16:00 /
13:00 close) + cme_sess (commodities incl. PAXG/XAUT: Sun 18:00 - Fri 17:00 ET, daily break 17-18 ET Mon-Thu; CME holidays not
modelled). No class dummy, no symbol id. Cross-asset block (H-NN12): for BTC, ETH, QQQ: log r^2/s2 at lags 1,2,3,6 h and the
1-6 h mean (leader's own base units), log robust variance, availability flag (21 cols); target's own copy -> missing; missing ->
training mean after standardisation.

Walk-forward: monthly expanding, purge + 1 day embargo, first test month = first with >= 365 distinct pooled training dates
(T: 2026-04, 8 refits; L: 2021-07, 65 refits as H-NN8). L trains on the H-NN8 1/3 subsample (same seed); T on all rows. Models
= frozen H-NN8 configs (MLP (64,32) wd 1e-2 batch 2048 lr 2e-3 x 3 seeds; XGB depth 3 mcw 200; ridge-linear reference); no new
search. Per refit: base and base+block fitted on identical rows (paired). Validation-block bias constant; F = s2 exp(f + c).
Loss: per-bar QLIKE diff, mean per UTC date, NW t; segments by bar open vs 2026-07-01.

Verdicts. H-NN11 (base models vs robust_bc x hour-of-week, universe T): per segment supports if mlp or xgb diff < 0 with t < -2;
contradicts if neither diff < 0 or the better has t > 2; else inconclusive; < 30 test dates -> inconclusive; pooled =
clean_holdout. H-NN12 (with - without block, same family): crypto component = L minus BTC/ETH, TradFi component = all of T;
llm_in_sample = crypto; clean_holdout = supports iff crypto and TradFi both support; pooled = same family supports crypto in
both segments AND TradFi supports in clean_holdout; contradicts if any required component contradicts. p = min over families
of 2 Phi(t); H-NN12 p = max over required components. Holm per segment over {H-NN11, H-NN12}.
Descriptive only: grouped TreeSHAP of the block XGB per target class (crypto_alt / btc / eth / equity / commodity /
gold_token), leader ablation per class, session-flag ablation, a replication check of our base L run against H-NN8's wf8.
Checkpoint per refit in data/models/ml/xasset/{T,L}/m_YYYY-MM.npz.

title: H-MINE2 effect family declared (495 effects) before any statistic
body:
Effect family of H-MINE2, declared in src/ai_trader/research/daily_mining.py (states, effect_family) and written to data/research/mining/daily_family.json BEFORE any target statistic is computed. Only feature-side counts (rows / dates per cell on llm_in_sample rows whose label exists) were computed; no target mean, SE or p-value.

**Panel:** universe-L daily complete rows (ai_trader.ml.features, the H-NN1 sample), decision at 00:00 UTC of D+1, point in time.

**Targets:** vr1 = log(RV_next / walk-forward per-asset log-HAR forecast of H-NN1) [vol]; r1 = next-day vol-scaled return, +-5 winsorised [return]; r5 = next-5-day vol-scaled return (5 consecutive days, sigma_D sqrt 5), +-5 winsorised, own segments (in-sample iff D+6 <= cutoff) [return].

**States (edges fitted on llm_in_sample rows only, frozen):** F1 terciles of the top-10 H-NN3 TreeSHAP features (log_sigma, lrv_w, lrv_q, next_is_weekend, dow_sin, lrv_m, next_wk_hours, lrv_d, rq_ratio_d, v0_dir_score) + top-bottom contrast; F2 quintiles of the top-3 + Q5-Q1; F3 all 10 pairs of terciles among the top-5; F4 forecast weekday; F5 v0 regime cell (9); F6 funding_z_90d tercile + contrast; F7 drawdown flag (dd_90d_z bottom fifth) + contrast; F8 BTC v0 trend x vol cell, alts only. Cells empty on discovery are not effects.

**Effect:** cell mean minus the population mean (or top-minus-bottom contrast). **Family size: 495 effects** (165 vol, 330 return; by target {'r1': 165, 'r5': 165, 'vr1': 165}); 495 testable (>= 100 rows on >= 30 dates per cell), the rest keep p = 1.
- F1: 117
- F2: 54
- F3: 228
- F4: 21
- F5: 27
- F6: 12
- F7: 9
- F8: 27

**Inference:** cluster-robust SE (influence function), clusters = 10-day calendar blocks, t with df = clusters touched - 1; date-clustered SE reported as secondary. BH at FDR 0.1 over the whole family on llm_in_sample.

**Confirmation (fixed now):** each frozen discovery once on clean_holdout with the frozen edges, one-sided in the discovered sign, p < 0.05 (10-day clusters), needs >= 20 rows per cell and >= 5 clusters (else not replicated). Verdict (pooled, once): supports iff rate >= 0.5 and vol rate > return rate; contradicts if rate < 0.5 or (both kinds discovered and vol rate <= return rate); inconclusive if rate >= 0.5 but one kind has no discoveries. Known-rule tags (KNOWN / known_tag) fixed in code now. Code wall: target_rows(clean_holdout) raises without data/research/mining/daily_discoveries_frozen.json.

title: H-PD6 exit-policy test: design fixed before evaluation
body:
Design of the H-PD6 test (agent I), fixed BEFORE any exit-policy result is computed. Module: ai_trader.research.exit_policy_study.

Trend family = the PD2 cluster F1 (pnl_decomposition_2026-11-11): tsmom, donchian_breakout, ema_stack, compression_breakout (1h)
and geo_struct, geo_pivot_bo, geo_flag_bo, zoo_ensemble (4h). compression_breakout is registry family 'volatility' but loads on
+TSMOM; it is in the primary family; a 7-strategy robustness row without it is reported.

Baseline = identical to the strategy panel: same frames (strategy_panel.frames_for, same as_of as the panel build,
2026-11-10T23:37:59Z), same signals (strategy_fn on the FULL history), same execution (evaluate.strategy_pnl: risk units,
rebalance band 0.2, 7.5 bps per side), same dating / warm-up / complete-date filter. The recomputed baseline is asserted
equal to the stored panel rows.

Trailing exit (per symbol, per strategy, per k in {1.5, 2.5, 3.5}; no other k):
* sigma_t = sigma_risk_next at close t: the bias-corrected robust EWMA one-bar sigma forecast at the strategy's own bar size
  (1h or 4h), without the weekend shrink (the frame's stop/risk sigma); fallback sigma_next if null. Known at close t.
  Distance = k * sigma_t in log price, one-bar horizon (no sqrt(time-in-trade) scaling), re-read every bar.
* A trade starts at the close of the first bar where the (wrapped) signal is non-zero with a new sign; best_t = max close
  (long) / min close (short) over entry..t, closes only. At close t, if side * (log best_t - log close_t) > k * sigma_t
  (strictly), the wrapped signal is 0 at t: the position is closed at close_t (the same timing as any strategy exit),
  paying the usual cost.
* Re-entry: after a trailing exit of side d, the wrapped signal stays 0 while sign(raw signal) == d. The first bar where
  sign(raw) != d (raw flat or opposite) is the 'fresh signal change': from that bar on the wrapper follows the raw signal
  again (an opposite raw signal opens the opposite trade at that same close; a flat raw signal re-arms, and a later
  non-zero raw signal enters). Otherwise the wrapped signal equals the raw signal (the strategy's own exits still apply).
* Close-based (no intrabar stop orders): the rule uses only close_t and sigma_t.

Evaluation: daily pnl_d per symbol-date as in the panel; sleeve = strategy x universe (mean over symbols, T >= 3 symbols);
family book = equal-weight mean of the available trend sleeves (L and T) per date. Paired daily difference book_k - book_orig,
NW t (evaluate.newey_west_t), one-sided p; Holm over the 3 k per segment (llm_in_sample < 2026-07-01 <= clean_holdout; pooled =
all dates). Verdicts (registered: median-k = 2.5): llm_in_sample supports if diff > 0, t > 2 and Holm p < 0.05, contradicts if

title: H-PD6: k-sigma trailing exits cut the trend book's in-sample P&L at every k; holdout gain is an exposure cut on a losing book
body:
H-PD6 result (design as in the earlier entry; baseline recomputed = stored strategy panel, 347,544 trend rows, max diff 0).
Paired daily trend book (8 F1 strategies, L+T, equal-weight sleeves), trail minus own exits:
* llm_in_sample (2204 d): k1.5 -0.0208/day (NW t -2.31), k2.5 -0.0195 (t -2.30), k3.5 -0.0167 (t -2.14); Sharpe 0.86 -> -1.13 / -0.27 / 0.27. CONTRADICTS.
* clean_holdout (132 d): +0.0177 (t 1.42), +0.0187 (t 1.63), +0.0186 (t 1.75), Holm p 0.12; Sharpe -2.21 -> -2.83 / -1.31 / -0.87. Registered '> 0' met: SUPPORTS.
* pooled: contradicts (in-sample fails).
Why: the trail is mostly an exposure cut (exposure 0.86 -> 0.10/0.17/0.25; mean hold 70 h -> 9/15/21 h). The daily difference is ~ the negative of
the own-exit book (corr -0.99), so the sign of the test is the sign of the trend book in that segment: positive in-sample, negative in the holdout.
Skew of the difference in-sample about -2: it gives up the big trend days (short convexity). Capture of MFE does not improve in-sample
(0.316 -> 0.318-0.323) - it rises only in the holdout (0.293 -> 0.35); the excursion pool shrinks 44-72% and costs per kept gross double at k1.5.
Lesson: the H-PD4 'exit leakage' is noise-scale give-back that a one-bar k-sigma close trail cannot harvest without cutting the trend tails.
Rule candidates R-EXIT-1 (avoid, B), R-EXIT-2 (expect, C), R-EXIT-3 (expect, B), provisional, in the report. Next ideas (need registration):
sqrt(time-in-trade)-scaled distance, profit-only trail (arm after +x sigma), time-in-trade exits.

title: GEN design fixed before holdout: parameter-uncertain 1h market generator + strategy-panel backtests
body:
Agent N, block GEN: design FIXED before any holdout comparison (no clean_holdout data read so far; calibration rows known_ts < 2026-07-01, max known_ts 2026-06-30 23:00:02).
Generator sim/market_gen.py (1h, multi-asset): daily log bipower variance = level a_i (trailing-365d in-sample mean; in-sample check: beats the full-history mean for the next-132d level, MSE 0.31 vs 0.38) + per-symbol weekday effect + common log-HAR factor (b1/b5/b22 0.39/0.38/0.13, t shocks nu 7) + pooled idiosyncratic log-HAR with v0-cell shifts (latent daily 9x9 chains); hourly diffusive part = hour-of-week shares x AR(1) log-vol (common+idio; SMM: sig_h 0.37, phi 0.67, psi 0.77) x Student-t with a per-cluster common shock (lam ~0.8 for crypto), normalised to the day's BV; regime-dependent hourly and daily AR(1) (EB-shrunk, all about -0.03), zero drift otherwise; Kou jumps (p 0.135/h in z units) with per-symbol Hawkes (branching ~0), common-jump share omega 0.63 (matches co-jump phi 0.33) and a GPD tail above 6 sd (rate 1.3e-4/h); Brownian-bridge wicks (kappa_w 1.27); turnover, funding (8h AR) and OI (4h AR) series.
Parameter uncertainty: 500 moving-block (20-day) bootstrap replicates of every estimator, asymptotic covariances for Kou and Hawkes, plus between-window drift of hour-of-week shares (tau 0.16), cross-asset correlation (Fisher-z tau 0.09) and jump intensity (log tau 0.13); one fresh draw per path. Fixed-parameter comparator = point estimate. Bootstrap comparator = B5 stationary block bootstrap (sim.resample), joint across symbols.
Paths: 500 param / 200 fixed / 200 boot per universe, from the real cutoff state, 2026-06-30 23:00 -> 2026-11-09 23:00; strategy-panel engines unchanged (1h frames 40-day real prefix, 4h aggregated, 80-day prefix). Tests, verdict maps and the 10 facts as in the market_gen_study docstring (literal H-GEN criteria; vector facts by distance-to-median envelope).
In-sample design check (8 in-sample 132-day windows vs 40 generated paths): facts inside per window 5-10 (median 7.5; 4/8 windows >= 8). Known misses in-sample: return factor share band too narrow (correlation not tied to the vol level), hourly kurtosis extremes (57 in one window), daily kurtosis upper tail. T: calibrated mostly on PAXG/XAUT (13 of 15 symbols have 12-80 in-sample days), SMM objective 101 vs 4.7 for L, no drift estimate: T is run but is weak by construction.

title: VBOS design fixed before testing: detector families, grids, objectives, nested purged walk-forward
body:
Agent F6. Design of the VBOS study, written BEFORE any VBOS number was computed. Plan: research/plans/2026-11-13_vol_bos_trend.md. Code: src/ai_trader/features/vol_bos.py, src/ai_trader/research/vol_bos_study.py. Nothing below is changed after results are seen; deviations will be logged as 'mistake'/'decision' entries.

DATA. Universe L = the 23 crypto perps of trend_zoo_study.UNIVERSE (verdicts, pooled); BTC alone as a per-symbol look (report only); T = 16 TradFi perps (breakout_cipher_kalman_study.UNIV_T) as holdout robustness only (history starts 2026-04..07, so it is thin and mostly descriptive). Bars: bybit, research.frame.market_frame(funding=False, oi=False), native 1d and 4h for L; for T, 4h/1d bars aggregated from 1h and enriched with frame.enrich_bars. Intrabar realised measures from 1h log returns inside each bar: rv = sum r^2, rs_pos / rs_neg = semivariances (features/realized.py definitions), rescaled by expected/observed 1h count. Costs 7.5 bps per side. Segments: llm_in_sample < 2026-07-01 <= clean_holdout. P&L is dated by the UTC date on which it accrues (bar t+1's interval), events by the first accrual date after the event bar's close.

TREND BASE. trend_zoo.ensemble (21 fixed variants, equal-weight signal) per symbol and freq, P&L via evaluate.strategy_pnl (sized at entry, risk units, band 0.2), summed per accrual date. Symbol evaluation window starts after max(zoo lookback_bars, 200 days of detector warm-up); every config of a symbol shares that window.

VOL BoS DETECTORS (62 per freq, fixed). y_t = log of seasonally adjusted bar RV (4h: divided by the trailing-60-day slot factor, causal; 1d: factor 1). Windows are in days (bars = days x bars/day).
 (a) range break, 27: L_t = log mean rv over the last w days, w in {5,10,20}; threshold = trailing quantile q in {0.90, 0.95, 1.00 (= the max, literal range break)} of L over the previous N days, N in {60,120,180} (t excluded); onset = first bar above.
 (b) CUSUM on y, 18: x = (y - trailing mean)/trailing sd over N in {60,180} days (t excluded); S_t = max(0, S_{t-1} + x_t - kappa), kappa in {0.25,0.5,1.0}; alarm when S_t > h, h in {2,4,8}; S resets to 0 at an alarm; onset = alarm.
 (c) persistent HAR surprise, 9: log-HAR on y with components (1 bar, 5 days, 22 days) fitted by expanding OLS, refit every 30 days, min 180 days, only rows whose target is known; level forecast F = exp(yhat + s2/2); condition rv_adj > k x F for m consecutive bars, k in {1.25,1.5,2.0}, m in {2,3,5} bars (1d) / {3,6,12} bars (4h); onset = first bar the run reaches m.
 (d) vol-of-vol break, 8: vov = sd over the last wv days of 1-day changes in log 1-day RV, wv in {10,20}; above its trailing quantile q in {0.90,0.95} over N in {60,180} days; onset = first bar above.
 Declustering: per symbol and detector, an onset within 20 days of the previous kept onset is dropped (no overlapping outcome windows within a symbol).

SEMIVARIANCE BREAKS (H-VBOS2, 27 per freq). L+_t, L-_t = log mean rs_pos / rs_neg over the last w days, w in {5,10,20}; each against its own trailing quantile q in {0.80,0.90,0.95} over N in {60,120,180} days. Up-break: L+ above its threshold while L- is not; down-break symmetric. Onset = first bar of the flag; declustered 20 days per side. Dominance for H-VBOS3: sign(sum rs_pos - sum rs_neg) over the last 10 days (fixed).

STRUCTURE. Fractal swings with k bars each side (swing high: high_i > max of the k previous highs and >= max of the k next; confirmed at i+k). BoS up at t: close_t above the most recent confirmed, not yet broken swing high (each level consumed once); down symmetric. CHoCH = a BoS against the direction of the previous BoS (reported descriptively).

STRATEGY (H-VBOS3, 496 configs per freq, 992 total). Candidate entry at the close of bar t: a structure BoS in direction d with sign(ensemble_t) = d. Allowed if a vol-BoS onset of the config's detector happened within the last A = 20 days (fixed) and, if semi = on, the 10-day dominance sign = d, and no trade is open. Position = the ensemble signal while held. Exit (flat) at the first later bar where sign(ensemble) != d (own exit, R-EXIT-1) or, if exit = own+struct, also at the first opposite BoS. No trailing stop. Grid: detector (62) x fractal k {2,5} bars (1d) / {3,12} bars (4h) x semi {off,on} x exit {own, own+struct} x freq {1d,4h}. Book = equal-weight mean over the live L symbols per date (flat days count as 0).

OBJECTIVES (pre-stated). VBOS1: excess_e = mean ensemble daily P&L over the h = 10 accrual days after the event (5 and 20 reported) minus that symbol's mean daily ensemble P&L over the same block/segment; statistic = date-clustered t (clusters = 10-day calendar buckets, mean of bucket means, Newey-West over buckets with lag >= 2). VBOS2: signed net return over h = 10 days (5, 20 reported) from the event close, sign = dominant side, minus 2 x 7.5 bps, divided by sigma_daily sqrt(h) (sigma_daily = sigma_next x sqrt(bars/day)); same clustered t. VBOS3: annualised net Sharpe of the EW daily book.

NESTED PURGED WALK-FORWARD (llm_in_sample only). Outer test blocks = calendar half-years 2022H1..2026H1 (9), expanding. Training for block b = data with dates < start_b - gap, gap = h_max (20) + embargo (5) = 25 days for event studies (an event is usable only if its 20-day outcome ends before the gap), 5 days for strategy P&L. Inner loop: the training window is cut into half-year folds (>= 60 days each, the last one truncated at the gap); each config is scored per inner fold (VBOS1/2: fold t, folds with < 10 events missing; VBOS3: fold Sharpe) and the inner score is the MEDIAN over folds (>= 2 valid folds required); argmax, ties -> grid order. Since the configs have no fitted parameters other than the causal HAR, the inner loop is a purged blocked CV of the past; the outer block is never touched by it (unit-tested). The WF result = the selected configs' outer-block events / P&L, concatenated. The final selection for the holdout = the same inner procedure over all of llm_in_sample (gap before the cutoff); its config is evaluated ONCE on clean_holdout.

VERDICTS (literal to hypotheses.yaml). VBOS1: one WF test per detector family x freq (8); one-sided p from the WF t, Holm over the 8; llm_in_sample supports if the best Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and its WF t > 2, contradicts if every WF estimate <= 0, else inconclusive; clean_holdout: the in-sample-best family's final detector, supports if excess > 0 (t reported), else contradicts; pooled supports only if both. VBOS2: WF test per freq (2), Holm over 2, same logic, signed mean. VBOS3: in-sample = DSR (Bailey & Lopez de Prado; trials = 992, V = variance of the 992 configs' daily Sharpes) of the final config's in-sample daily book > 0.95 AND PBO (CSCV, 16 blocks, in-sample daily EW books of the 992 configs) < 0.5; holdout: Sharpe(final config) - Sharpe(ensemble) > 0 with the paired daily-difference NW t reported; supports in pooled only if all three. Also reported: WF series vs ensemble (paired NW t), exposure, and a placebo (the selected gate circularly shifted per symbol, 200 draws) to separate timing from exposure cuts (R-EXIT-2). VBOS4: surfaces of the VBOS1 objective over the range-break grid (w, N, q) and of the VBOS2 objective over the semivariance grid, per freq (4 surfaces); top-quintile region = grid points >= the 80th percentile of the in-sample surface; clean_holdout supports if the holdout argmax is inside it for >= 3 of 4 surfaces, contradicts if <= 1, else inconclusive; llm_in_sample record uses the split-half analogue (2021-2023 vs 2024-2026H1). Holm across VBOS1-3 (in-sample p's) reported. Each hypothesis is recorded once per segment (L pooled); BTC-only and T are report-only.

title: PNN design fixed (H-PNN1..3) before holdout evaluation
body:
Agent F2, before any clean_holdout evaluation. Full spec: docstring of src/ai_trader/research/pnn_study.py; network in src/ai_trader/ml/pnn.py; tests tests/test_pnn.py (7 pass).

- Data: BTCUSDT 1h (ml.hourly 19 features, market_frame as of 2026-11-13; 56,454 complete bars, 3,239 holdout) and BTC rows of the 2026-11-12 daily panel (14 of ML_FEATURES; 2,317 rows, 133 holdout). F1's field.state did not exist yet; delta (signed flow) has no multi-year history in the lake, so it is not an input.
- Targets: vol-standardised returns (1h r/sqrt(s2), 1d ret_{D+1}/exp(lrv_w/2)); 7 quantiles 5..95.
- PNN: KAN [n_in -> 4 latent -> 7], Chebyshev T1..T4 of tanh(x/2) + SiLU residual per edge, non-crossing softplus-increment head; 531 params (1h), 431 (1d); feedback head 671 / 571. MLP: ReLU [n_in -> H -> 4 -> 7], same head, H 20 / 21 (519 / 438 params). log-HAR-t: OLS HAR on the log variance proxy + Student-t (loc, scale, df MLE) on training rows.
- Walk-forward monthly expanding (1h from 2021-07, 1d from 2021-08), purge + 1-day embargo, last 15% of training dates = validation (early stopping, split-conformal calibration). Configs from a 4-point in-sample search per family (1h: pnn lr 3e-3 wd 1e-2, mlp lr 1e-3 wd 1e-4; 1d: pnn 1e-3/1e-4, mlp 3e-3/1e-2); 2 seeds per family.
- H-PNN3: dynamics z_{t+1} = A z_t + B u_t + c fitted on fit-block pairs of the seed-0 PNN latents (u = next-step calendar); ctrl vs fb = the same frozen encoder, head retrained without / with zhat_{t+1}.
- Conformal: CQR scores; ACI gamma 0.005, window 1440 bars / 250 days; 80% from [q10,q90], 90% and 95% from [q5,q95]; compared with the unconformalised log-HAR-t interval at the same nominal level.
- Verdict rules exactly as in the docstring (H-PNN1: both baselines t < -2 at >= 1 horizon; H-PNN2: six coverages within 2 pp and widths <= HAR-t; H-PNN3: gain > 0.05 with t > 2 and fb - ctrl pinball t < -2 at the same horizon). Holm within PNN per segment over H-PNN1 and H-PNN3.
- Pilot (2022 only, in-sample): 1h pinball pnn 0.23048, mlp 0.23064, har 0.23127 (pnn - har t -3.5; pnn - mlp t -0.8); 1d pnn 0.2950, mlp 0.2945, har 0.2925; ACI coverage 0.80 / 0.90 / 0.95 on target; latent R^2 gain 0.16 (1h), 0.53 (1d); fb - ctrl t -0.85 / -0.95. No design change after the pilot; pilot checkpoints are reused by the full run (deterministic, same code).

title: VBOS in-sample: vol BoS does not time trend (range/CUSUM onsets precede WORSE trend P&L), semivariance breaks do not point direction, filtered strategy overfits (DSR 0.22, PBO 0.84)
body:
llm_in_sample results of H-VBOS1-4 (L 23 crypto pooled, nested purged walk-forward, 2022H1-2026H1 outer blocks), recorded BEFORE any clean_holdout number was computed. Selections are frozen in the study cache (selection.json).

- H-VBOS1 inconclusive. None of the 8 family x freq tests is positive with t > 2 (all Holm p = 1). The best is vov|4h (WF 10-day excess +0.028/day, t 0.81, 471 events); har is slightly positive (t 0.55-0.57). The largest effects are NEGATIVE: after a range break or a CUSUM alarm the trend ensemble does WORSE than its block mean over the next 10 days (range|1d -0.037/day t -2.43, range|4h -0.075 t -2.37, cusum|4h -0.056 t -2.33). Vol expansion is not a 'trend is starting' signal here; if anything it marks whipsaw.
- H-VBOS2 contradicts. WF signed 10-day return in the dominant side's direction is negative at both freqs (1d -0.077 sigma t -1.04; 4h -0.037 t -0.59). Semivariance dominance agrees with the sign of the trailing return in 69-80% of events: it is mostly a momentum proxy, and it does not continue.
- H-VBOS3 contradicts. Final selection (inner median-of-folds over all in-sample half-years): 4h, har_1.5_3 (RV above 1.5x the log-HAR forecast for 3 bars), fractal k 3, semivariance filter on, own exits. In-sample Sharpe 0.35 vs unfiltered 4h ensemble 0.44 on the same days; exposure 43% of symbol-days. DSR 0.22 (SR0 0.68 for 992 trials); PBO 0.84 (CSCV 16 blocks, median logit -1.35, degradation slope -1.23). Walk-forward picks switch family and freq almost every block; WF Sharpe 0.37 vs same-freq ensemble 0.34, paired daily diff t -0.58 (the filter cuts exposure, not risk-adjusted loss).
- H-VBOS4 inconclusive (split-half analogue): the 2024-26 optimum lies inside the 2021-23 top quintile for the range grid at both freqs but not for the semivariance grid (2 of 4); rank correlations between halves -0.40 to +0.19.
- BTC look (report only): min 3 events per fold because a single symbol cannot reach 10 declustered events per half-year (decision, report-only); even then 4h range folds never reach 5 clusters, so BTC event selection is mostly undefined. BTC final strategy: 4h vov_20_0.9_60, in-sample Sharpe 0.77 vs 0.59 ensemble, but DSR 0.09 and WF Sharpe 0.15 vs 0.65.
- Check: the ensemble base reproduces data/priors/trend_zoo_daily_4h.parquet (monthly corr 0.997, equal totals); the lower EW Sharpe than the zoo report (0.44 vs 0.96) is the window (the zoo includes 2020H2; here symbols start after 200 warm-up days).

Pooled-verdict rules fixed now, before the holdout: VBOS1/2/4 pooled = supports only if both segments support, contradicts if either contradicts, else inconclusive; VBOS3 pooled = supports if DSR > 0.95, PBO < 0.5 and holdout Sharpe diff > 0 all hold, contradicts if at most one holds, else inconclusive. Holdout primaries: VBOS1 = vov|4h (smallest raw p; all Holm p tie at 1), VBOS2 = 4h.

title: VBOS holdout: vol BoS filter fails (holdout Sharpe -0.46 vs -0.12, placebo median); range-break vol expansion precedes WORSE trend P&L in both segments
body:
Single clean_holdout look (2026-07-01 .. 2026-11-12, 135 days) with the selections frozen at 21:16 UTC; verdicts recorded once per segment.

- H-VBOS1 holdout contradicts (frozen vov|4h detector -0.057/day, t -1.16, 71 events); pooled contradicts. The range-break family is negative again: frozen range_20_180_0.9 -0.086 (t -2.97, 24 events, 1d), -0.102 (t -1.59, 4h); 89-100% of range grid points negative in the holdout (descriptive). Trend P&L after a vol range break is BELOW its mean in both segments - the opposite of the registered idea. Rule candidate R-VBOS-1 (C, provisional); it should be registered as its own hypothesis before use.
- H-VBOS2 holdout 'supports' only literally: 4h bucket-weighted +0.165 sigma (t 1.20, 45 events), but event-weighted about -0.02; pooled contradicts (R-VBOS-2).
- H-VBOS3 holdout contradicts: frozen 4h har_1.5_3 filter Sharpe -0.46 vs -0.12 for the unfiltered 4h ensemble (paired diff t -0.12); its Sharpe is exactly the median of 200 time-shifted gates, so the timing adds nothing. Pooled contradicts (DSR 0.22, PBO 0.84, holdout diff < 0: 0 of 3 criteria). R-VBOS-3.
- H-VBOS4 holdout inconclusive (2 of 4 surfaces), pooled inconclusive; surfaces rank corr -0.11..+0.50. R-VBOS-4 (C).
- T could not test the frozen strategy (history too short for 180-day windows / HAR); BTC alone is too thin for event selection.
Reflection: the user's intuition that trend has 'worked, maybe not the way we tested it' was given a fair, wide shot (62 detectors, semivariance direction, structure entries, 992 strategy configs, nested purged WF). The honest answer is that vol expansion is a whipsaw marker for trend, not a starting gun; the only stable signal found is negative.

title: F3: H-NEWS1/H-NEWS2 design fixed before evaluation
body:
Design fixed BEFORE any H-NEWS1/H-NEWS2 evaluation on real data (agent F3, BTC field program).

Data (src/ai_trader/news/, data/research/news/ with manifest.json; nothing re-downloaded):
- GDELT DOC 2.0 daily timelines 2017-01-01..2026-11-12 (timelinevolraw count + monitored-total norm; timelinetone) for 10 queries: bitcoin, crypto, blockchain, hack, regulation, etf, stablecoin, binance, coinbase, tether; 15-min buckets for the last 84 days (bitcoin, crypto, hack, regulation).
- Events: FOMC parsed from federalreserve.gov (2017-2027), CPI/NFP 2020-2026 BLS schedules (2026 from fedratecalc.com; FRED/ALFRED unreachable from this host today, BLS refuses scripted access, so 2020-2025 are recorded by hand - a caveat), halvings, 5 ETF/SEC dates.
- On-chain: blockchain.com charts (hash-rate, n-transactions, transaction-fees-usd, mempool-size).

Observation before testing: GDELT's monitored volume (norm) is non-stationary - ~0.7M articles/day in 2017, ~0.15M 2023-26, collapsing to ~0.08M in Oct 2026 and ~0.02M in Nov 2026. Raw counts are unusable across the holdout; features use log share ln((count+1)/norm) minus its trailing 60-day mean.

Point-in-time: GDELT day d known_ts = d+1 00:00 (end of the publication window, the literal reading of H-NEWS1's 'known_ts = publication time'); a *_l1 robustness variant uses day t-1. On-chain day d known at d+2 00:00 (observed <= 20 h lag; 24 h used). Event 'next' flags need schedule_known_ts <= asof (30 d lead for CPI/NFP/FOMC, 7 d for shutdown-delayed releases and halvings, 14 d for SEC deadlines); unscheduled events never appear in advance.

Block (13 columns, fixed): att_btc, att_btc7, att_ind, att_max, tone_btc, tone_ind, ev_macro_next, ev_crypto_next, ev_macro_today, oc_ntx, oc_fees, oc_mempool, oc_hash. Missing values -> 0.

H-NEWS1: BTCUSDT daily RV (1h bars); baseline = log-HAR (1/7/30 d) + 6 forecast-weekday dummies; augmented = + block; expanding OLS on ln RV_{t+1}, refit every 30 d, first fit after 365 d, lognormal back-transform; paired QLIKE diff per target day, NW t; segments by target day vs 2026-07-01. supports: diff<0 and t<-2; contradicts: diff>=0; else inconclusive. One record per segment.
H-NEWS2: walk-forward L2 logistic (C=1, numpy Newton) of 1{ret_{t+1}>0} on the standardised block, same schedule; base = training up share; Brier skill with 95% circular 10-day block bootstrap (2000 draws). supports: CI upper <= 0.005; contradicts: CI lower > 0.005; else inconclusive.
Robustness (reported, not recorded): news_l1, news-only, events-only, onchain-only, coefficients at the cutoff.

title: PNN study: 1h networks beat log-HAR-t, KAN = MLP, conformal and latent feedback add nothing
body:
Agent F2. Recorded once per segment (H-PNN1 X / ? / pooled X; H-PNN2 ? / ? / ?; H-PNN3 ? / ? / ?). Report research/reports/btc_pnn_2026-11-13.md.

- 1h: both ~500-parameter quantile networks beat log-HAR-t in both segments (PNN - HAR pinball -0.00082, t -7.3 in-sample; -0.00124, t -2.95 holdout; MLP -0.00083 t -7.8 / -0.00097 t -2.2). The polynomial (KAN) edges add nothing over the equal-size ReLU MLP (PNN - MLP +0.00002 t 0.2 / -0.00027 t -1.1). H-PNN1 fails because of the MLP baseline, not log-HAR-t.
- 1d: nothing beats log-HAR-t (PNN - HAR +0.0024 t 1.8 in-sample, -0.0082 t -1.8 on 133 holdout dates).
- Conformal: log-HAR-t bands are already near nominal. ACI holds 1h holdout coverage within 0.2 pp, but its bands are 2-3% wider than HAR-t; the 1d 90% band covers 0.880.
- Latent: linear dynamics beat persistence (holdout R^2 gain 0.14 at 1h, 0.89 at 1d, t > 10), but feeding zhat back does nothing (fb - ctrl t 0.27 / -0.69). The predictable part is calendar and vol persistence, which the head already sees.
- Symbolic: at 1h the hour-of-week factor, robust sigma and last-hour |r| dominate. At 1d one latent is a weekend clock (next_wk_hours -> z3 quadratic, R^2 0.995) that narrows the band.
- Mistake avoided / note: the MLP's default Linear head init started it far from the unconditional quantiles (0 early-stopped epochs); fixed to a small init before the design was frozen.
- Not done: F1's field.state appeared after the design was fixed; a rerun on it would be a new track. Delta has no multi-year history.
- Rule candidates R-PNN-1..4 are in the report (not added to research/rules.yaml).

title: H-FLD design fixed before evaluation (BTC probability field)
body:
Agent F1 (BTC field program). Fixed after the 2022 in-sample pilot (1h only) and BEFORE any 4h/1d or clean_holdout evaluation.

State (ai_trader.field.state, point-in-time, 1h): x1 = 0.5 ln(vf/vm), x2 = 0.5 ln(vm/vs), L = 0.5 ln vs (jump-robust deseasonalised EWMAs, lambda 0.94/0.995/0.9993, clip 4 sd), s = 0.5 ln hour-of-week factor of the next bar (profile_asof, frozen per refit), jx = jump excitation (half-life 3 h), m24 = standardised 24h momentum, fz = funding z (720 h), oi = 24h log OI change, dir = regime v0 direction score. Offset ln vf. Delta is NOT in the state: the lake's Binance bars carry no taker-buy volume (and hold ETHUSDT only); Bybit flow_bars for BTC start 2026-05-11, so delta gets an exploratory check only. News intensity not available (F3 pending).

Field: r = mu + sqrt(D)(e + 1[jump]K); D = vf exp(P_D), mu = sqrt(D) P_mu, p = min(exp(P_lam), 0.5); K ~ Kou in sd units with mean size >= 3 sd (eta <= 1/3); e = unit-variance Student-t (df by EM) off the jump branch, N(0,1) on it. EM with Gamma-QML (ln D), least squares (drift), Poisson-QML (jump probability). Libraries: degree <= 3 in the 9 standardised coordinates for P_D and P_mu (220 terms), degree <= 2 for P_lam (55). Supports by stability selection (40 half-date subsamples, pi_thr 0.7, PFER <= 1) at the first refit, each January and at 2026-07-01; coefficients by EM at every monthly refit (expanding, training from 2020-09-01).

Why the core changed after the pilot: with a Gaussian core the jump branch absorbed 7% -> 25% of bars (Kou mean 1.7-2.5 sd), i.e. it became a second diffusion scale, not jumps. The t core plus the 3-sd floor keeps the jump share at ~1%. Pilot 2022 (1h, in-sample): field vs B0 +0.0136 nats (t 3.98); field vs B1 (B0 + calendar) +0.0005 (t 0.19); Gaussian-core field vs B0 -0.051. So the 1h gain over log-HAR-t looks like the hour-of-week factor, which is already known (H-NS4); I expect FLD1 to pass at 1h for that reason and to be a hard test at 4h/1d.

Baselines (per horizon, MLE on the same origin grid, same refits): B0 = log-HAR-t + constant Kou (ln s^2 on ln RV24, ln RV168/7, ln RV720/30; t_nu core + constant-rate N+Kou branch); B1 = B0 + mean hour-of-week factor over the horizon (report only).
Evaluation: origins 1h every hour (closed form), 4h at closes with hour % 4 == 0 (MC 1000 paths), 1d at 00:00 UTC (MC 2000 paths), Rao-Blackwellised last step; first OOS month 2022-01; log score of R_h; paired diff averaged per UTC date, NW t, one-sided p; segments by origin vs 2026-07-01.
Verdicts: H-FLD1 per segment supports if >= 2 of 3 horizons have diff > 0, t > 2 and Holm p < 0.05 (Holm over FLD per segment: FLD1 x3, plus FLD3 x3 in the holdout); contradicts if >= 2 horizons have diff <= 0. H-FLD2 per segment at 1h and 1d: supports if Brier-skill 90% CI upper (10-day blocks) <= 0.005 and |t| of drift-on minus drift-off log score < 2 at both; contradicts if CI lower > 0 or t > 2 at either; else inconclusive (a drift that HURTS with t < -2 is therefore inconclusive under the literal |t| < 2). H-FLD3 (clean_holdout): frozen cutoff field vs RLS with forgetting 1 - 1/1440 (prior = cutoff fit, model-based covariance), state construction frozen at the cutoff for both; primary 1h: supports if diff > 0, t > 2, Holm p < 0.05; contradicts if diff <= 0.

title: OBG design fixed (F5 order-book generator, H-OBG1/H-OBG2)
body: Before any held-out generation: queue-reactive tables from 3 ob200 event-level BTC days (2026-04-15, 2026-09-13, 2026-10-28; raw deleted after aggregation, manifest data/research/obgen/manifest.json). Generator sim/ob_gen.py: 100 ms steps; touch and levels 1-29 from HLR-style tables p_add/p_cancel(level band, q/AES bin, vol tercile, spread state) estimated on 100 ms pushes with unchanged best quotes, touch flicker memory (prev event multipliers, cancel-of-just-added); deep levels re-drawn from the stationary profile; reference price = real 1-min path with a trade-time Brownian bridge plus a capped square-root flow bridge, threshold repricing (move-size law of the calibration days); taker orders from the path's per-minute counts and notional, bursty arrival law, long-memory signs, empirical FIT-half order sizes. Per-day calibration on the FIT half (00-12 UTC) incl. indirect inference of theta, lam, deep_corr on 06-08 UTC; facts on the TEST half. Split frozen in data/research/obgen/split.json (31 micro_days days, folds i mod 3). H-OBG1 through atx match-sim; twins (H-OBG2) through the generator's own book (identical prints/100 ms states, tested). Pilots only on calibration days: most facts near the envelopes; risks: depletion and order-size median at the envelope edge, |r| ACF and flow ACF low, 1 s RV ~1.5x real from sweeps. F4 replay test with the real 2026-09-13 ob200 file: passed.

title: BTC probability field: H-FLD1 passes only through the hour-of-week factor; drift null holds; online updating adds nothing
body:
Agent F1. 59 monthly refits (2022-01 .. 2026-11), BTCUSDT 1h Bybit. Recorded once per segment.

H-FLD1 supports / supports. Field minus log-HAR-t + constant Kou (nats per origin, NW t by date): in-sample 1h +0.033 (t 17.7), 4h +0.027 (t 7.2), 1d +0.009 (t 0.9); holdout 1h +0.051 (t 7.5), 4h +0.062 (t 5.4), 1d +0.023 (t 0.8). Passes at 1h and 4h (Holm p < 0.001), not at 1d.
But against log-HAR-t + hour-of-week (B1, report only) the field is level at 1h (+0.004 t 3.4 in-sample, +0.002 t 0.7 holdout) and WORSE at 4h (-0.011 t -4.1 / -0.007 t -1.2) and 1d (-0.036 t -3.8 / -0.037 t -1.4). So the registered win is the known hour-of-week factor (H-NS4); the polynomial terms and the path simulation add nothing over a direct-horizon calendar log-HAR-t, and the multi-step MC runs wide (central 50% interval covers 0.55-0.57 at 4h/1d).

Discovered field (cutoff fit, 51k bars): ln D = ln vf - 0.151 - 0.154 x1 - 0.059 x2 + 0.556 s - 0.112 L*s + 0.145 m24*dir (standardised); raw slope on s = 0.5 ln f is 2.67 (the smoothed profile understates the hour-of-week swing); x1/x2 negative = the fast EWMA overshoots after shocks; m24*dir = running trends (either sign) are louder and jumpier. Jump probability exp(-4.15 + 0.082 m24*dir) ~ 1.6%/h; Kou sizes sit on the 3-sd floor (identification is weak: the floor binds); off-jump t df 4.3. Drift: constant only (+0.014 sd/h).
H-FLD2 supports / inconclusive: Brier skill CIs at 1h [-0.0001, +0.0000] both segments; at 1d in-sample [-0.0025, +0.0034], holdout [-0.0071, +0.0227] (135 days: too wide for the 0.005 bound); drift term |t| <= 1.3.
H-FLD3 inconclusive: online RLS (memory 1440 h) vs frozen 1h +0.00001 (t 0.09), 4h -0.0001, 1d -0.008 (t -2.0); coefficients barely move.
Mistake caught before recording: the first FLD3 run scored the online 1h arm with a Gaussian core (missing t df) and showed -0.034 (t -7.7); fixed, and the 4h/1d arms now share random numbers per origin.
Vol field: fast log-vol half-life 107 h (OU, finite-dt corrected), corr(dv, sign of return) -0.03, corr(dv, |z|) +0.92: no leverage. FP check: the 2-D FP solution matches the Euler MC of the same SDE to < 0.15 pp at q05/q95; both the reduced field and the full field MC are wider than realised 24h returns at mid/high vol (forecasts run hot after spikes, R-VOL-8).
Delta (Bybit flow_bars, 2026-05-11 .. 11-10 only; the lake's Binance bars have no taker-buy volume): no relation to field residuals (|t| <= 1.4).

title: F3: H-NEWS provisional (GDELT outage), not recorded; dashboard built
body:
H-NEWS1/H-NEWS2 run on PARTIAL GDELT data; NOT recorded (the design in the earlier entry is unchanged).

GDELT's DOC API returned HTTP 429 or timed out on almost every request from 21:31 UTC (even a 1-day query timed out; the server itself looks overloaded - its monitored volume also fell ~7x Jul->Nov 2026 and ~25 days are missing in Oct-Nov 2026). Daily data in hand: bitcoin (volume + tone), crypto (volume); the other 17 of 20 query x mode series are missing, so att_ind and tone_ind enter as zeros. Recording once per segment on a partial block would lock in an incomplete test, so scripts/news_study.py now refuses --record until all 20 series are present (or --allow-partial).

Provisional numbers (BTCUSDT, log-HAR x weekday baseline, expanding OLS, refit 30 d):
- H-NEWS1 primary: in-sample QLIKE diff +0.0059 (rel +1.7%, NW t +1.49, n 1908) -> would be 'contradicts'; holdout +0.0084 (t +0.76, n 134) -> 'contradicts'. News-only: -0.0000 (t -0.03) / -0.0030 (t -0.26); events-only: -0.0016 (t -0.84) / +0.0068 (t +1.05); on-chain-only hurts: +0.0078 (t +2.22) / +0.0045 (t +1.48).
- The macro-day flag has a clear in-sample coefficient (ln RV +0.22, x1.24, OLS t 3.5) but adding it does not lower out-of-sample QLIKE significantly.
- H-NEWS2: Brier skill -0.0107, 95% CI [-0.0195, -0.0021] in-sample -> would be 'supports'; holdout -0.0098 [-0.0242, +0.0056] -> 'inconclusive'.

title: MM replay study design and grid frozen before any P&L (H-MMR0-2)
body:
Agent M freezes the design of the market-making replay study before any P&L is computed (split file data/research/mm_replay/split.json).

- Hypotheses: H-MMR0, H-MMR1, H-MMR2 (registered 2026-11-14 ~00:30 UTC, before any data; not edited).
- Symbols: BTCUSDT; illiquid group TRXUSDT, ETCUSDT, XLMUSDT. These three are the mm_illiq20 contracts the live bot filled most on 2026-11-09..11-12 (exchange executions + journal: TRX 4 fills; ETC, XLM, CRV, CRWV, MAVIA, TSLA 2 each; ties broken by fills over all mm runs 2026-11-08..11-12: ETC 6, XLM 6). Live fill counts per symbol-day are tiny (0-2), so H-MMR0 has little power.
- Days: 2026-10-25..2026-11-13 (20 per symbol; live days 11-09 and 11-10 included). Split: chronological, FIT = 2026-10-25..2026-11-03, HELD = 2026-11-04..2026-11-13.
- Engine: atx mm-replay (crates/atx/src/mm_replay.rs): ob200 snapshot + deltas -> at_match::Ob200Replayer -> at_match::OrderBook; public trade tape merged by time (trade ts <= message cts first); the live atx mm decision code (mm::symbol_inputs, mm::target_quotes, mm::needs_replace, sigma / flow / micro / toxicity / shock / trend-guard steps); our orders virtual (minimum lots, no impact).
- Queue: join the back at activation (ahead = level size); trades at our price consume from the front; trade through our price or a real resting order crossing our price fills us; unexplained level decreases are cancels split FIFO-pessimistic (behind first), pro-rata (primary), LIFO-optimistic (ahead first); levels outside the 200-level window count fully ahead when they appear; RPI prints do not fill. Latency 150 ms on placement and cancel.
- Fees: config/fees.yaml by symbol class (crypto: maker 2.0 bp, taker 5.5 bp). Risk: inventory caps, per-symbol and global loss stops from the config (a stop cancels and closes at market, taker); one-lot-from-flat rule. Day: each symbol-day starts flat at 00:00 UTC and is marked to the mid at 24:00 UTC; warm-up 1m bars of the two previous days.
- P&L decomposition: net = spread captured + adverse selection (60 s) + inventory P&L - fees; spread = sum s q (mid_fill - price); adverse_h = sum s q (mid_t+h - mid_fill) (1 / 10 / 60 s); inventory = sum s q (mid_end - mid_t+60s).
- Selection: per group, on FIT days only, pro-rata queue: combinatorial purged CV over days (10 fit days, 2 test days per split = 45 splits, training days within 1 calendar day of a test day purged); a variant's CV score = median over splits of its test-day mean net P&L per symbol-day; choice = the highest CV score (H-MMR1); best fixed width = the F variant chosen the same way among F only, best micro among M, best forecast among N (H-MMR2).
- Overfitting: PBO by CSCV over the fit days (S = 10 one-day blocks, C(10,5) = 252 splits, metric = mean net P&L per symbol-day); deflated Sharpe of the chosen variant's daily net P&L on fit days with N = grid size trials.
- Tests: H-MMR1: mean net P&L per symbol-day on HELD days, day-clustered bootstrap (B = 10000) 95% CI, per group, pro-rata primary; H-MMR2: paired per symbol-day difference (forecast - best fixed) on HELD days, day-clustered bootstrap; H-MMR0: live days with the journaled live config over the live window, |replay - live| / max(live, 1) fill-count error and P&L sign agreement.
- Forecast arm: N family: the BTC live network's 1h band (data/journal/live_nn net.1h.sigma_pct) where it exists (2026-11-13 20:00-24:00 UTC); every other hour the field's hour-of-week x log-vol sigma sqrt(vf_t * f_next) (ai_trader.field.state; hour-of-week profile known at the day's 00:00 UTC; row valid from its known_ts).
- Segment: every day is after research.knowledge_cutoff (2026-07-01): clean_holdout.
- Grid (x 3 queue models each): btc 28 variants ['L_k0.5_live', 'L_k1_live', 'L_k2_live', 'M_h30_live', 'M_h120_live', 'M_h480_live', 'F_w3_live', 'F_w6_live', 'F_w12_live', 'F_w24_live', 'F_w48_live', 'N_k0.5_live', 'N_k1_live', 'N_k2_live', 'L_k0.5_sym', 'L_k1_sym', 'L_k2_sym', 'M_h30_sym', 'M_h120_sym', 'M_h480_sym', 'F_w3_sym', 'F_w6_sym', 'F_w12_sym', 'F_w24_sym', 'F_w48_sym', 'N_k0.5_sym', 'N_k1_sym', 'N_k2_sym']; illiquid 22 variants ['L_k0.5_live', 'L_k1_live', 'L_k2_live', 'M_h30_live', 'M_h120_live', 'M_h480_live', 'F_w3_live', 'F_w6_live', 'F_w12_live', 'F_w24_live', 'F_w48_live', 'L_k0.5_sym', 'L_k1_sym', 'L_k2_sym', 'M_h30_sym', 'M_h120_sym', 'M_h480_sym', 'F_w3_sym', 'F_w6_sym', 'F_w12_sym', 'F_w24_sym', 'F_w48_sym'].
- Bases: btc config/mm_multi.yaml, illiquid config/mm_illiq20.yaml; micro family adds the mm_nvda_micro micro_* / requote settings. Flow refreshed every tick in the grid (live rotation only in the H-MMR0 runs, which use the journaled live config and the measured live tick period: 16.7 s for mm11082326, 22.2 s for mm11101949).
- Not modelled: portfolio caps across symbols, structural zones (levels_file), stale tops of the slow link, funding, Bybit internals.

title: Phase-4 decision harness and H-STOP1 stop posterior built; pilot run; EV gate blocks every sleeve candidate
body:
Agent D built the phase-4 decision harness and the H-STOP1 stop posterior; paper only (execution.allow_mainnet stays false).

- scripts/decision_session.py prepare / decide / status (core: src/ai_trader/agent/decision.py). The persistent paper book is the
  Rust PaperBook via `atx exec-intents --mode paper --as-of` (new clock override, never future, never backwards) under
  data/exec/paper_book/ (run `ai`; pipeline tests use run `pipeline_test`). Decisions are refused after as_of + 30 min, with
  unanswered candidates, takes of blocked candidates, or any size / stop / target / cap / limit key. Size comes from at-risk.
- Stop cap: ai_trader.risk.stop_posterior, pinned as H-STOP1. ln(MAE/sigma) ~ N(mu, s^2), NIG prior kappa0 = 20, a0 = 10
  (20 pseudo-trades), b0 = 2.5 (prior log-sd 0.5, the fallback: no llm_in_sample replay trades exist), m0 = 0.7073 so that
  the predictive q90 = 4.0 exactly. Weekly (Monday 00:00 UTC), clipped to placement.stop_cap_bounds_sigma [2.5, 6.0]
  (new in config/risk.yaml). data/models/risk/stop_cap.json is read by crates/at-risk (validated, fail closed), by
  agent.session placement and by the bias gate.
- Pilot: pipeline_test sessions S20261113-0405 and S20261113-0805 were prepared and decided with scripted files (a take of a
  blocked candidate was refused; double decide refused). The first real session S20261114-1136 is prepared and left for
  the main session to decide.

Observation (not acted on; the user's call): with the current sleeve priors (PRIOR_EDGE shock +0.05, trend +0.03) and
min_net_expected_r 0.10, no sleeve candidate clears the engine's net E[R] gate after costs (shock continuation at 2R
about +0.05..0.06, trend at 3R about +0.01..0.04). Every candidate in all three sessions was blocked, so the RULE and AI
books stay empty and H-AI1 / H-AI2 cannot accumulate samples until the gate or the priors change. A second issue is in
the pinned H-STOP1 model: winners' MAE is truncated at the stop in force, so the posterior can tighten more easily than
it can widen (near_stop_share is reported in stop_cap.json).

title: MM replay: BTC grid amendment (portfolio net cap off) after a zero-order first BTC day
body: On BTCUSDT 2026-10-25 every one of the 84 BTC quoters placed 0 orders. Cause: the live quote rule (mm::target_quotes) checks the portfolio net cap max_net_usd = 60 (config/mm_multi.yaml) without the one-lot-from-flat exemption the per-symbol caps have, and one BTC lot is about 80 USD, so the live code can never quote BTC under mm_multi. This is a finding about the live config, not an engine bug. Since a single-symbol replay has no portfolio (portfolio coupling was already listed as not modelled), the BTC grid now sets max_net_usd = 0 (off) in every BTC variant; per-symbol caps (one lot from flat) still apply. No P&L information was seen (0 fills). The split, the illiquid grid and every other setting are unchanged; split.json carries an amendments list and the superseded version is kept (split_v1_superseded.json). BTCUSDT 2026-10-25 is re-run, which needs its two archives a second time; the manifest records the re-download and its reason. Variants file switched before BTC 2026-10-26 ran.

title: Cross-venue study ready; waiting on cTrader read-only credentials
body: Agent X built the read-only cTrader Open API client (crates/at-ctrader: official Spotware protos, prost code checked in, TLS framing, clientMsgId matching, heartbeats, 220 ms historical pacing with BLOCKED_PAYLOAD_TYPE retry). The client can only send an allowlist of read-only payload types, and it refuses a token with SCOPE_TRADE before account auth. Commands: atx ctrader check|symbols [--resolve]|ticks|stream|ping, tested against canned protobuf frames (15 Rust tests) plus tests/test_xvenue.py (10). Day split drawn with seed 20261114 and written before any cTrader data existed: 14 study instruments x 5 days in 2026-08-03..11-13, all clean_holdout. The pool is restricted to existing micro_days books for BTC, ETH, NVDA, QQQ and XAU, so their ob200 downloads aren't repeated. Bybit side ready: 51 new symbol-days of 1 s books reduced from ob200 archives (zips deleted, 25 MB total), USDCUSDT spot 1 m for the USDT basis, and funding for all 14 perps. Latency was measured with no orders: cTrader request RTT p50 0.12 s, p90 0.29 s; Bybit mainnet REST p50 0.47-0.82 s; Bybit demo order/create p50 0.66 s, p90 10.6 s (2026-11-09). Pre-specified: episodes must last > 1.32 s, fills come 1 s late, and the p90 sensitivity uses 21 s / 11 s. Decision: TradFi perps get no USDT correction because they track a USD index numerically; crypto gets ln(USDCUSDT) subtracted. A smoke run on fake CFD ticks (Bybit mid + 3 bp noise) passed H-ARB1 on noise alone and lost money in H-ARB2. Quote noise alone can therefore satisfy H-ARB1, so H-ARB2 is the test that matters. SPYUSDT is excluded and the resolver refuses it.

title: Paper EV gate > 0 and per-sleeve edge posteriors (user option 1)
body:
User decision 2026-11-14 ~13:30 UTC (option 1) implemented by agent D.

1. Paper EV gate: config/risk.yaml min_net_expected_r_paper: 0.0 (exclusive, net E[R] after costs > 0). at-risk
   DecideConfig::for_mode applies it only for paper / replay and never on mainnet; min_net_expected_r: 0.10 stays for
   every other mode. A Rust test covers paper, replay, mainnet, live and the exclusive bound.
2. Sleeve edges are now posteriors (ai_trader.risk.edge_posterior). Priors are shock_regime +0.05 and trend_4h +0.03
   (agent.session.PRIOR_EDGE), each worth 30 pseudo-trades: prior sd 0.09, half weight to the data after 30 closed trades,
   two thirds by H-AI1's 60. Conjugate normal on y = (R - E0[R]) / (1 + g), which is 1{target} - p_null for a bracket
   trade, with sd pinned at 0.5. Updated weekly (Monday 00:00 UTC) from the AI book's closed trades (kill exits
   excluded) into data/models/risk/edge_posterior.json. p_quant and net E[R] use the posterior mean in force at as_of.
   A posterior that takes net E[R] to <= 0 blocks the sleeve again (intended). The LLM never sets it.

Consequence: shock continuation candidates (about +0.05 to +0.06 net E[R]) and the better trend candidates (+0.01 to
+0.04) now pass the paper gate on weekdays. The paper book can start trading, so H-AI1 / H-AI2 / H-STOP1 can begin
collecting samples. This is a new track record from this decision on.

body:
80 symbol-days replayed (BTCUSDT, TRXUSDT, ETCUSDT, XLMUSDT; 2026-10-25..11-13) with atx mm-replay: real ob200 book + trade tape through at-match, the live atx mm quoting code, 150 ms latency, crypto fees (2 / 5.5 bp), 3 queue models. All verified (0 engine rejects, replayer checks equal, ledger identity exact); every raw file deleted. All days are after the knowledge cutoff: recorded as clean_holdout.

- H-MMR0 supports (weakly): journaled live config over the live windows of 2026-11-09 and 11-10 gives 12 replay fills vs 7 live, median |error| 0.25 (0.75 on the 4 days with live fills), P&L sign agreement 6/6 under pro-rata; optimistic 16 fills.
- H-MMR1 inconclusive: fit-chosen by purged CV (45 splits): BTC L_k1_live (the live mm_multi rule) held +0.039 USD per symbol-day [-0.105, +0.178]; illiquid L_k1_sym +0.002 [-0.009, +0.011]. PBO 0.00 both (uninformative: many dominated variants), procedure OOS mean negative (-0.015 / -0.025), DSR 0.05 / 0.89.
- H-MMR2 inconclusive: micro sigma minus best fixed width: illiquid -0.099 [-0.126, -0.074], BTC -1.50 [-1.55, -1.44]; BTC field / network band minus fixed +0.024 [-0.21, +0.22].
- Decomposition: tight variants capture +0.2..0.4 USD/day of spread but give back -0.5..-0.8 within 1 s and pay -0.6..-1.1 in fees; BTC tight variants hit the 1.5 USD symbol stop on most days. Wide variants (40-50 bp) fill 2-4 times a day for cents.
- Problems: the live mm_multi net cap (60 USD) blocks any BTC order (~80 USD) - the BTC grid needed max_net_usd = 0 (amendment, BTC 10-25 downloaded twice); TRX sub-tick prints on 10-29 / 10-31 (treated as hidden liquidity); two BTC days lost to another agent's rebuild of target/debug/atx.exe (re-run; private binary copy); BTC ob200 is too coarse (59% of prints outside the 100 ms touch).
