title: vecopen phase 2 (levels) passed
body: LegOriginDetector and LevelRegistry (streaming update(bar) only), 12 hand-built cases + 5 property tests (oracle equality, brute-force registry model, truncation/perturbation invariance), 9 injected bugs all caught. BTCUSDT research smoke run: 21,157 levels born across 15m..1M (10,954 on 15m, 25 weekly, 6 monthly), 16,630 first fills (fill share 0.80 at 15m falling to 0.50 at 1M), median k* 2; 15 s loop, 332 MB. 13 SPEC-silent decisions documented (D1-D13: Wilder ATR shifted, zone from ATR_{t-1}, lockout of pending same-direction candidates, zero-range zero-volume bars invisible, HTF before 5m at equal timestamps, etc.). Builder disclosed one blocked listing attempt into data/holdout (nothing read). Weekly/monthly crypto levels are few (25/6 for BTC), as expected; their depth must come from CFDs.

title: Options after compression and tail-profit continuation (user idea)
body: User proposed: buy calls on an expected volatile up-move after compression and sell deep-ITM puts at the same time to collect premium and lower volatility dependence; on the downside, small puts plus some futures, hedge with spot after an extreme (unexpected) profit and scale out with limit orders; check whether extreme profits are autocorrelated across percentiles. Main-session note to the user: a short deep-ITM put is mostly a synthetic long future (delta ~0.85-1, low vega); only its time value is earned, Deribit options are BTC-settled, and direction after compression has never been predictable here (H-VB3, VB1); a risk reversal or call spread cuts vega more. No Deribit options data was found in BTC_USDT_Probs (only BTC 1m and Polymarket); the lake has DVOL hourly 2021-03.., a daily smile summary 2020..2026-10 and Deribit perps. Registered H-OPX1-4 before any download; agent OPX downloads Deribit option trade history (public history API, aggregated per instrument-hour, <= 3 GB) and runs the tests.

title: OPX design frozen before evaluation: detector, contracts, pricing tiers, costs, grids, verdict rules
body:
Design frozen before any options result (agent OPX). Only data coverage has been looked at (Bybit BTCUSDT 1h from 2020-03-25; deribit_svi daily to 2026-10-09; DVOL hourly 2021-03-24..; option download in progress, 2020-01..2026-11, full history).

DATA. Deribit BTC option trades (history.deribit.com public API), aggregated per instrument-hour, block trades excluded (data/research/options/btc_YYYY-MM.parquet; src/ai_trader/research/options_download.py). Underlying = Bybit BTCUSDT 1h (lake), ETHUSDT for H-OPX3 robustness; Bybit funding (lake); smile summary deribit_svi; DVOL. Index S at an 08:00 fixing = index_price of the last option trade before 08:00 (hour 07:00 rows), fallback Bybit 08:00 open. Forward F = S exp(b T), b = iv_basis_ann_30 (last known), else 0.

DETECTOR (as registered). Evaluated at 08:01 UTC on day d: RV7 = sum of squared hourly log returns over the 168 bars ending 08:00; IV = iv_atm_30 of day d (known 08:01), or DVOL/100 (bar ending 08:00) where iv_atm_30 is missing (after 2026-10-09). Percentile = share of the trailing 365 daily values (d-364..d) <= today's, >= 300 values required. Trigger: RV pct <= 0.20 AND IV pct <= 1/3. Entry at day d+1 08:00. Declustered: no new entry within 14 days of the last one. Unconditional sample = every day from the first day the detector is defined to the last day with a full 14-day exit.

CONTRACTS. Expiry = the nearest expiry with >= 21 days to go among expiries traded in the 7 days before entry (point-in-time listing); strikes = strikes of that expiry traded in those 7 days. Straddle strike = listed strike nearest F. H-OPX2 legs: call with Black-76 delta nearest +0.25 and put with delta nearest -0.85, deltas from the model smile at entry.

PRICING (tiered, per leg per fixing). (1) real: the instrument's hourly row in 05:00-10:59 whose last trade is nearest 08:00; IV = its last trade iv (or implied from last_price x last_index if iv <= 0), repriced with Black-76 at the 08:00 F and T (IV transport, so the trade's index timing does not matter). (2) model: 3-point smile from ATM / RR25 / BF25 (sigma_25C = ATM + BF + RR/2, sigma_25P = ATM + BF - RR/2, pillar strikes by Black-76 delta inversion at the pillar vols), quadratic in log-moneyness k = ln K/F through the three pillars, linear extrapolation outside the 25-delta pillars with the quadratic's slope there, floor 0.5 ATM, cap 3 ATM. Tenor: ATM total variance linear in T between 7/30/90 days, RR and BF linear in T, flat outside. After 2026-10-09 ATM = DVOL/100 for every tenor, RR / BF = last known. Model error reported vs every real 08:00 quote with 7-120 days and |delta| 0.05-0.95 (IV points and % of price).

COSTS. Per option leg per transaction (entry, exit, each scale-out third) = max(half-spread, 0.0003 BTC + 0.0125% x 1 BTC notional) in BTC per option, x S in USD; half-spread = the row's median |price - mark| (real) or the trailing-90-day median of real quotes in the same |delta| bucket (<0.35, 0.35-0.65, >0.65) for model-priced legs. Settlement at expiry costs nothing. Perp / spot: 5 bps of notional per side; perp funding from Bybit BTCUSDT funding events in (entry, exit], long pays positive rates.

P&L UNITS. USD per 1-BTC option (V_usd = Black-76 value; BTC price = V_usd / S). Primary USD (linear) P&L; BTC-settled P&L = sum of (V1/S1 - V0/S0) - costs in BTC, also reported. H-OPX1 primary = net USD P&L / entry USD premium. H-OPX2 primary = USD P&L / S0 (% of notional).

H-OPX1. Long ATM straddle, 14-day hold, exit at the day-14 08:00 quotes. Hedged variant: daily at fixings 0..13, perp hedge h_k = -delta_straddle at that day's straddle IV (tiered), P&L on Bybit 08:00 opens, 5 bps on every change incl. open and unwind, funding. Test: block bootstrap by ISO week (B = 5000) of mean(event days) - mean(all days), 95% percentile CI; both variants; verdict on the hedged one. In-sample: supports if diff > 0 and CI lo > 0, contradicts if diff <= 0, else inconclusive. Holdout: fewer than 8 events -> inconclusive; else supports if diff > 0, contradicts if <= 0.

H-OPX2. Structure +1 call(25d) -1 put(-0.85d); comparator +1 call + n perp, n = -delta_put at entry (same initial net delta). Paired diff = P&L(short put) - P&L(n perp incl. costs and funding), % of S0. Primary hold 14 days; to-expiry variant reported. Both segments need diff > 0 with the 95% week-block bootstrap CI above 0 (holdout: < 8 events inconclusive). Unconditional all-days version reported (and recorded in the metrics). Also reported: net delta, vega (USD per vol point) and theta of call alone / call + perp / user structure at entry; time value share of the short put premium = (P - max(K - F, 0)) / P.

H-OPX3. Origins daily 08:00 UTC, Bybit BTCUSDT 1h; H = 1/3/7 days. Model = field_study.LogHarT (log-HAR-t + constant Kou, the project's implementation) with Z = [1, ln RV24, ln RV168/7, ln RV720/30 (field_study.har_regressors), 6 origin-weekday dummies]; one model per H on R_H; expanding window, refit on the 1st of each month on origins whose target ended before the refit, first fit after 365 days of origins. Up event R_H(t) > Q_q(t), down event R_H(t) < Q_(1-q)(t), q in {50,75,90,95,99}; forward = d x R_H(t+H) / sd(t+H) (predictive sd at the next origin). Stats: cluster t with calendar blocks of max(7, 2H) days (verdict), NW t also reported. Trend: OLS slope of the five conditional means on q-rank 0..4, 90% block-bootstrap CI (B = 2000); positive if slope > 0 and CI lo > 0. Horizon H qualifies for continuation if at every q in {90,95,99} with >= 10 events (q = 90 must have >= 10) mean > 0 and t > 2, and the trend is positive; reversal if mean < 0 and t < -2 at those q (trend negative). Supports if >= 2 of 3 horizons qualify for continuation; contradicts if >= 2 qualify for reversal; else inconclusive. Segment by origin; origins before the cutoff whose forward window crosses it are dropped. ETH reported, not recorded separately.

H-OPX4. Trend book: UNIV_L (23 crypto perps) x the 8 H-PD6 trend strategies, own exits (orig), panel as_of and execution (strategy_pnl, 7.5 bps per side). Ex-ante distribution = the H-OPX3 1-day model fitted per symbol; threshold at elapsed tau hours = Qz(0.95) x s x sqrt(tau / 24), s from the latest origin <= entry. At the first three closes where side x ln(close/entry) exceeds it: limit for 1/3 of the initial position at that close, filled only if the next bar trades through (high > limit for longs, low < limit for shorts); unfilled = cancelled; the remainder follows the strategy. R = (gross - cost) / sqrt(bars per day). Option arm: H-OPX1 unhedged straddles and H-OPX2 structures (events and all days), daily 08:00 marks; threshold = 95th percentile of the ex-ante P&L distribution (the predictive R_tau, sqrt-time from the 1-day model, mapped through Black-76 at the entry IVs); each leg's third is a limit at its mark, filled only if a trade in the next 24 h prints through it (no trades = no fill). Primary verdict on the trend book: weekly-cluster bootstrap (B = 5000) of the mean per-trade diff; supports if diff > 0 and CI lo > 0; contradicts if diff <= 0; else inconclusive (holdout < 8 trades inconclusive).

DOWNSIDE PLAN (descriptive only, not a hypothesis). Bearish-compression event = compression event whose BTC return entry 08:00 -> next day 08:00 is < 0. At day 1 08:00 add protection: buy 0.5 x 25-delta puts (same expiry) and short 0.25 perp. At the first later daily mark where the protection's open P&L exceeds its ex-ante q95 P&L, buy spot equal to minus the protection's delta; then close a third of the protection and the spot hedge at each of the next three marks by limits (filled only if traded through within 24 h). Rest closed at day 14. Report structure alone vs with plan per event.

Segments everywhere: entry >= 2026-07-01 clean_holdout; exit < cutoff llm_in_sample; straddling dropped (H-OPX3 as above).

title: field_study.LogHarT crashes on daily fits of some alts (log of 0); guarded by clipping
body: Fitting the project's log-HAR-t (+ constant Kou) on DAILY 08:00 origins per symbol for H-OPX4, the L-BFGS search drove expit(p_up) to exactly 1.0 (one symbol) and exp(eta) to 0 (another), so kramers_moyal.jump_logpdf raised a math domain error. field_study.py is left untouched; options_compression wraps it in a subclass that clips p_up to [1e-9, 1-1e-9] and the Kou rates to [1e-6, 1e6] (identical output whenever the original runs; the 15 symbols fitted before the guard did not hit the bounds). Also noted, not changed: on daily BTC data the jump-branch weight p sits at its 0.3 upper bound (nu ~2.9), i.e. the 'jump' branch acts as a second, wider scale component; the predictive distribution is still a proper fitted mixture and its calibration is reported. No results had been looked at.

title: OPX results: long vol after compression inconclusive, short deep-ITM put loses to the perp at events, no tail reversal, scaling out hurts
body:
OPX block results (recorded 2026-11-14 19:05 UTC; report research/reports/options_compression_2026-11-14.{md,json}).

Data: Deribit BTC option trades 2020-01..2026-11-13 from history.deribit.com, 24,247,567 trades -> 5.34 M instrument-hour rows, 209 MB (82 complete months + partial Nov). 54 compression events (48 llm_in_sample, 6 clean_holdout), 2,104 entry days. Smile model (3-point quadratic in log-moneyness from ATM/RR25/BF25) vs 239,718 real 08:00 quotes: IV bias +0.14 vol pts, median |err| 1.09, RMSE 3.82, median |price err| 3.2% (strikes like the short put: 1.07 vol pts, 0.0007 BTC).

H-OPX1 (long ATM straddle 14 d, event - all days, net/premium): llm_in_sample hedged -0.039 vs -0.064, diff +0.025, 95% CI [-0.038, +0.094] -> inconclusive; unhedged diff +0.027 [-0.112, +0.185]; RV/IV median 0.85 events vs 0.82. clean_holdout 6 events -> inconclusive.
H-OPX2 (short -0.85d put minus same-delta perp, % of spot, 14 d, events): llm_in_sample -0.33 [-1.07, +0.25] (median +0.38, 69% > 0) -> contradicts; all days +0.29 [+0.07, +0.48]; to expiry -0.86. clean_holdout 6 events -0.67 -> inconclusive (all days -0.40).
Greeks at events: call delta 0.24 / vega 0.094% spot per vol pt; call + perp delta 1.09 / vega 0.094; user structure delta 1.09 / vega 0.024 (-74%); put vega / call vega 0.74; put time value 5.6% of its premium (1.06% of spot of 19.7%). Correction to the main-session framing: the short deep-ITM put DOES cut net vega by about three quarters (it is short vega), but by turning the position into a ~1.1-delta long future with short convexity.
BTC vs USD: unhedged event straddle +0.9% (USD) vs +3.8% (BTC) of premium; user structure -1.79% vs -2.19% of spot (corr 0.999).
H-OPX3 (BTC, log-HAR-t x weekday, signed next-H z): no horizon qualifies in-sample (3 d: q90 +0.149 t 2.05, q95 +0.207 t 2.24, q99 +0.305 t 1.91, slope +0.068 CI90 [+0.014, +0.124]; 1 d q90 +0.10 t 1.88; 7 d ~0) -> inconclusive; holdout only 3 d qualifies (q90 +0.65, n 12) -> inconclusive. No reversal anywhere. ETH same 3-day pattern. Predictive quantiles well calibrated (1 d: 9.2% beyond two-sided q95).
H-OPX4 (thirds at the first three closes beyond ex-ante q95, limit filled only if traded through): trend book llm_in_sample -0.0036 R/trade [-0.026, +0.014], 68,641 trades -> contradicts; clean_holdout -0.0081 [-0.089, +0.042], 6,933 -> contradicts. Triggered trades win 74% but lose on average (-0.018 R). Options all days -0.24% (straddle, CI [-0.45, -0.05]) and -0.39% (user, [-0.70, -0.12]).
Downside plan (DESCRIPTIVE, 27 bearish-compression events): worst structure loss -37.2% -> -29.0% of spot; protection held +0.63% mean, with spot hedge + scale-out +0.07% (the scale-out gives back 12-72% of crash gains); costs 0.7-3.6% of spot in 11 of 12 rebounds.

Rule candidates R-OPX-1..5 in the report (validated with rules.validate; not merged into research/rules.yaml).

title: Correction: the short deep-ITM put does cut vega
body: I told the user the short deep-ITM put barely changes volatility exposure. The OPX Greeks show it cuts the structure vega by about 74% versus the 25-delta call alone (put vega ~0.74 of the call vega), because a -0.85 delta put still carries meaningful vega. The rest of the explanation held: only 5.6% of its premium is time value, the structure is a ~1.1-delta long future, and it loses to a same-delta perp at compression events. Merged R-OPX-1..5 (2 and 3 and 5 provisional, grade C); BELIEFS OX1.

title: H-EXE1 / H-MMR3 design frozen before any P&L (limit vs market entries; regime-gated quoting)
body:
Agent EXE. Design frozen before any P&L (data/research/execution/design.json; signals.json; gates/summary.json). Research only: no orders.

H-EXE1 (limit at the touch vs market entry)
- Signals: agent.session.analyse at every 4h slot (00/04/08/12/16/20 UTC), as_of = slot + 5 min, BTC/ETH/SOL, 2026-01-05 .. 2026-11-13,
  stop cap 4 sigma (H-STOP1 prior), prior edges. Kept: not blocked by the session (weekend S4, min stop distance), net E[R] > 0 (paper gate),
  trend_4h only at onset (no kept same-side trend candidate at the previous slot); shock_regime candidates are new by construction.
  Fast path (frames truncated at known_ts <= as_of) checked equal to the slow as-of read on 36 random slot x symbol cases.
  Result: 275 signals (shock_regime 125, trend_4h 150; BTC 78, ETH 109, SOL 88) on 245 symbol-days; 159 before 2026-07-01 (llm_in_sample), 116 after (clean_holdout).
  No price after as_of was read to build the set.
- Arms: market = taker order executed 150 ms after t0 = as_of against the replayed ob200 book (walks levels, VWAP); limit_N = PostOnly at the
  touch, re-pegged by amend to the touch when it moves away (back of the new queue, 150 ms latency, one amend in flight), cancel sent at
  t0 + N min, N in {1, 5, 15}; partial fills kept; unfilled = 0 R. New Rust CLI atx exec-replay (reuses mm_replay::Market / Queue).
- Queue: pro-rata primary; pessimistic and optimistic reported.
- Size: risk-engine fixed risk 0.5% x 10,000 USDT / (|entry - stop| + entry x 15 bp), same qty in every arm.
- Costs: limit fills maker 2.0 bp, market taker 5.5 bp + the real book's slippage; exits taker 5.5 + 2.0 bp slippage in every arm.
- Exits: the sleeve's own stop / target. Same day: first print at/through either in the tape (that print's price); later: lake 1h bars,
  stop first, gaps fill at the open; still open at the last bar = marked at the close.
- Statistic: paired per-signal net R difference limit_N - market, sleeves pooled, day-clustered bootstrap B = 10000. Verdict per segment:
  supports if any N has mean > 0 with the 95% CI above 0 (pro-rata); contradicts if every N's CI is below 0; else inconclusive.
- Missed winners: share unfilled / partial per N and their market-arm outcome (mean R, share > 0, share reaching the target).

H-MMR3 (regime-gated market making)
- Agent M's 80 symbol-days and split (BTCUSDT + TRX/ETC/XLM, fit 10-25..11-03, held 11-04..11-13), re-downloaded (my manifest
  data/research/execution/manifest.json; agent M's first download is in theirs). Same replay (atx mm-replay), now with a per-variant gate input
  (VariantSpec.gate / gate_flatten; live mm.rs untouched).
- Gate (decision minute t, bars closed by t only; thresholds from FIT days):
  V: RV60 (60 closed 1m returns) <= its fit-day 1/3 quantile;  R: |4h log return| < sqrt(48) x sigma_5m (RMS of the 24 h of 5m returns);
  S: no clock hour with |r_1h| >= 4 x sqrt(12) sigma_5m closed in the last 6 h;
  J (pre-declared): BTCUSDT = the field's P(jump next hour) from the frozen pre-cutoff fit (btc_field_cutoff_2026-07-01.json) <= its fit-day
  median; TRX/ETC/XLM (no field) = Hawkes-type excitation sum 2^(-(t - t_j)/60 min) over jump minutes (|r_1m| > 4 sigma_1m) <= its fit-day median.
  BTC with the Hawkes J is a secondary variant. Gate on = V and R and S and J. Off: exit-only quotes (live wind-down path); `_flat` variants
  close at market when the gate turns off with inventory.
  Fit-day thresholds: BTC rv60 q33 0.00235, P(jump) median 0.0160; TRX 0.00197 / lambda 0.112; ETC 0.00369 / 0.095; XLM 0.00504 / 0.064.
  Gate on share (all days): BTC 0.16, TRX 0.24, ETC 0.17, XLM 0.15.
- Widths: primary = agent M's fit-day choices (BTC L_k1_live, illiquid L_k1_sym); secondary F_w12_sym, F_w24_sym; single-component gates at the
  primary width. Ungated reruns must reproduce agent M's numbers exactly (check).
- Test: gated(all) - ungated at the primary width, paired per symbol-day on held days, pro-rata, day-clustered bootstrap B = 10000, per group.
  supports if > 0 with CI above 0 in at least one group; contradicts if CI below 0 in both; else inconclusive. Segment: clean_holdout.

Data handling: one symbol-day at a time per worker (2 workers, single-threaded replays), ob200 + trades downloaded, all replays the day needs
run, verified (0 engine rejects / trades, replayer checks equal, ledger identity), raw deleted; transient raw cap 2 GB; private binary
data/research/execution/bin/atx-exe.exe (release build from a private target dir).

title: H-EXE1 supports (+0.01 R, fee-driven, no missed fills); H-MMR3 inconclusive (the gate stops trading; loss limiter at tight widths)
body:
Agent EXE. Results of the frozen design (diary 2026-11-14 23:00 UTC). 319 symbol-days replayed (55.4 GB downloaded one day at a time and deleted; 0 failures, 0 raw left).

H-EXE1 supports (llm_in_sample, clean_holdout, pooled). 275 signals (125 shock_regime, 150 trend_4h; BTC/ETH/SOL 2026-01-05..11-13):
- every PostOnly limit at the touch (re-pegged) filled, under all three queue models, median 1-3 s, max 37 s: N = 1/5/15 min identical, 0 missed winners.
- limit - market, pro-rata, pooled sleeves: +0.010 R/signal [95% CI +0.009, +0.012]; llm_in_sample +0.008 [+0.006, +0.010]; clean_holdout +0.014 [+0.012, +0.015].
- split: fee gap (maker 2.0 vs taker 5.5 bp) +0.015 R, worse price -0.005 R (the pegged limit fills 1.1-1.6 bp beyond the decision-time mid vs 0.1-0.3 bp for the market order; spreads 0.01-1.1 bp). shock_regime +0.016 R, trend_4h +0.006 R (tighter stops).
- Small and fee-driven; holds at paper-book order values (0.7-8k USDT) on majors with virtual orders.

H-MMR3 inconclusive (clean_holdout). Gate = bottom-tercile 60-min vol AND |4h ret| < 1 sigma AND no 4-sigma hourly shock in 6 h AND jump intensity <= fit median (BTC field P(jump), illiquid Hawkes 1m-jump excitation); open 11-18% of held minutes.
- live width: the gate removes ~all fills (BTC 0/day, illiquid 0.2/day); gated - ungated BTC -0.039 USD/symbol-day [-0.173, +0.103], illiquid -0.002 [-0.011, +0.009].
- tight widths (secondary): the gate cuts the loss (BTC F_w12 +1.35 [+1.04, +1.54], illiquid F_w12 +0.58 [+0.40, +0.75]) by removing ~99% of fills, but gated quoting still loses (illiquid F_w12 -0.011 [-0.020, -0.005]); in quiet phases spread captured (+0.011) ~ adverse 1 s (-0.012) per day, so the 2 bp maker fee is not covered. Quiet phases reduce adverse selection (ungated ratio 0.30 / 0.50) but not enough.
- ungated reruns reproduce agent M exactly on 78/80 symbol-days (TRX 10-30 / 11-01 differ: agent M ran them without warm-up bars).

Rule candidates R-EXE-1, R-EXE-2, R-MMR-5 (C, provisional), R-MMR-6 in the report (validated; not merged into research/rules.yaml).

The AI book had 0 trades, so no track record was lost.

- config/risk.yaml paper_entry: {mode: pegged_limit, slip_bps: 1.3, window_min: 15}. Both sleeves send entry {type:
  limit, peg: touch}.
- at-risk costs a pegged entry as maker + 1.3 bp; the exit stays taker + slippage. The paper EV gate (> 0), the stop cap
  and the edge posteriors are unchanged.
- at-exec PaperBook fills it at the first 1h open after the decision, 1.3 bp adverse, as maker (fees.yaml).
- Approximation, decided here: there are no 1m bars, so the 15-minute window lies inside that bar, and the fill is taken
  even when the bar range never reaches the peg price. Requiring the range to contain the price would drop exactly the
  entries whose price moved toward the resting order (those would really fill, often as early losers), biasing the book

title: RB design frozen before results: post-cascade flush study (H-RB1/2/3)
body:
Agent RB. Frozen before any outcome is computed (only data coverage was probed). Code: src/ai_trader/research/post_cascade_study.py; design copied to data/research/post_cascade/design.json.
Universe L (trend_zoo_study.UNIVERSE, 23 perps). market_frame(sym,'4h',now) with funding + 4h OI as-of joined on known_ts; v0 cell = regimes.label(frame, 4.0) (reused, not rebuilt). 1h bars only to resolve trade paths.
FLUSH at 4h close t: r48 = ln(c_t/c_{t-12}) < 5th pct of r48 over the trailing 365 d ending at t-1 (min 180 d of history); OI_t / max(OI_{t-17..t}) - 1 <= -5%; cell_t == R9; decluster: first qualifying bar, then none for 7 d (42 bars) per asset.
Sigma = 4h sigma_risk_next at the entry bar (the paper book's trend_4h per-bar risk sigma); distances in log units. Stops: structural extreme with a 0.5 sigma buffer, pulled in to 4 sigma if farther (cap_stop semantics), blocked if < 0.5 sigma. Target 2R, time stop 120 h. Paths walked on 1h bars from the entry close: stop checked before target in each hour (worst case), stop fills at min(open, stop) for longs (gap-through), target fills at the target, time exit at the 120th hour's close; trades whose path runs past the data are unresolved and dropped. Costs 7.5 bp per side (taker 5.5 + slip 2.0); variant pegged-limit entry = maker 2.0 + 1.3 bp slip (risk.yaml paper_entry), exit unchanged. R = (d*(exit-entry) - c_in*entry - c_out*exit) / (|entry-stop| + entry*(c_in+c_out)).
H-RB1: long at the close of bar t+1 (the first 4h close after the event is known); flush low = min low t-11..t+1; stop = low*exp(-0.5 sigma).
H-RB2: within 42 bars after t: running post-flush low L_k = min low t-11..k; rebound armed at the first close >= L_k*exp(1.5 sigma_t); then the first cross-down (close_k < EMA20_k and close_{k-1} >= EMA20_{k-1}, EMA20 of 4h closes, k-1 >= arm bar); short at close_k; rebound high = max high from the low bar to k; stop = high*exp(+0.5 sigma). No arm or no cross within 42 bars = no trade.
Baselines (RB1/RB2): one random 4h close per asset per UTC date (seed 20261115) on non-event days (no flush of that asset within +-7 d); long geometry = stop below the min low of the 13 bars ending at entry, short = above the max high of the 13 bars; same buffer/cap/target/time stop. RB1 matched on asset + cell R9 + segment; RB2 matched on asset + entry cell + segment. Paired difference = mean_i (R_i - baseline mean of its match cell); match cells with < 5 baseline trades fall back to asset + segment.
H-RB3: among flush events, pattern = first close k in t+1..t+18 with funding (latest print known) < its trailing-90 d 10th pct of prints AND OI_k / min(OI_t..k) - 1 >= 3%. Outcome = ln(c_{k+h}/c_k) / (sigma_k*sqrt(h)) for h = 6, 18 bars (24 h, 72 h). Control for a pattern event with lag L = mean over no-pattern events of the same segment of the same return anchored at their t+L. Difference = mean over pattern events.
Inference: cluster bootstrap by ISO week of the event/entry (all assets share a week cluster), 5000 reps, 95% percentile CI, seed 20261115; baseline pool resampled by week too. Segments by entry/anchor date vs 2026-07-01. Verdict per segment: supports = success criterion met; contradicts = point estimate <= 0 with the 95% CI entirely below 0 (RB1/RB2: mean R or paired diff; RB3: both horizons' differences); else inconclusive. Pegged variant reported, verdict on 7.5 bp. Extras: events by asset x year; v0 cell at +1/+3/+7 d (6/18/42 bars) after events, pooled and BTC; post-flush path over 7 d (max drawdown from the event close to the low, rebound from the low to the later max high, hours to the low). Everything pooled and BTC alone (BTC alone is descriptive: few events). Current episode 2026-11-13..15 (BTC/ETH/SOL), liquidation prints and nearest neighbours (z-scored features r48/(sigma*sqrt12), OI drawdown, funding pct rank in 90 d, 30 d vol-scaled return; Euclidean, k = 5) are descriptive only, chosen after the fact. Trial count: 3 hypotheses x 2 segments x 2 cost variants (+ BTC-only descriptive).

title: Live network v2 settings pre-declared (before the first v2 line)
body: v2 (model id live_nn.v2, config/live_nn_v2.yaml, config hash 1adb8e380642c015) runs in parallel with v1; v1 is computed and written first and is unchanged (its code file and hash are untouched). Same frozen PNN 1h/1d checkpoints, features, rolling-day 24h construction and field as v1; only the conformal layer differs. (1) ACI: same Gibbs-Candes update and CQR scores, gamma 0.02 for 1h (v1 0.005) and 0.02/24 per resolved 24h forecast (v1 0.005/24), windows 1440/2000, warm-started from the same source as v1 (latent_1h/latent_1d.parquet, F2 walk-forward stream); the ACI stream is updated with the miscoverage of its own pre-floor band. (2) Jump-cluster floor, 1h only: active for bar S when any of bars S-6h..S-1h had |z|>3 with z = r / sigma_eff, sigma_eff = (hi80-lo80)/2.5631 of the v2 issued 80% band of that bar; while active each issued band half-width >= z_q x max(net sigma, field 1h sd, H-NN10 ML sigma) (z_q 1.2816/1.6449/1.9600), widened symmetrically about the ACI band midpoint. Field omitted if fitted after as_of; H-NN10 used if its newest line logged by as_of has forecast_for >= S-1h; bars with no issued v2 line (warm-up, missed hours) use net and H-NN10 only. title: Post-cascade study: rebound long after a flush loses in both segments; failed-rebound short ~breakeven; neg funding + OI rebuild is no squeeze signal

body: Replay of live_nn.v2 (cfg 1adb8e380642c015) over the 38 bars 11-13 20:00 to 11-15 09:00 (as_of S+3 min, all flagged replay, no verdict). Same bars, 1h, n 37: coverage v1 ACI vs v2 issued 80% 0.595 vs 0.676, 90% 0.730 vs 0.838, 95% 0.838 vs 0.892; band pinball (6 endpoints) 0.1324 vs 0.1381 (d +0.0056, NW t 0.40): v2 is better at 80% (0.191 vs 0.176) and 90% (0.131 vs 0.123) but worse at 95% (0.076 vs 0.116), because with gamma 0.02 the 95% alpha_t goes below 0 after a miss (each miss -0.019, each hit +0.001) and the ACI then issues the window's largest CQR score: v2 1h 95% band ~+-11% now. 80% width 1.17 vs 1.63. The jump floor was active on 18 of 38 bars and bound on 13 (mostly the 80% band). 24h, n 14: identical (no 24h forecast resolves in the first 24 h, so both run on the same warm state). Not changing v2 (a fix such as clipping alpha_t is a v3). Same for OI at 1h (the updater keeps 4h). Not changed (updater config and schema untouched).

title: Live network v2.1: issue-alpha floor before any live v2 line
body: Made at 09:33 UTC, before any live v2 line (all 38 v2 lines were replays). Reason: with gamma 0.02 the 95% alpha_t went below 0 after misses, and alpha_t < 0 makes the ACI interval infinite (the implementation then issues the largest CQR score in the 1440-h window: 1h 95% band about +-11%). Rule (v2.1, config hash 2d4ba801a6363fe9, model id live_nn.v2.1): bands are ISSUED at alpha_eff = max(alpha_t, nominal_alpha/4) = 0.05 / 0.025 / 0.0125 for 80 / 90 / 95, on both horizons, so no band is issued at or beyond its 98.75% score quantile; the jump-cluster floor then applies to the 1h band as before. The ACI state is unchanged: unclipped alpha_t, updated on the pre-floor ACI band. Everything else as v2 (cfg 1adb8e380642c015). The v2 replay lines, scores and state are archived (not deleted) in data/journal/live_nn_v2/archive_live_nn.v2_cfg1adb8e380642c015_replay/; v2.1 is replayed from 2026-11-13 20:00 UTC as replay lines (no verdict). v1 untouched.

title: XS v3 design frozen (H-XS1..H-XS3)
body:
Design of the cross-sectional network v3 (H-XS1..H-XS3), fixed before the config search and before any fit is evaluated. Code: src/ai_trader/ml/xs_net.py, src/ai_trader/research/xs_network_study.py (docstrings hold the full spec); tests tests/test_xs_net.py.

Data: universe L (23 perps, trend_zoo_study.UNIVERSE), Bybit 1h market_frame as of 2026-11-15 10:00 UTC with funding and 4h OI. Panel 2021-05-25 .. 2026-11-14 (48,002 hours, 974,796 token-hours; an hour is used iff >= 5 tokens are present). Decision at the open of hour t; inputs from bars <= t-1 and prints known by the close of t-1; segment = decision time vs the 2026-07-01 cutoff.
Features (38 per token): the 19 ml.hourly features (lsig2, lfac, funding-hour flags, lu_1..lu_24, lu_m6, lu_m24, jump24, since_jump, har_d/w/m, dow), lfac4, lfac24 (hour-of-week factor over the next 4/24 h, profile as of t), hod sin/cos, own returns ret{1,4,24,168}_z, relative returns rel{1,4,24,168}_z (token minus equal-weight universe, in units of sqrt(h) s_t), rolling 720h betas to BTC and to the EW universe, funding level (bp) and 90d z, OI 4h/24h log changes + flag. Sector = config/sectors.yaml overrides (8 sectors). Market token: 8 cross-sectional features (EW returns 1/4/24/168h, mean lu_1, mean lsig2, 24h dispersion, share present).
Targets: vol a_h = |R_h| / sqrt(h s2) for h = 1, 4, 24 (quantiles 5..95); relative return rel_h = R_i - mean_U R_j (U = tokens present with a target) for h = 4, 24, standardised by sqrt(h) s_t (quantiles 10/50/90); pairwise P(i beats j) = Phi((m_i - m_j)/sqrt(s_i^2 + s_j^2)) from the rel heads.
Network: shared encoder (KAN Chebyshev deg 4 + SiLU, 38 -> 8), sector embeddings, market token (linear 8 -> 8), one 2-head attention layer over present tokens + market token, head KAN [z, a] (16) -> 27. Parameters 4,147. Comparison arm mlp_mix: equal-size ReLU MLP encoder (hidden 32) and head (hidden 49), 4,127 parameters. Ablation kan_nomix: keys restricted to the token itself (same 4,147 parameters, no cross-token information).
Training: summed pinball over the 5 heads, AdamW, batch 64 hours, epoch = 8,192 random training hours, max 60 epochs, patience 6, grad clip 5; torch 2 threads. Quarterly expanding refits; training hours with t + 24h <= quarter start - 1 day; validation = last 15% of training days (purged 1 day) for early stopping only; standardisation on the fit block; inputs clipped +/- 6. Warm start from the previous refit (same arm and seed). Seeds 3 per arm, quantiles averaged. First test quarter 2022Q3 (>= 365 training days): 16 in-sample refits 2022Q3..2026Q2, 2 holdout refits 2026Q3, 2026Q4 with the frozen configuration. Config search (in-sample, equal effort): lr {1e-3, 3e-3} x wd {1e-4, 1e-2} for kan_mix and mlp_mix, seed 0, first test quarter's training rows (80/20 purged split); kan_nomix uses kan_mix's config.
Baselines: H-XS1 mom24 (past 24h relative return), mom7d (past 168h), rev1 (minus past 1h), best per horizon chosen on the in-sample IC and reused in the holdout. H-XS2 panel log-HAR-t x hour-of-week per horizon (pooled OLS of log(a_h^2) on [1, lsig2, lfac_h, har_d, har_w, har_m], QLIKE-optimal constant, zero-location Student-t by MLE; magnitude quantiles from the folded t), refitted on each refit's training rows.
Tests: H-XS1 non-overlapping origins (4h: 00/04/..; 24h: 00 UTC), Spearman IC per origin, per-day mean, NW t; success IC > 0 and IC - best > 0 each with t > 2 at >= 1 horizon in both segments. H-XS2 vol pinball v3 - HAR per token-origin at 1h (every hour) and 4h (00/04/..), per-day mean, NW t; success diff < 0, t < -2 at >= 1 horizon in both segments. H-XS3 pinball kan_nomix - kan_mix on non-BTC tokens at the same horizons; success diff > 0, t > 2 at >= 1 horizon in both segments (IC part reported). Contradicts = at every horizon the point estimate is on the wrong side. Holm over H-XS1..3 per segment. Pooled: supports iff both support, contradicts iff either contradicts. Descriptive: IC by sector / BTC v0 cell, attention maps (all hours and v0 high-vol cells R3/R6/R9; ETH/SOL hub test = per-day received-attention ratio vs the other tokens, NW t), pairwise accuracy/Brier, top-minus-bottom quintile spread net of 7.5 bp per side per leg with turnover, ACI (gamma 0.005, window 500 origins) on the 80% rel band per token, 2D PCA map of token representations, KAN vs MLP. clean_holdout is read once after the in-sample results are recorded.

title: XS v3 IC is a median / low-vol effect; simple-return spread is ~0 gross
body: Before the holdout: the v3 rank IC is mostly a low-volatility / low-beta ranking. -lsig2 alone has IC 4h 0.0399 (t 11.83), 24h 0.0727 (t 8.59); v3 - low-vol 4h 0.0155 (t 7.37), 24h 0.0046 (t 1.23). IC is concentrated in BTC, TRX, BNB, ENA (24h token contributions 0.23, 0.19, 0.14, 0.21) and is flat across years (0.053-0.060 at 4h). Rank IC is invariant to log vs simple returns, but the money is not: the top-minus-bottom quintile spread in simple returns is gross 0.14 bp / 4h and -6.98 bp / 24h (net -11.75 / -19.44 bp at 7.5 bp/side/leg); low-vol alone -2.50 / -7.83 bp gross. Reading: high-vol alts land below the cross-sectional median more often but carry the right tail, so median-rank skill does not convert into a positive mean spread. I added the simple-return spread, a low-vol ranking and the v3 - low-vol IC difference to the evaluation as descriptive outputs after this in-sample look; they are not part of any verdict and the holdout rules are unchanged. Attention: BTC and TRX are the hubs (received-from-others ratio 2.25 / 2.28 vs uniform 1); ETH and SOL receive less than average (hub t -13.5 / -24.0), unlike the R-SPILL transmitter finding.

title: XS v3 holdout: H-XS1 and H-XS2 hold, H-XS3 contradicts; IC is mostly low-vol and the spread is negative
body: clean_holdout (2026Q3 + 2026Q4 to 2026-11-14, 138 days, 2 refits with the frozen configuration), read once. H-XS1 supports (Holm p 0.009): rank IC v3 4h 0.052 (t 4.14), 24h 0.061 (t 2.26); best baseline rev1 0.023 / 0.017; v3 - rev1 4h +0.029 (t 2.61), 24h +0.043 (t 1.39). But a pure low-vol ranking (-lsig2) has IC 0.039 / 0.060 and v3 - low-vol is +0.013 (t 2.37) at 4h and +0.001 (t 0.08) at 24h. The MLP arm beats the KAN arm on IC (4h 0.069, 24h 0.094; KAN - MLP t -2.8 / -2.0). H-XS2 supports (Holm p 0.001): vol pinball v3 - panel log-HAR-t 1h -0.0022 (t -3.39, 1.4%), 4h -0.0002 (t -0.19, 0.1%); 24h descriptive +0.0009 (worse). MLP - HAR 1h t -4.58; KAN - MLP 1h +0.00066 (t 2.84): the MLP is better. Recipe brain_recipe.v1 (H-BR1, fixed before any checkpoint data): u = r_p^2 / (f s2) replaces the last-bar return in lu_1 and its 1/6 and 1/24 shares of lu_m6 / lu_m24; the partial-hour range from the open (max(ln H/P0, ln P0/L) > 4 s_pre) sets jump24 and since_jump; the other 14 inputs are frozen; frozen inputs for the first 5 min. Nowcast and frozen remaining-hour quantiles are both scaled by sqrt(1 - f).

Neuron atlas (descriptive; 2025-01..2026-11, which is fit/validation for this net): lfac is the top input of all 8 latent units; the hemispheres duplicate two units with the sign flipped (A.z1 ~ -B.z1 r=-0.96, A.z3 ~ -B.z2 r=-0.94); either seed alone costs only +0.08% pinball; no unit is sparse (|a|>1sd in 27-31% of hours); unit ablations are <= 0.3% of pinball against a 3.8% edge over constant quantiles; dead inputs fund_before, jump24, lu_24, har_d (< 0.03%). z4 is each hemisphere's median/skew channel and carries the after-jump memory. Proposed (not registered) growth steps are in the report: drop dead inputs, move lfac into the scale, 1m-RV last-hour input, macro-event flag, one seed with latent 5.

title: FinancialJuice RSS ingestion stopped at the access check (ToS forbids automated collection)
body:
Agent FJ was asked to build a 20-30 s poller of FinancialJuice headlines. Access check on 2026-11-15 ~16:05 UTC, before any ingestion code was written:
- robots.txt: HTTP 404 (none published), so no robots rules either way.
- The official RSS feed (homepage footer link https://www.financialjuice.com/feed.ashx?xy=rss) exists: RSS 2.0, 100 items, fields title/link/guid(numeric id)/pubDate/author, description empty, no category or importance marker. On a Sunday the 100 items covered about 38 h. guid ids have gaps, so the feed looks like a subset of the site stream. No ETag or Last-Modified headers; If-Modified-Since is ignored (always 200, about 42 KB). lastBuildDate is the generation time, not the time of the last item.
- ToS (tos.aspx), Access to the Service: "a limited, revocable, nonexclusive license to access and use the Service and the Content for your own personal use. This license does not include any collection, aggregation, copying, duplication, display or derivative use of the Service nor any use of data mining, robots, spiders, or similar data gathering and extraction tools for any purpose unless expressly permitted by FinancialJuice in writing." Proprietary Rights: copying Content "to any other server or location for non-personal use, is prohibited without the express written consent".
Decision: a 24/7 poller that archives, classifies and feeds headlines to a trading desk is automated collection plus derivative use, so per the brief's stop rule nothing was built or run. Options for the user: written permission from FJ (the contact page invites partnership enquiries), a licensed headline API (Newsquawk, Benzinga, LSEG MRN), or sources that allow automated use (Bybit v5 announcements, Fed/ECB press RSS with ETag, CryptoPanic API).

title: ANALOG design frozen before results (multi-scale analog search + H-ANA1)
body:
Agent ANALOG. Frozen before any distance, ranking or outcome is computed (copied to data/research/analogs/design.json).

Data (deviation from the brief, data availability only): the lake has no Binance BTC 1h (venue=binance holds only ETHUSDT 1h 2017-08..2026-08). Not backfilled (user leads data). BTC 1h = Deribit BTC-PERPETUAL for bars before the first Bybit BTCUSDT 1h bar (2020-01-01..2020-03-25 10:00), Bybit BTCUSDT after. So H-ANA1's "2019-2026" becomes 2021-02..2026-11 (the log-HAR-t needs 365 d before its first refit). Funding: Bybit from 2020-03-25; OI: Bybit 4h from 2020-08-04, both as-of joined on known_ts. Missing state features are re-weighted (distance averaged over the features both hours have), not dropped; coverage reported per year.

Grid: hourly, t = bar close time. Scales L = 6, 24, 72, 168, 720 h.
- Shape: cumulative log close path over [t-L, t] (hourly closes, gaps forward-filled, invalid if > 10% missing), linearly resampled to N = 7 points (6h) or 25 points (others); d_shape = 1 - Pearson(now, cand).
- Amplitude: A = (max - min of the hourly path) / (sigma_ref * sqrt(L)), sigma_ref = sd of hourly log returns over the 720 h ending at t-L (>= 336 obs); d_amp = |ln(A_now / A_cand)|.
- State (same for all scales): rv_pct = percentile of the 24h realised vol in its trailing 365 d of hourly values (>= 60 d); dd30 = ln(close / max high of the last 720 h); v0 cell on 1h bars (regimes.label, bar_hours 1) as dir in {-1,0,1} and vol in {-1,0,1}, weight 0.5 each; funding_pct = rank of the latest print in its trailing 90 d (>= 30 d); oi72 = ln(OI_t / OI_{t-72h}); weekend = calendar.tradfi_weekend. Each feature divided by its sd over the eligible pool; D_state = sqrt(sum w_j m_j dz_j^2 / sum w_j m_j), m_j = 1 if both hours have feature j, weights 1 (cell 0.5 + 0.5).
- d_s = 1.0 * d_shape + 0.5 * d_amp + 0.5 * D_state.
- Combined score = mean over the 5 scales of the percentile rank of d_s within the pool.
- Pool (descriptive): hours with all 5 scales valid and t <= now - 30 d. Decluster: greedy, at most one analog per 168 h. Top 20 per scale and combined.

Outcomes per analog: forward log returns +6/+24/+72/+168 h; max drawdown and max run-up (high/low vs the close at t) within 72 h and 7 d; 7 d realised vol; v0 cell at +1/+3/+7 d; whether the trailing 24 h (72 h) low was undercut before the trailing 24 h (72 h) high was exceeded, within 7 d; hours to the 7 d low. Aggregate: top-20 combined vs unconditional (every pool hour); band = 5-95% of the statistic over 5000 random sets of 20 pool hours (seed 20261115); analog CI = bootstrap of the 20.

H-ANA1 walk-forward (as registered): origins = daily 08:00 UTC closes (the log-HAR-t x weekday origins of options_compression.predictive, monthly expanding refits, 365 d warm-up). Pool for origin t: candidates c with c + 72 h <= t - 168 h (7-day embargo after the outcomes are known); feature sds from that pool. Analog variance forecast F_h = s168_t^2 * mean_k(R_k,h^2 / s168_k^2), s168^2 = mean squared hourly return over the trailing 168 h (vol-standardised). HAR forecast F_h = s^2 * E[u^2] from the refit's predictive grid. QLIKE = V/F - ln(V/F) - 1, V = R_h^2; d = QLIKE_analog - QLIKE_HAR per origin; NW t with lag 7 (24h) and 9 (72h); segments by origin date at 2026-07-01. Segment verdict: supports if d < 0 with t < -2 at both 24h and 72h; contradicts if at least one horizon has d > 0 with t > +2 and neither passes; else inconclusive. Secondary (reported, not used for the verdict): unscaled F_h = mean_k R_k,h^2. Sign: p_up = (ups + 1) / 22 over the 20 analogs; base rate = expanding up-fraction of prior origins whose outcome had resolved (0.5 until 30); Brier skill 1 - BS_analog / BS_base, 10-day moving-block bootstrap (5000) CI. Effective n reported as origins / horizon days and the NW-implied n.
Trials: 1 hypothesis x 2 segments x 2 horizons x (QLIKE + Brier), plus 1 secondary variant.

title: BOS family: frozen grid, execution arms, regimes and multiple-testing plan (before any result)
body:
Agent BOS. Frozen BEFORE any outcome is computed (only data coverage has been looked at). Implements block BOS of research/hypotheses.yaml (H-BOS1..5) exactly; the registration is not edited. Machine copy: data/research/bos/design.json. Code: src/ai_trader/research/bos_regimes_study.py (engine), bos_download.py (5m klines).

DATA
- Swing: lake bybit last-price 1h and 4h bars, universe L (23 crypto perps, trend_zoo_study.UNIVERSE), 2020-03 .. 2026-11-15, market_frame burn-in rules. TradFi perps (T, 16 symbols of vol_bos_study.UNIV_T, 1h from the lake, 4h aggregated from 1h) = robustness only, reported for the in-sample survivors.
- Intraday: Bybit public /v5/market/kline linear 5m, universe L, 2022-01-01 .. 2026-11-15, data/research/bos/bars/5m (+ manifest). 15m = aggregation of the 5m bars (4h-style truncate). No vecopen data is read.
- Funding: lake funding (bybit), charged per funding print held (side x rate), in R units.
- Intrabar: bar-level approximation, no 1m. The only same-bar ambiguity is a retest fill bar that also touches the stop; primary = stop-first (worst case), the fill-only (best case) bound is reported. Stops are intrabar (low/high through the stop, gap fills at the open); every other exit is decided on a close and filled at the next open.

VARIANT GRID (per timeframe; 60 variants x 4 timeframes {5m, 15m | 1h, 4h} = 240 variants)
- Structure (5): fractal swings k in {2, 3, 5} (features.vol_bos.fractal_pivots: confirmed k bars after the pivot, each level consumed once, vol_bos.structure); Donchian n in {20, 55}: up-break = close above max(high of the previous n bars), onset bar only (previous close not above its own channel); down symmetric.
- Signal (3): BoS = every structure break, traded in the break direction (both sides); CHoCH = a BoS against the direction of the previous BoS of the same structure; BoS+mom = BoS with side * log(c_t/c_{t-20}) / (sigma_bar * sqrt(20)) > 1.0 (sigma_bar = frame sigma_next, EWMA 0.94). One threshold, m = 20 bars, on every timeframe.
- Sigma unit for stops and trails: s_u = sigma_bar * sqrt(ref_minutes / bar_minutes) * close_t, ref = 60 min for intraday (5m, 15m), 240 min for swing (1h, 4h); fixed at the signal.
- Initial stop (all variants): the opposite structural level at the signal (fractal: last confirmed swing low / high; Donchian: n-bar low / high of bars t-n+1..t), distance from close_t clipped to [0.5, 4.0] s_u (risk.yaml placement bounds). 1 R = |close_t - stop| at the signal (same denominator for every execution arm of that signal).
- Exits (4), each with the hard stop and a max hold (intraday 1 day: 288 x 5m / 96 x 15m bars; swing 10 days: 240 x 1h / 60 x 4h bars): (a) opposite structure: close beyond the trailing structural level (fractal: latest confirmed opposite swing; Donchian: n-bar opposite channel of the previous n bars); (b) trail 2.5 s_u and (c) trail 4.0 s_u from the best close since entry (close-based; never tighter than 2.5, R-EXIT-2); (d) time: hard stop + max hold only.
- Every signal is its own trade (no overlap logic; same direction signals can stack). Trades not finished at the data end are dropped.

EXECUTION ARMS (costs from config/risk.yaml, read-only)
- market: next open +2.0 bp against, taker 5.5 bp.
- pegged (R-EXE-1): next open +1.3 bp against, maker 2.0 bp, always fills (as replayed: 275/275).
- retest: PostOnly limit at the broken level L placed at the signal close, live for N = 6 bars (t+1..t+6), fills only when price trades THROUGH L by >= 1 bp (pessimistic queue), at L (or at the open if it gaps through), maker 2.0 bp; cancelled if the stop is on the wrong side of L; missed = 0 R. Sensitivity (descriptive, not in BH): N = 24.
- Exits for all arms: taker 5.5 + 2.0 bp slippage (stops: worse of stop and open, then slippage).

REGIMES (known at the signal; all from the symbol's 4h frame, last 4h bar closed at or before the signal close)
- v0 cell (regimes.label on 4h, settings v0) crossed with trade side: R1..R9 x {long, short} = 18 cells.
- vol tercile: 4h sigma_next percentile within its trailing 365 days (2190 bars) -> T1/T2/T3 (sides pooled).
- trend-strength tercile: |v0 dir_score| percentile within the trailing 365 days -> S1/S2/S3 (sides pooled).
- plus ALL. 25 regime cells.

SEGMENTS: llm_in_sample = signal < 2026-07-01 (in-sample trades exiting after the cutoff are purged); clean_holdout = signal >= 2026-07-01. Signals computed on the full history first, then split.

STATISTICS AND MULTIPLE TESTING
- Cell = (variant, arm, regime cell): mean net R per trade (missed retests excluded from the per-trade mean, counted in the per-signal mean), hit rate, payoff ratio (mean win / |mean loss|), top-5% tail share (sum of the top 5% trades by net R / cell total), n trades, n distinct weeks.
- SE: week-clustered bootstrap (weeks resampled, B = 400, all symbols of a week together), z = mean / SE, one-sided p for mean > 0 (and < 0 for detrimental). Cells enter the test family only with n >= 30 trades and >= 10 weeks in that segment.
- BH at q = 0.10 across all tested cells within each segment (positive side = H-BOS1 family). H-BOS1 checks the in-sample survivors' clean_holdout mean sign once.
- Labels: explosive = mean > 0 and top-5% share > 100%; power = mean > 0, z > 2, top-5% share <= 100%; detrimental = mean < 0 with z < -2.
- DSR (Bailey-Lopez de Prado, trend_zoo_study.deflated_sharpe, daily net R booked at exit) and PBO (CSCV, 16 blocks, weekly net R) at every selection step: (1) best in-sample cell among all tested cells; (2) the static in-sample-best variant (variant x arm, ALL regime); (3) the allocator over its phi grid; (4) the best execution arm.
- H-BOS2: per timeframe class (intraday, swing) and arm market (primary; pegged/retest reported), the family pool (all 120 variants of the class: 60 per timeframe x 2 timeframes) per regime cell: tail share and mean with week-clustered z; condition A (explosive) and B (z < -2) must each hold for the SAME cell in both segments (loose version, different cells, also reported); best minus worst cell difference with week-clustered bootstrap.
- H-BOS3: in-sample-best cells = BH survivors, or if fewer than 10 the top 10 tested in-sample cells by z. Per cell: calendar half-year means (share with sign opposite the in-sample mean, >= 1/3 counts as flipping), OLS-CUSUM (statsmodels breaks_cusumolsresid) at 5%, and a Bai-Perron break-in-mean (dynamic programming, up to 3 breaks, 15% trimming, sup-F vs Andrews 5% critical value 8.85 for one break; BIC picks the number) on the full per-trade series. Break dates are compared with frozen events (+-30 days): 2021-05-19 China mining ban, 2021-11-10 BTC top, 2022-05-09 LUNA, 2022-06-13 Celsius/3AC, 2022-11-08 FTX, 2023-03-10 SVB/USDC, 2024-01-10 spot ETF, 2024-04-20 halving, 2024-08-05 carry unwind, 2024-11-05 US election, 2025-02-21 Bybit hack, 2025-04-07 tariff crash, 2025-10-10 liquidation cascade; and with BTC regime shifts = zero crossings of the 90-day share of up-cells (R1-R3) minus down-cells (R7-R9) on BTC 4h, declustered 60 days.
- H-BOS4 allocator (arm pegged primary, market reported): units = the 240 variants; posterior per (variant, v0 cell x side) on net R: discounted weekly sums with forgetting phi, prior mean 0 with kappa0 = 20 pseudo-trades, sd = the variant's training-window net-R sd; ON for the coming week (Monday 00:00 UTC) iff posterior mean / posterior sd >= 0.84 (P(edge > 0) >= 0.8), using only trades exited before the week starts. phi grid {0.90, 0.95, 0.98, 0.99, 1.00}. Book = sum of taken trades' net R / 240, booked on exit day. Baselines: equal weight of all 240 variants (same scale) and the static best variant (best training daily Sharpe, all regimes, held fixed). Nested purged WF: outer test blocks = calendar half-years 2023H1..2026H1 (in-sample) then the holdout 2026-07-01..11-15 trained on all in-sample; inner = phi with the best online allocator Sharpe inside the training window (26-week burn-in, trades exiting within 2 weeks of the training end purged); each book scaled by its own training-window daily sd before paired differences (NW t). DSR over the 5 phi books (in-sample WF series), PBO over them.
- H-BOS5: per signal, three arms paired (missed = 0 R), pooled over all variants of a timeframe class, exits as in each variant; retest - market and retest - pegged with week-clustered bootstrap 95% CI, both segments; missed-winner analysis: share of the market arm's winners and of its top-5% trades the retest never fills.
- Trial count reported: 240 variants x 3 arms x 25 regime cells per segment (tested cells only enter BH).

Constraints: 2 threads, < 2 GB RAM, checkpoint per symbol and timeframe (data/research/bos/cache/), research only.

title: ANALOG: multi-scale analog search (descriptive) and H-ANA1 walk-forward (contradicts / inconclusive)
body:
Agent ANALOG. Multi-scale analog search for BTC as of the 2026-11-15 17:00 UTC close, plus the H-ANA1 walk-forward. Report: research/reports/analogs_2026-11-15.md (+ .json, figures in research/figures/analogs_2026-11-15/). Design frozen at 17:56 (decision entry).

Clusters: 2025-H2/2026-H1 bear flushes (7), 2022 (5), 2024 (3).

H-ANA1 (recorded, both segments): llm_in_sample CONTRADICTS: QLIKE analog - HAR +0.288 (NW t +6.3) at 24h, +0.279 (t +4.4) at 72h, n 1976 / 1948 daily origins 2021-02..2026-06; the analogs are about 16% worse than log-HAR-t x weekday. clean_holdout INCONCLUSIVE: +0.399 (t +1.4) at 24h, +0.110 (t +0.8) at 72h, n 137 / 135 (72h n_eff 45 non-overlapping). Brier skill of the sign: in-sample -0.025 [-0.047, -0.002] (24h), -0.046 [-0.073, -0.021] (72h); holdout +0.002 / +0.026, CIs straddle 0. Unscaled variant: also worse in-sample (t +7.5 / +4.5).

Surprise: the analogs' up-tilt after flush-like states (90% up at 24h) looks striking in the descriptive table, yet the same machinery walk-forward has negative sign skill. The tilt partly comes from matching the bounce off the low (several analog hours sit 1-5 h after their 7-day low). Lesson: a striking analog table is not evidence. Rule candidates R-ANA-1 (B, active: don't use analog outcomes for move size), R-ANA-2 (C), R-ANA-3 (C) are in the report; not merged.

title: MAC: H-MAC1/H-MAC2 operationalisation frozen before any result
body:
Agent MACRO. Written before computing any regime-conditional BTC return.
Data: FRED public CSV (latest vintage) DGS2, DGS10, VIXCLS, BAMLH0A0HYM2, DTWEXBGS, SP500, NASDAQCOM (+ BAMLC0A0CM, BAMLC0A4CBBB, THREEFYTP10, DFII10, NASDAQ100 daily; UNRATE, SAHMREALTIME, CPILFESL, PCEPILFE monthly for thesis d). Daily known_ts = obs_date + 1 day 00:00 UTC as registered. BTC = Deribit BTC-PERPETUAL 1h (2020-01-01 .. first Bybit bar 2020-03-25) spliced to Bybit BTCUSDT 1h, UTC-day closes. The registration says 2017-2026; the lake has no BTC before 2020 and the user leads data decisions, so the test runs 2020-2026 and 2017-2019 is reported missing.
Regime (registered): 5-observation changes d2, d10 of DGS2/DGS10. No regime when |d2|<5bp and |d10|<5bp. Otherwise the dominant leg (larger |change|) decides, which is the only reading under which the four registered phrases are mutually exclusive: 2y dominant & up = bear_flattening; 2y dominant & down = bull_steepening; 10y dominant & up = bear_steepening; 10y dominant & down = bull_flattening. Ties go to the 2y.
Outcome: entry at the BTC close at known_ts (UTC day close of obs_date); forward log return over 5 and 20 calendar days (BTC trades daily); vol-scaled by sigma_hat = sd of the 30 daily log returns ending at entry, times sqrt(h). Segment by entry date vs research.knowledge_cutoff.
H-MAC1 test: per cell (bear_flattening, bull_steepening) x (5d, 20d), mean vol-scaled return, one-sided p from a week-clustered (ISO week of entry) bootstrap with the null imposed (centred), 5000 draws, seed 7; Holm over the 4 cells. Also reported: difference vs unconditional mean and an NW t (lags = h) because 20d windows overlap across weeks. Verdict per segment: supports = all 4 cells right sign and Holm p<0.05 (llm_in_sample) / all 4 right sign (clean_holdout, given in-sample support); contradicts = any cell significantly (Holm p<0.05) the wrong sign, or >= 3 of 4 cells wrong sign; else inconclusive.
H-MAC2 test: bull-steepening days split by the 5-obs change in BAMLH0A0HYM2 (<0 eased vs >0 widened; 0 dropped); difference in mean 20d vol-scaled return eased minus widened; week-clustered bootstrap 95% CI (weeks resampled within each group). supports = diff>0 with CI>0 in the full sample (pooled) and diff>0 in both segments; contradicts = diff<0 with CI<0 in the full sample, or diff<0 in both segments; else inconclusive.
Robustness (descriptive, not used for the verdict): known_ts + 1 extra day.

title: DEEP: microstructure fingerprint of the top-10 analogs vs now (design, descriptive)
body: Agent DEEP. Descriptive study chosen after seeing today (2026-11-15), no hypothesis tested; H-ANA1 (analogs do not forecast) stands. Episodes: the top-10 combined analog hours of research/reports/analogs_2026-11-15.md plus NOW = 2026-11-15 17:00 UTC. Window T-3d..T+7d (Binance 1m from T-33d for 30d context, to T+14d for outcomes). Sources: Binance UM 1m klines (taker-buy delta), metrics (OI, top-trader account/position LS, global LS, taker LS ratio), fundingRate monthly, spot 1m (basis), bookDepth (+-0.2..5%, 2023+), CM BTCUSD_PERP liquidationSnapshot where present (UM liquidationSnapshot does not exist in the archive); Bybit tick trades for T-date +-1, ob200 where present (BTC ob200 only spans a few bp, so 25/50/100 bp depth comes from Binance bookDepth and, for NOW, Bybit flow_3s); Bybit funding/OI lake + REST 1h OI; Deribit DVOL and Fear & Greed from the lake; OKX 1H candles as cross-check. Liquidation proxy (same rule every episode): 1m bars with return < -3 sigma(30d 1m), volume > 5x 30d median, taker share > 0.65 on the move side. Fingerprint at T only uses data <= T. Similarity per group = exp(-d^2/2), d = RMS of feature gaps standardised by the cross-episode sd. Level probabilities from the analogs' first passage, the field card touch probabilities (BM fitted to them) and a driftless first-passage baseline. Raw to data/raw/deep/ one day at a time, deleted after processing; manifest data/research/deep_analogs/manifest.json.

title: BOS family by regime and execution: no edge survives; intraday detrimental everywhere; swing tail-driven in calm regimes
body:
Results of block BOS (design frozen 18:05 UTC). 240 variants (5m/15m/1h/4h x fractal k2/3/5 + Donchian 20/55 x BoS/CHoCH/BoS+mom x opp/trail2.5/trail4.0/time) x 3 arms (market/pegged/retest N6) x 25 regime cells; 17,460 tested cells in-sample, 15,185 holdout.
- H-BOS1 contradicts / inconclusive: 0 BH-10% survivors positive in either segment; 8,210 negative survivors in-sample, 84% still negative in the holdout. Best cell 1h don20 CHoCH time pegged vol_T1 +0.234 R (z 3.25, n 8103) in-sample, +0.230 (z 0.60, n 740) holdout; DSR 0.00 (17,460 trials).
- H-BOS2 supports / supports: explosive (top-5% share > 100%) in both segments: swing R1L, R3L, R4L, R7L, vol_T1 (none significant); detrimental z < -2 in both: intraday R3S, R4S, R8L, R9L, vol_T1, vol_T3, trend_S1/S2. Swing best-minus-worst (R4S - R9S) +0.41 z 3.98 in-sample reverses in holdout (-0.16). Intraday family pool market -0.173 R (z -12.3) / -0.191 (z -3.2).
- H-BOS3 contradicts / inconclusive: top-10 cells flip in 0.18-0.20 of half-years (< 1/3); 6/10 show a 5% break (2023-06-26 R1S cells, 2022-07-10); 7/10 flip sign in the holdout (R1S/R7S shorts).
- H-BOS4 contradicts / inconclusive: pegged WF allocator Sharpe -0.38 vs static +0.25 vs EW -4.60 (vs static t -0.69); holdout -0.90 / -1.11 / -4.90 (vs static t 0.34, vs EW t 2.82); DSR 0.004; phi = 1.0 chosen in 8/8 blocks.
- H-BOS5 supports / inconclusive: intraday retest - market +0.068 [+0.057, +0.078], retest - pegged +0.018 [+0.007, +0.027] in-sample; holdout retest - pegged CI includes 0; swing no difference. Retest misses 24% of signals, 35-39% of the market arm's top-5% trades. Pegged - market > 0 everywhere (+0.013 swing, +0.050 intraday).
What it changes: intraday BoS is a cost sink in every regime (R-BOS-1 candidate, B); swing BoS is near zero overall, tail-driven and modestly positive only in calm vol / quiet-trend longs (C, forward-test candidate), negative in high vol, R6, R9, R3S (C). Retest entries miss the explosive winners; prefer pegged. Adaptive regime switching did not beat the static pick. 7 rule candidates R-BOS-1..7 (validated) in the report; not merged into rules.yaml.

title: BOS: H-BOS2 verdict pools cells across the two timeframe classes (fixed after the swing-only dry run, before recording)
body: The frozen design computes H-BOS2 per class (intraday, swing) and requires conditions A (explosive) and B (z < -2) to each hold for the same cell in both segments; it does not require A and B in the same class. My first verdict code required them in the same class; I changed it before recording so A and B are taken over the cells of both classes, which matches the registered statement ("in at least one cell ... in at least one other cell"). Under the same-class reading the holdout verdict would have been inconclusive (swing has strict A but no strict B; intraday has strict B but no strict A). Both readings are in the report.

title: KAVAUSDT order-flow scalper built (atx scalp, shadow only) and H-SCALP1 pre-registered
body:
Built crates/atx/src/scalp.rs (atx scalp, engine scalp-v1) + config/scalp_kava.yaml + scripts/scalp_eval.py. Deterministic Rust engine on Bybit public WS orderbook.50 + publicTrade + tickers: L1 OFI (Cont-Kukanov-Stoikov) and taker delta over 10/30/60 s, z(OFI_w) vs its own last 1800 one-second samples, book imbalance within 5 ticks, microprice vs mid, sweeps (same-ts same-side prints at >= 2 prices), absorption, spread, touch queue.

H-SCALP1 registered BEFORE any signal (the 300-sample z warm-up meant none could exist yet): long when spread <= 2 ticks, z(OFI_30) >= 1.5, delta_30 > 0, microprice > mid, no sell sweep in 10 s (short symmetric). PostOnly at the touch, cancel after 20 s / z crosses 0 / opposite signal. Stop 1 tick beyond the 60 s trade extreme, >= 4 ticks, skip if > 12; TP exactly 2R; time stop 5 min (passive 30 s, then market); funding: shorts flat at T-5 min and no short entry within 11 min, longs flat unless >= +1 R. Notional 20 USD. Conservative shadow fills (trade-through, or prints at our price > queue ahead + our qty; stop at min(stop - 1 tick, print), taker; TP only on trade-through). Success: first 30 fills, mean net R > 0, block-bootstrap CI lower bound > -0.05, TP-hit rate > 1/(1+W).

Cost arithmetic before data: with a 4-tick stop (about 14 bp), a 2R TP nets only about +0.96 R once the R unit includes the 1-tick stop slip and both fees, so the break-even TP-hit rate is about 51 %. The bar is high, and the prior is 0.15.

Stop trigger: LastPrice. At 22:08 UTC the mark was 0.02917 against last about 0.02897, i.e. about 20 ticks of mark-last basis (funding -1.17 %/8h). That is larger than the whole 4-12 tick stop range, so a MarkPrice stop would not track the book we trade.

Live mode: implemented as a pre-flight that always refuses (mainnet env, two-key guard, KILL, sub-limits tighter than live_small, approval gate). It is not routed, because the live_small approval gate is MANUAL (1 of 5 confirmed trades) and per-second entries cannot be hand-approved, and because sharing entries_today and realised P&L needs scalper trades inside data/live/state.json under its lock. Shadow run started 22:10:11 UTC, PID 19460.

title: Scalper live path built (atx scalp --mode live), disabled until H-SCALP1 passes
body:
New crates/atx/src/scalp_live.rs. Scalper trades are TradeRecs in data/live/state.json (source scalp, id sc-<run>-<n>, orderLinkId lsb-sc-...), written under the desk StateLock with the desk load/save. So entries_today, realised P&L, the daily stop, open slots, same side and gross are shared, and atx live status/reconcile show ([scalp] tag) and reconcile them.

Each entry: decide_live with live_small, tier caps tightened to 20 USD, min_net_expected_r unchanged (never the learning minimum). p_tp = the 95 % CI lower bound of the shadow TP-hit rate from the frozen H-SCALP1 evaluation (scripts/scalp_eval.py --write research/scalp/H-SCALP1_eval.json, written once). Then the scalper sub-limits: run entries, scalper day loss 3 USD, 4 consecutive losses, and no same-side entry beside an open desk bot position in a correlated cluster. decide_live itself only refuses opposite-side hedges of a losing position, so that last rule is new.

Start refusals: not mainnet, two-key guard, KILL, sub-limits, no verdict file or verdict not supported for strategy hash 17416371082833e8, gate MANUAL without data/live/approvals/scalp-<run_id>.ok (written by the orchestrator, never by code). The guard and KILL are re-checked every second.

Orders: PostOnly entry with the stopLoss attached (LastPrice, tpslMode Full); reduce-only PostOnly TP (-tp) on the fill; time stop as a passive -tx order, then a reduce-only market close. Private WS order/execution/position, REST poll every 5 s. Halts on an unknown scalper order, an unexpected position or size, or no stop after one re-attach: own orders cancelled, stop kept.

Placement sigma: sd(1 s mid log returns) x sqrt(60 s). At the 5 min horizon most 4-12 tick stops would sit inside 0.5 sigma. The live section is excluded from the strategy hash, so the shadow record stays one track. Not run live; no orders placed.

title: atx tape: read-only participant labeller (descriptive labels, not tested)
body:
Built `atx tape` (crates/atx/src/tape.rs, config/tape.yaml, version tape-v1): a deterministic, read-only participant labeller on Bybit PUBLIC data only (orderbook.1 / .50 / deep 200-1000, publicTrade, allLiquidation per symbol on one websocket; no keys, no orders, no balances). Started on BTC, ETH, SOL, ZEC, XRP, DOGE, HYPE, SUI after the user reported BTC expanding to the downside and asked who is participating and where they want to push price.

Footprints (thresholds in config/tape.yaml, config hash logged on every journal row): HFT_MM (L1 update rate and flicker share both above their rolling 30-min p80; flicker = an L1 level that leaves within 500 ms with no print at its price; cancel-to-trade within 5 ticks of the touch), SPOOF_PULL (a wall >= 5x the median level size within 50 bp of mid, cancelled rather than traded while within 3 ticks of its touch and closer than at birth, after living >= 500 ms; plus a 10 s follow-up on whether mid moved away), ALGO_BUY/SELL (>= 5 same-side clips of one size within 1 %, gap CV < 0.5, clips >= the rolling p50 notional), ICEBERG_BID/ASK (more than 1.5x the largest displayed size executed at a touch price, with at least one refill), SWEEP (multi-level same-T, or a 1 s burst > 3x the p99 clip moving >= 2 ticks), LIQ_CASCADE (>= 5 one-sided liquidations in 30 s), taker delta by rolling clip-notional bucket (p50/p95/p99), and a PUSH summary (votes from the large+whale delta, algo side, defence and spoofs; a pulled wall points against the intended direction), with the next liquidity pool, the defended level and the swept level.

Decision: these labels are DESCRIPTIVE, NOT TESTED SIGNALS. None is registered in research/hypotheses.yaml and none has been evaluated, so every console line and journal row says "descriptive label, not a tested signal". They may be used to describe the tape to the user. They must not gate or size a trade until a footprint is pre-registered and evaluated forward against a baseline. Known limits: from L2 data alone an iceberg refill cannot be told apart from fresh joiners; 'spoof' is defined by cancel-on-approach, not by intent; flicker matching relies on the arrival order of trade and book messages. The scalper (H-SCALP1, hash 17416371082833e8) is untouched: the tape only imports pure helpers from it. Journal: data/journal/tape/<date>.jsonl, console log: logs/tape.log.

title: Correction: the missed 11:42 time stop was a PC suspend, not only the session
body:

The orchestrator went quiet at ~08:10 (API weekly limit), and at 11:42 nothing on the machine was running. A local watchdog alone would also have missed it.
Fixes (atx live watchdog, commit after fcccb47):
- the watchdog holds the Windows system-required execution state (blocks idle sleep) while any bot trade with a time stop is active, and releases it after;
- it cannot stop a manual sleep or a closed lid: with a live time stop open, the PC must stay on (to tell the user).
Side effects of the suspend: the lake has a ~11 h gap in flow / book data (collector) on 2026-11-20 10:38-21:56; live_nn, vol_ml and news_alt sleep timers do not count suspended time, so they were restarted at 22:12 (H-LIVE network lines 09:00-21:00 missing). Clarifications of the registration (not changes): ladder quotes sit at the zone edge nearest the mid; the take-profit is the mid at fill time rounded away from the entry and never less than one tick beyond it; sigma_risk = the quoter's unshrunk 1h sigma; the H-MMW5 'field P(jump)' is the BTC field (BTC-only) used as the market jump state for the alts, with on at the bottom tercile and off above the median (hysteresis), plus each alt's own 4h-range and 6 h shock conditions. Data. FRED/ALFRED all vintages pulled through the existing loader `atx alt fred --series ...` into lake alt_series (known_ts = vintage date + 1 day): core PCE, PCE, core CPI, CPI, CPI components (shelter, core goods, services less energy, medical services, airfares), PPI (final demand core, finished goods core, components portfolio mgmt / hospitals / physicians / airline), AHE, UNRATE, PAYEMS, NROU, GDP, GDPNow, NFCI, USREC, GS10, TB3MS, BAA10YM, SAHMREALTIME, ECBDFR, euro HICP. Daily series with > 2000 vintages (DGS*, T10Y3M, DFEDTARU/L, NASDAQCOM) are rejected by the API; they are not revised, so they come from the public CSV via ai_trader.narrative.macro (rule_ts = obs + 1 day).

M1 (core PCE). Origin T = 00:00 UTC of the PCE release date of month m (date of the first vintage that contains m). Target = first-release log m/m x100. Candidates: AR(p) p 1..12; Minnesota VAR(p) p 1..6, lambda {0.05,0.1,0.2,0.5,1,OLS} on core PCE, core CPI, core finished-goods PPI, AHE m/m and dUNRATE; bridge (h=0) with 4 variable sets. Benchmarks: random walk (last m/m), 12-month mean. Validation origins 2003-2014 (bridge 2010-2014), test 2015-01..latest once, COVID targets 2020-03..2021-12 separate. DM with HAC + Harvey correction. Intervals: Student-t on validation errors per horizon. y/y implied from the vintage at T plus the forecast path (published convention = simple %).
Q3 GDP 2nd estimate: advance estimate + mean first revision, Student-t fit to the historical advance->second revisions (vintages 1990-2014).

M2 (policy). Monthly ordered logit on the end-of-month target move (Fed upper target; ECB DFR). Fed regressors: core PCE y/y - 2 (vintage), UNRATE - NROU (vintage), NFCI (vintage), lagged level, last move sign; ZLB months excluded from the fit. Benchmarks: climatology, persistence, logistic map of 3m bill minus target midpoint (market proxy; futures history is paywalled; current CME FedWatch recorded as given). Forward path to the Jan / Mar 2027 meetings by simulation with M1's inflation path, unemployment flat. Monthly design means non-meeting months count as holds: documented approximation.

M3 (recession). Monthly probit, P(USREC=1 in t+1..t+12); labels used at origin t only for s <= t-24 (horizon + NBER announcement lag). Candidates TS / TS+BAA spread / TS+Sahm / TS+spread+real FF+Sahm / +NFCI; selection on validation log score 1972-1989; test 1990-01..2024-10 once; 24-month block bootstrap. Then the current state vs 2018Q4 and 2007Q3-2008Q3 feature by feature.

M4. BTC 1d/5d vol-scaled log returns on the standardised surprise (actual - M1 pre-release forecast) for core PCE and core CPI, 2020-04..latest, NW SEs, segments at the knowledge cutoff. Consensus history unavailable point-in-time: the model forecast is the expectation (weaker).

Forward test: the Oct core PCE nowcast (and Q3 GDP 2nd) goes to research/macro/forecasts/2026-11-25_pre_release.json and is committed and pushed before 13:30 UTC; scored after, never edited.

title: MACRO models M1-M4: out-of-sample verdicts and current readings
body:
Results (all recorded in research/hypotheses_results.jsonl; report research/reports/macro_models_2026-11-25.md).
- H-MAC3 inconclusive (pooled): AR(12) selected; test RMSE vs 12m mean ratio 1.00/0.98/0.97 at h=1-3 (DM p 0.50/0.35/0.27); beats RW by 25-30%; 80% coverage 0.72-0.75.
- H-MAC4 inconclusive: bridge S2 (core CPI + core PPI) RMSE 0.075 vs AR(12) 0.100 (ratio 0.76, DM p 0.002) but frozen 80% coverage 0.67 < 0.70 (intervals fitted on mostly pseudo-real-time 2010-2014 validation were too narrow).
- H-MAC5 contradicts: Fed ordered logit Brier 0.461 vs climatology 0.434, persistence 0.411, bill proxy 0.319.
- H-MAC6 inconclusive: ECB Brier 0.292 vs climatology 0.333 (CI includes 0) and persistence 0.288.
- H-MAC7 inconclusive: TS+Baa probit AUC 0.80 vs 0.61 for TS only, Brier diff -0.003 (CI -0.069..+0.048).
- H-MAC8 inconclusive: pooled CPI+PCE surprise slope -0.15 (t -1.5) in-sample; core CPI alone -0.32 (t -2.0, sub-analysis = extra trial).
Current: P(recession 12m) 0.19 (80% 0.11-0.25) vs 0.65 real-time in Dec 2018 and 0.28 in mid-2008; hike + 50-100 bp Baa widening -> 0.51-0.74. Oct core PCE nowcast 0.24% m/m / 3.19% y/y committed 00:44Z (0c73a21) before the 13:30 UTC release.
Surprise: the free market proxy (3m bill minus target) beats the Taylor-type reaction function by a wide margin; the reaction function is mostly a persistence model.

title: First macro forward test: October core PCE nowcast missed low, GDP surprised high
